text: Huroof-e-Muqatta'at jo suraton ke shuru mein aate hain un ki poori tafsir Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein guzar chuki hai. Yahan Quran ki qasam khai aur ise pand-o-nasihat karne wala farmaya. Kyunke is ki baton par amal karne wale ki deen-o-duniya dono sanwar jati hain aur aayat mein hai (Laqad anzalna ilaikum kitaban fihi zikrukum, afala ta'qiloon) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 10). Is Quran mein tumhare liye nasihat hai aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke Quran sharafat mein buzurg izzat-o-azmat wala hai. Ab is qasam ka jawab ba'az ke nazdeek to (In kullun illa kazzabar-rusula fahaqqa iqab) (Surah (Sad: 14) hai. Ba'az kehte hain (Inna zalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahl-e-nar) (Surah (Sad: 64) hai, lekin yeh zyada munasib maloom nahin hota. Hazrat Qatadah (R.A) farmate hain is ka jawab is ke baad ki aayat hai. Ibn-e-Jarir isi ko mukhtar batate hain. Ba'az Arabi daan kehte hain is ka jawab 'Sad' hai aur is lafz ke ma'ani sadaqat aur haqaniyat ke hain. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke poori surat ka khulasa is qasam ka jawab hai. Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai yeh Quran to sarasar ibrat-o-nasihat hai magar is se faida wahi uthate hain jin ke dil mein iman hai. Kafir log is faide se is liye mehroom hain ke woh mutakabbir hain aur mukhalif hain. Yeh log apne se pehle aur apne jaise logon ke anjam par nazar dalein to apne anjam se darein. Agli ummatein isi jurm par Hum ne teh-o-bala kar di hain. Azab aa padne ke baad to bade roye peete khoob aaho-zari ki lekin us waqt ki tamam baatein besood hain. Jaise farmaya (Falamma ahassu ba'sana iza hum minha yarkudoon) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 12). Hamare azabon ko maloom kar ke un se bachna aur bhagna chaha. Lekin yeh kaise ho sakta tha? Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke ab bhagne ka waqt nahin na faryad ka waqt hai, us waqt koi faryad-rasi nahin kar sakta. Chaho jitna cheekho chillao mehez besood hai. Ab tauheed ki qabooliyat benafa', tauba bekar hai. Yeh be-waqt ki pukar hai. 'Lat' ma'ani mein 'La' ke hai. Is mein 'Ta' za'id hai jaise 'Summa' mein bhi 'Ta' zyada hoti hai aur 'Rubba' mein bhi. Yeh mafsoola hai aur is par waqf hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka qaul hai ke yeh 'Ta' 'heen' se mili hui hai yani 'wala-tahina', lekin mashhoor awwal hi hai. Jamhoor ne 'heen' ko zabar se padha hai. To matlab yeh hoga ke yeh waqt aaho-zari ka waqt nahin. Ba'az ne yahan zer padhna bhi jaiz rakha hai. Lughat mein 'naus' kehte hain peeche hatne ko aur 'baus' kehte hain aage badhne ko. Pas maqsad yeh hai ke yeh waqt bhagne aur nikal jaane ka waqt nahin. Wallahul Muwaffiq.))))

Mushrikeen ka Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par ta'ajjub. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat par kuffar ke hamaqat-amez ta'ajjub ka izhar ho raha hai jaise aur ayat mein hai (A-kana lin-nasi 'ajaban an auhaina ila rajulim minhum an anzirin-nasa wa bash-shirillazina amanu anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim, qalal-kafiruna inna haza lasahirum mubin) (Yunus: 2), kya logon ko is baat se ta'ajjub hua ke un mein se ek insan ki taraf hum ne wahi ki taake woh logon ko hoshiyar kar de aur imandaron ko is baat ki khush-khabri suna de ke us ke paas un ke liye behtareen laiha-e-amal hai. Kafir to hamare Rasool ko khula jadugar kehne lage. Yahin par yeh zikr hai ke unhi mein se unhi jaise ek insan ke Rasool ban kar aane par unhein ta'ajjub hua aur kehne lage ke yeh to jadugar aur kazzab hai. Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat par ta'ajjub ke sath hi Allah ki wahdaniyat par bhi unhein ta'ajjub maloom hua aur kehne lage ke aur suno itne sare maboodon ke badle yeh to kehta hai ke Allah ek hi hai aur us ka koi kisi tarah ka shareek hi nahin. In bewaqoofon ko apne badon ki dekha-dekhi jis shirk-o-kufr ki aadat thi us ke khilaf awaz sun kar un ke dilon mein dukhne aur rukne lage aur woh toheed ko ek anokhi aur anjan cheez samajhne lage. Un ke badon aur sardaron ne takabbur ke sath munh modte hue elan kiya ke apne qadeemi mazhab par jame raho. Is ki baat na mano aur apne maboodon ki ibadat karte raho. Yeh to sirf apne matlab ki baatein kehta hai. Yeh is bahane apni jama raha hai ke yeh tumhara sab ka bada ban jaye aur tum is ke tabe-e-farman ho jao. In ayaton ka shan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke ek baar Quraishiyon ke shareef aur sardar ru'asa ek martaba jama hue un mein Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Aas bin Wail, Aswad bin Al-Muttalib, Aswad bin Abd-e-Yaghus waghera bhi the aur sab ne is baat par ittefaq kiya ke chal kar aaj Abu Talib se aakhri faisla kar lein woh insaf ke sath ek baat hamare zimme daal de aur ek apne bhatije ke zimme. Kyunke yeh ab intehai umr ko pahunch chuke hain chiragh-e-sehari ho rahe hain agar mar gaye aur un ke baad hum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko koi museebat pahunchai to Arab mein ta'ana denge ke budhe ki maujoodgi tak to kuch na chali aur un ki maut ke baad bahaduri aa gayi. Chunancha ek aadmi bhej kar Abu Talib se ijazat mangi un ki ijazat par sab ghar mein gaye aur kaha suniye janab! Aap hamare sardar hain buzurg hain bade hain. Hum aap ke bhatije se ab bahut tang aa gaye hain aap insaf ke sath hum mein aur is mein faisla kar dijiye. Dekhiye hum aap se insaf chahte hain woh hamare maboodon ko bura na kahein aur na hum unhein satayein woh mukhtar hain jis ki chahein ibadat karein lekin hamare maboodon ko bura na kahein.

Abu Talib ne aadmi bhej kar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko bulwaya aur kaha jaan-e-pidar dekhte ho aap ki qoum ke sardar aur buzurg sab jama hue hain aur aap se sirf yeh chahte hain ke aap un ke maboodon ki tauheen aur burai karne se baaz aa jayen aur yeh aap ko aap ke deen par chalne mein aazadi de rahe hain. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya chacha jaan kya main unhein behtareen aur badi bhalai ki taraf na bulaun? Abu Talib ne kaha woh kya hai? Farmaya yeh ek kalma keh dein sirf us ke kehne ki wajah se sara Arab un ke matahat ho jayega aur sare Ajam par un ki hukumat ho jayegi. Abu Jahl maloon ne sawal kiya ke achha batao woh aisa kaunsa kalma hai? Ek nahin hum das kehne ko tayyar hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya kaho La Ilaha Illallah bas yeh sunna tha ke shor-o-ghul kar diya aur kehne lage is ke siwa jo tu mange hum dene ko tayyar hain. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya agar tum suraj ko bhi la kar mere hath par rakh do toh bhi toh tum se is kalme ke siwa aur kuch nahin mangunga. Sare ke sare mare gusse aur ghazab ke bhuna kar khade ho gaye aur kehne lage wallah hum tujhe aur tere Allah ko galiyan denge jis ne tujhe yeh hukm diya hai. Ab yeh chale aur un ke sardar yeh kehte rahe ke jao apne deen par aur apne maboodon ki ibadat par jame raho. Maloom ho gaya ke is shakhs ka toh irada hi aur hai yeh toh bada banna chahta hai (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke un ke bhag jane ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne chacha se kaha ke aap hi is kalme ko padh lijiye us ne kaha nahin main toh apne baap dadon aur qoum ke badon ke deen par hi rahunga. Is par Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko farmaya ke jise tu chahe hidayat nahin kar sakta aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt Abu Talib bimar the aur isi wajah se woh mara bhi. Jis waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) tashreef laye us waqt Abu Talib ke paas ek aadmi ke baithne ki jagah khali thi baqi tamam ghar aadmiyon se bhara hua tha toh Abu Jahl khabees ne khayal kiya ke agar aap (ﷺ) aa kar apne chacha ke paas baith gaye toh zyada asar daal sakenge is liye yeh maloon kood kar wahan ja baitha aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ko darwaza ke paas hi baithna pada. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne jab ek kalma kehne ko kaha toh sab ne jawab diya ke ek nahin das hum sab muntazir hain farmayiye woh kya kalma hai? Aur jab kalma-e-tauheed aap ki zabani suna toh kapde jhadte hue bhag khade hue aur kehne lage lo aur suno yeh toh sare maboodon ka ek mabood bana raha hai. Is par yeh aayatein, azaab tak, utrin. Imam Tirmidhi is riwayat ko Hasan kehte hain. Hum ne toh yeh baat na apne deen mein dekhi na nasraniyon ke deen mein. Yeh bilkul ghalat aur jhoot aur be-sanad baat hai. Yeh kaise kuch ta'ajjub ki baat hai ke Allah Miyan ko koi aur nazar hi na aaya aur us par Quran utar diya. Jaise ek aur aayat mein un ka qaul hai (وَقَالُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ ھٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَـتَيْنِ عَظِيْمٍ) (Az-Zukhruf: 31) yani un dono shahron mein ke kisi bade aadmi par yeh Quran kyun na utara gaya?

Jis ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hua ke kya yehi log Rabb ki Rahmat ki taqseem karne wale hain? Yeh toh is qadar mohtaj hain ke in ki apni roziyan aur darjay bhi hum taqseem karte hain. Al-gharz yeh aitraz bhi in ki hamaqat ka ghara tha. Allah farmata hai, yeh hai in ke shak ka natija aur wajah yeh hai ke ab tak yeh chikni chupri khate rahe hain hamare azabon se sabqa nahin para. Kal Qayamat ke din jabke dhakkay de kar Jahannam mein giraye jayenge, us waqt apni is sarkashi ka maza payenge. Phir Allah Ta'ala apna qabza aur apni qudrat zahir farmata hai ke jo woh chahe kare, jisay chahe jo chahe de, izzat zillat us ke hath hai, hidayat zalalat us ki taraf se hai. Woh apne bandon mein se jis par chahe Wahi nazil farmaye aur jis ke dil par chahe apni mohar laga de, bandon ke ikhtiyar mein kuch nahin, woh mehez bebas, bilkul lachar aur sarasar majboor hain. Isi liye farmaya kya in ke paas us buland janab, Ghalib, Wahab Allah ki Rahmat ke khazanay hain? Ya'ni nahin hain, jaise farmaya (Am lahum naseebum minal mulki fa-izan la yu'tunan nasa naqeera) (Surah (An-Nisa: 53), agar Allah ki hukmrani ka koi hissa in ke hath mein hota toh yeh bakheel toh kisi ko tukra bhi na khane dete. Aur inhein logon ke hathon mein Allah ka fazl dekh kar hasad aa raha hai? Hum ne Aal-e-Ibrahim ko Kitab-o-Hikmat aur bohat bari saltanat di thi. In mein se ba'az toh iman laye aur ba'az iman se rukay rahe, jo bharkti Jahannam ke luqmay banenge, woh aag hi inhein kafi hai. Aur aayat mein hai (Qul lau antum tamlikuna khaza'ina rahmati Rabbi izan la-amsaktum khashyatal infaq, wa kanal insanu qatoora) (Surah (Al-Isra: 100). Ya'ni agar mere Rabb ki rahmatoon ke khazanay tumhari malkiyat mein hote toh tum toh kami se dar kar kharch karne se ruk jate, insan hai hi nashukra. Qaum-e-Saleh ne bhi apne Nabi (ﷺ) se yehi kaha tha ke al-kh, kya hum sab ko chor kar isi par zikr utara gaya? Nahin balkay yeh kazzab aur shareer hai. Allah farmata hai kal maloom kar lenge ke aisa kaun hai? Phir farmaya kya zameen aasman aur us ke darmiyan ki cheezon par in ka ikhtiyar hai? Agar aisa hai toh phir aasmanon ki raahon par charh jayen, satwein aasman par pahunch jayen. Yeh yahan ka lashkar bhi anqareeb hazimat-o-shikast uthaye ga aur maghloob-o-zaleel hoga. Jaise aur baray baray garoh haq se takraye aur pash pash ho gaye, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Am yaquluna nahnu jame'um muntasir) (Surah (Al-Qamar: 44), ya'ni kya in ka qaul hai ke hum bari jama'at hain aur hum hi fath-yab rahenge? Suno inhein abhi abhi shikast-e-fash hogi aur peeth dikhate hue buzdili ke sath bad-hawas ho kar bhaag kharay honge. Chunancha Badr wale din Allah ki farman-rawai ne Allah ki baton ki sachai inhein apni aankhon se dikhayi aur abhi in ke azabon ke waday ka din toh Aakhirat ka din hai jo sakht karwa aur nihayat dehshat-naak aur wehshat wala hai.)))

Farmaya yeh ek kalma keh dein sirf us ke kehne ki wajah se sara Arab un ke matahat ho jayega aur sare Ajam par un ki hukumat ho jayegi. Abu Jahl maloon ne sawal kiya ke achha batao woh aisa kaunsa kalma hai? Ek nahin hum das kehne ko tayyar hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya kaho La Ilaha Illallah bas yeh sunna tha ke shor-o-ghul kar diya aur kehne lage is ke siwa jo tu mange hum dene ko tayyar hain. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya agar tum suraj ko bhi la kar mere hath par rakh do toh bhi toh tum se is kalme ke siwa aur kuch nahin mangunga. Sare ke sare mare gusse aur ghazab ke bhuna kar khade ho gaye aur kehne lage wallah hum tujhe aur tere Allah ko galiyan denge jis ne tujhe yeh hukm diya hai. Ab yeh chale aur un ke sardar yeh kehte rahe ke jao apne deen par aur apne maboodon ki ibadat par jame raho. Maloom ho gaya ke is shakhs ka toh irada hi aur hai yeh toh bada banna chahta hai (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke un ke bhag jane ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne chacha se kaha ke aap hi is kalme ko padh lijiye us ne kaha nahin main toh apne baap dadon aur qoum ke badon ke deen par hi rahunga. Is par Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko farmaya ke jise tu chahe hidayat nahin kar sakta aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt Abu Talib bimar the aur isi wajah se woh mara bhi. Jis waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) tashreef laye us waqt Abu Talib ke paas ek aadmi ke baithne ki jagah khali thi baqi tamam ghar aadmiyon se bhara hua tha toh Abu Jahl khabees ne khayal kiya ke agar aap (ﷺ) aa kar apne chacha ke paas baith gaye toh zyada asar daal sakenge is liye yeh maloon kood kar wahan ja baitha aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ko darwaza ke paas hi baithna pada. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne jab ek kalma kehne ko kaha toh sab ne jawab diya ke ek nahin das hum sab muntazir hain farmayiye woh kya kalma hai? Aur jab kalma-e-tauheed aap ki zabani suna toh kapde jhadte hue bhag khade hue aur kehne lage lo aur suno yeh toh sare maboodon ka ek mabood bana raha hai. Is par yeh aayatein, azaab tak, utrin. Imam Tirmidhi is riwayat ko Hasan kehte hain. Hum ne toh yeh baat na apne deen mein dekhi na nasraniyon ke deen mein. Yeh bilkul ghalat aur jhoot aur be-sanad baat hai. Yeh kaise kuch ta'ajjub ki baat hai ke Allah Miyan ko koi aur nazar hi na aaya aur us par Quran utar diya. Jaise ek aur aayat mein un ka qaul hai (وَقَالُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ ھٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَـتَيْنِ عَظِيْمٍ) (Az-Zukhruf: 31) yani un dono shahron mein ke kisi bade aadmi par yeh Quran kyun na utara gaya?

Jis ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hua ke kya yehi log Rabb ki Rahmat ki taqseem karne wale hain? Yeh toh is qadar mohtaj hain ke in ki apni roziyan aur darjay bhi hum taqseem karte hain. Al-gharz yeh aitraz bhi in ki hamaqat ka ghara tha. Allah farmata hai, yeh hai in ke shak ka natija aur wajah yeh hai ke ab tak yeh chikni chupri khate rahe hain hamare azabon se sabqa nahin para. Kal Qayamat ke din jabke dhakkay de kar Jahannam mein giraye jayenge, us waqt apni is sarkashi ka maza payenge. Phir Allah Ta'ala apna qabza aur apni qudrat zahir farmata hai ke jo woh chahe kare, jisay chahe jo chahe de, izzat zillat us ke hath hai, hidayat zalalat us ki taraf se hai. Woh apne bandon mein se jis par chahe Wahi nazil farmaye aur jis ke dil par chahe apni mohar laga de, bandon ke ikhtiyar mein kuch nahin, woh mehez bebas, bilkul lachar aur sarasar majboor hain. Isi liye farmaya kya in ke paas us buland janab, Ghalib, Wahab Allah ki Rahmat ke khazanay hain? Ya'ni nahin hain, jaise farmaya (Am lahum naseebum minal mulki fa-izan la yu'tunan nasa naqeera) (Surah (An-Nisa: 53), agar Allah ki hukmrani ka koi hissa in ke hath mein hota toh yeh bakheel toh kisi ko tukra bhi na khane dete. Aur inhein logon ke hathon mein Allah ka fazl dekh kar hasad aa raha hai? Hum ne Aal-e-Ibrahim ko Kitab-o-Hikmat aur bohat bari saltanat di thi. In mein se ba'az toh iman laye aur ba'az iman se rukay rahe, jo bharkti Jahannam ke luqmay banenge, woh aag hi inhein kafi hai. Aur aayat mein hai (Qul lau antum tamlikuna khaza'ina rahmati Rabbi izan la-amsaktum khashyatal infaq, wa kanal insanu qatoora) (Surah (Al-Isra: 100). Ya'ni agar mere Rabb ki rahmatoon ke khazanay tumhari malkiyat mein hote toh tum toh kami se dar kar kharch karne se ruk jate, insan hai hi nashukra. Qaum-e-Saleh ne bhi apne Nabi (ﷺ) se yehi kaha tha ke al-kh, kya hum sab ko chor kar isi par zikr utara gaya? Nahin balkay yeh kazzab aur shareer hai. Allah farmata hai kal maloom kar lenge ke aisa kaun hai? Phir farmaya kya zameen aasman aur us ke darmiyan ki cheezon par in ka ikhtiyar hai? Agar aisa hai toh phir aasmanon ki raahon par charh jayen, satwein aasman par pahunch jayen. Yeh yahan ka lashkar bhi anqareeb hazimat-o-shikast uthaye ga aur maghloob-o-zaleel hoga. Jaise aur baray baray garoh haq se takraye aur pash pash ho gaye, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Am yaquluna nahnu jame'um muntasir) (Surah (Al-Qamar: 44), ya'ni kya in ka qaul hai ke hum bari jama'at hain aur hum hi fath-yab rahenge? Suno inhein abhi abhi shikast-e-fash hogi aur peeth dikhate hue buzdili ke sath bad-hawas ho kar bhaag kharay honge. Chunancha Badr wale din Allah ki farman-rawai ne Allah ki baton ki sachai inhein apni aankhon se dikhayi aur abhi in ke azabon ke waday ka din toh Aakhirat ka din hai jo sakht karwa aur nihayat dehshat-naak aur wehshat wala hai.)))

Mushrikeen ka Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par ta'ajjub. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat par kuffar ke hamaqat-amez ta'ajjub ka izhar ho raha hai jaise aur ayat mein hai (A-kana lin-nasi 'ajaban an auhaina ila rajulim minhum an anzirin-nasa wa bash-shirillazina amanu anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim, qalal-kafiruna inna haza lasahirum mubin) (Yunus: 2), kya logon ko is baat se ta'ajjub hua ke un mein se ek insan ki taraf hum ne wahi ki taake woh logon ko hoshiyar kar de aur imandaron ko is baat ki khush-khabri suna de ke us ke paas un ke liye behtareen laiha-e-amal hai. Kafir to hamare Rasool ko khula jadugar kehne lage. Yahin par yeh zikr hai ke unhi mein se unhi jaise ek insan ke Rasool ban kar aane par unhein ta'ajjub hua aur kehne lage ke yeh to jadugar aur kazzab hai. Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat par ta'ajjub ke sath hi Allah ki wahdaniyat par bhi unhein ta'ajjub maloom hua aur kehne lage ke aur suno itne sare maboodon ke badle yeh to kehta hai ke Allah ek hi hai aur us ka koi kisi tarah ka shareek hi nahin. In bewaqoofon ko apne badon ki dekha-dekhi jis shirk-o-kufr ki aadat thi us ke khilaf awaz sun kar un ke dilon mein dukhne aur rukne lage aur woh toheed ko ek anokhi aur anjan cheez samajhne lage. Un ke badon aur sardaron ne takabbur ke sath munh modte hue elan kiya ke apne qadeemi mazhab par jame raho. Is ki baat na mano aur apne maboodon ki ibadat karte raho. Yeh to sirf apne matlab ki baatein kehta hai. Yeh is bahane apni jama raha hai ke yeh tumhara sab ka bada ban jaye aur tum is ke tabe-e-farman ho jao. In ayaton ka shan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke ek baar Quraishiyon ke shareef aur sardar ru'asa ek martaba jama hue un mein Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Aas bin Wail, Aswad bin Al-Muttalib, Aswad bin Abd-e-Yaghus waghera bhi the aur sab ne is baat par ittefaq kiya ke chal kar aaj Abu Talib se aakhri faisla kar lein woh insaf ke sath ek baat hamare zimme daal de aur ek apne bhatije ke zimme. Kyunke yeh ab intehai umr ko pahunch chuke hain chiragh-e-sehari ho rahe hain agar mar gaye aur un ke baad hum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko koi museebat pahunchai to Arab mein ta'ana denge ke budhe ki maujoodgi tak to kuch na chali aur un ki maut ke baad bahaduri aa gayi. Chunancha ek aadmi bhej kar Abu Talib se ijazat mangi un ki ijazat par sab ghar mein gaye aur kaha suniye janab! Aap hamare sardar hain buzurg hain bade hain. Hum aap ke bhatije se ab bahut tang aa gaye hain aap insaf ke sath hum mein aur is mein faisla kar dijiye. Dekhiye hum aap se insaf chahte hain woh hamare maboodon ko bura na kahein aur na hum unhein satayein woh mukhtar hain jis ki chahein ibadat karein lekin hamare maboodon ko bura na kahein.

Al-gharz yeh aitraz bhi in ki hamaqat ka ghara tha. Allah farmata hai, yeh hai in ke shak ka natija aur wajah yeh hai ke ab tak yeh chikni chupri khate rahe hain hamare azabon se sabqa nahin para. Kal Qayamat ke din jabke dhakkay de kar Jahannam mein giraye jayenge, us waqt apni is sarkashi ka maza payenge. Phir Allah Ta'ala apna qabza aur apni qudrat zahir farmata hai ke jo woh chahe kare, jisay chahe jo chahe de, izzat zillat us ke hath hai, hidayat zalalat us ki taraf se hai. Suno inhein abhi abhi shikast-e-fash hogi aur peeth dikhate hue buzdili ke sath bad-hawas ho kar bhaag kharay honge. Chunancha Badr wale din Allah ki farman-rawai ne Allah ki baton ki sachai inhein apni aankhon se dikhayi aur abhi in ke azabon ke waday ka din toh Aakhirat ka din hai jo sakht karwa aur nihayat dehshat-naak aur wehshat wala hai.)))

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat par kuffar ke hamaqat-amez ta'ajjub ka izhar ho raha hai jaise aur ayat mein hai (A-kana lin-nasi 'ajaban an auhaina ila rajulim minhum an anzirin-nasa wa bash-shirillazina amanu anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim, qalal-kafiruna inna haza lasahirum mubin) (Yunus: 2), kya logon ko is baat se ta'ajjub hua ke un mein se ek insan ki taraf hum ne wahi ki taake woh logon ko hoshiyar kar de aur imandaron ko is baat ki khush-khabri suna de ke us ke paas un ke liye behtareen laiha-e-amal hai. Kafir to hamare Rasool ko khula jadugar kehne lage. Yahin par yeh zikr hai ke unhi mein se unhi jaise ek insan ke Rasool ban kar aane par unhein ta'ajjub hua aur kehne lage ke yeh to jadugar aur kazzab hai. Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat par ta'ajjub ke sath hi Allah ki wahdaniyat par bhi unhein ta'ajjub maloom hua aur kehne lage ke aur suno itne sare maboodon ke badle yeh to kehta hai ke Allah ek hi hai aur us ka koi kisi tarah ka shareek hi nahin. In bewaqoofon ko apne badon ki dekha-dekhi jis shirk-o-kufr ki aadat thi us ke khilaf awaz sun kar un ke dilon mein dukhne aur rukne lage aur woh toheed ko ek anokhi aur anjan cheez samajhne lage. Un ke badon aur sardaron ne takabbur ke sath munh modte hue elan kiya ke apne qadeemi mazhab par jame raho. Is ki baat na mano aur apne maboodon ki ibadat karte raho. Yeh to sirf apne matlab ki baatein kehta hai. Yeh is bahane apni jama raha hai ke yeh tumhara sab ka bada ban jaye aur tum is ke tabe-e-farman ho jao. In ayaton ka shan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke ek baar Quraishiyon ke shareef aur sardar ru'asa ek martaba jama hue un mein Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Aas bin Wail, Aswad bin Al-Muttalib, Aswad bin Abd-e-Yaghus waghera bhi the aur sab ne is baat par ittefaq kiya ke chal kar aaj Abu Talib se aakhri faisla kar lein woh insaf ke sath ek baat hamare zimme daal de aur ek apne bhatije ke zimme. Kyunke yeh ab intehai umr ko pahunch chuke hain chiragh-e-sehari ho rahe hain agar mar gaye aur un ke baad hum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko koi museebat pahunchai to Arab mein ta'ana denge ke budhe ki maujoodgi tak to kuch na chali aur un ki maut ke baad bahaduri aa gayi. Chunancha ek aadmi bhej kar Abu Talib se ijazat mangi un ki ijazat par sab ghar mein gaye aur kaha suniye janab! Aap hamare sardar hain buzurg hain bade hain. Hum aap ke bhatije se ab bahut tang aa gaye hain aap insaf ke sath hum mein aur is mein faisla kar dijiye. Dekhiye hum aap se insaf chahte hain woh hamare maboodon ko bura na kahein aur na hum unhein satayein woh mukhtar hain jis ki chahein ibadat karein lekin hamare maboodon ko bura na kahein.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya kaho La Ilaha Illallah bas yeh sunna tha ke shor-o-ghul kar diya aur kehne lage is ke siwa jo tu mange hum dene ko tayyar hain. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya agar tum suraj ko bhi la kar mere hath par rakh do toh bhi toh tum se is kalme ke siwa aur kuch nahin mangunga. Sare ke sare mare gusse aur ghazab ke bhuna kar khade ho gaye aur kehne lage wallah hum tujhe aur tere Allah ko galiyan denge jis ne tujhe yeh hukm diya hai. Ab yeh chale aur un ke sardar yeh kehte rahe ke jao apne deen par aur apne maboodon ki ibadat par jame raho. Maloom ho gaya ke is shakhs ka toh irada hi aur hai yeh toh bada banna chahta hai (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke un ke bhag jane ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne chacha se kaha ke aap hi is kalme ko padh lijiye us ne kaha nahin main toh apne baap dadon aur qoum ke badon ke deen par hi rahunga. Ya'ni agar mere Rabb ki rahmatoon ke khazanay tumhari malkiyat mein hote toh tum toh kami se dar kar kharch karne se ruk jate, insan hai hi nashukra. Qaum-e-Saleh ne bhi apne Nabi (ﷺ) se yehi kaha tha ke al-kh, kya hum sab ko chor kar isi par zikr utara gaya? Nahin balkay yeh kazzab aur shareer hai. Agar aisa hai toh phir aasmanon ki raahon par charh jayen, satwein aasman par pahunch jayen. Yeh yahan ka lashkar bhi anqareeb hazimat-o-shikast uthaye ga aur maghloob-o-zaleel hoga. Jaise aur baray baray garoh haq se takraye aur pash pash ho gaye, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Am yaquluna nahnu jame'um muntasir) (Surah (Al-Qamar: 44), ya'ni kya in ka qaul hai ke hum bari jama'at hain aur hum hi fath-yab rahenge? Suno inhein abhi abhi shikast-e-fash hogi aur peeth dikhate hue buzdili ke sath bad-hawas ho kar bhaag kharay honge. Chunancha Badr wale din Allah ki farman-rawai ne Allah ki baton ki sachai inhein apni aankhon se dikhayi aur abhi in ke azabon ke waday ka din toh Aakhirat ka din hai jo sakht karwa aur nihayat dehshat-naak aur wehshat wala hai.)))

Mushrikeen ka Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par ta'ajjub. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat par kuffar ke hamaqat-amez ta'ajjub ka izhar ho raha hai jaise aur ayat mein hai (A-kana lin-nasi 'ajaban an auhaina ila rajulim minhum an anzirin-nasa wa bash-shirillazina amanu anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim, qalal-kafiruna inna haza lasahirum mubin) (Yunus: 2), kya logon ko is baat se ta'ajjub hua ke un mein se ek insan ki taraf hum ne wahi ki taake woh logon ko hoshiyar kar de aur imandaron ko is baat ki khush-khabri suna de ke us ke paas un ke liye behtareen laiha-e-amal hai. Kafir to hamare Rasool ko khula jadugar kehne lage. Yahin par yeh zikr hai ke unhi mein se unhi jaise ek insan ke Rasool ban kar aane par unhein ta'ajjub hua aur kehne lage ke yeh to jadugar aur kazzab hai. Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat par ta'ajjub ke sath hi Allah ki wahdaniyat par bhi unhein ta'ajjub maloom hua aur kehne lage ke aur suno itne sare maboodon ke badle yeh to kehta hai ke Allah ek hi hai aur us ka koi kisi tarah ka shareek hi nahin. In bewaqoofon ko apne badon ki dekha-dekhi jis shirk-o-kufr ki aadat thi us ke khilaf awaz sun kar un ke dilon mein dukhne aur rukne lage aur woh toheed ko ek anokhi aur anjan cheez samajhne lage. Un ke badon aur sardaron ne takabbur ke sath munh modte hue elan kiya ke apne qadeemi mazhab par jame raho. Is ki baat na mano aur apne maboodon ki ibadat karte raho. Yeh to sirf apne matlab ki baatein kehta hai. Yeh is bahane apni jama raha hai ke yeh tumhara sab ka bada ban jaye aur tum is ke tabe-e-farman ho jao. In ayaton ka shan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke ek baar Quraishiyon ke shareef aur sardar ru'asa ek martaba jama hue un mein Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Aas bin Wail, Aswad bin Al-Muttalib, Aswad bin Abd-e-Yaghus waghera bhi the aur sab ne is baat par ittefaq kiya ke chal kar aaj Abu Talib se aakhri faisla kar lein woh insaf ke sath ek baat hamare zimme daal de aur ek apne bhatije ke zimme. Kyunke yeh ab intehai umr ko pahunch chuke hain chiragh-e-sehari ho rahe hain agar mar gaye aur un ke baad hum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko koi museebat pahunchai to Arab mein ta'ana denge ke budhe ki maujoodgi tak to kuch na chali aur un ki maut ke baad bahaduri aa gayi. Chunancha ek aadmi bhej kar Abu Talib se ijazat mangi un ki ijazat par sab ghar mein gaye aur kaha suniye janab! Aap hamare sardar hain buzurg hain bade hain. Hum aap ke bhatije se ab bahut tang aa gaye hain aap insaf ke sath hum mein aur is mein faisla kar dijiye. Dekhiye hum aap se insaf chahte hain woh hamare maboodon ko bura na kahein aur na hum unhein satayein woh mukhtar hain jis ki chahein ibadat karein lekin hamare maboodon ko bura na kahein.

Abu Talib ne aadmi bhej kar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko bulwaya aur kaha jaan-e-pidar dekhte ho aap ki qoum ke sardar aur buzurg sab jama hue hain aur aap se sirf yeh chahte hain ke aap un ke maboodon ki tauheen aur burai karne se baaz aa jayen aur yeh aap ko aap ke deen par chalne mein aazadi de rahe hain. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya chacha jaan kya main unhein behtareen aur badi bhalai ki taraf na bulaun? Abu Talib ne kaha woh kya hai? Farmaya yeh ek kalma keh dein sirf us ke kehne ki wajah se sara Arab un ke matahat ho jayega aur sare Ajam par un ki hukumat ho jayegi. Abu Jahl maloon ne sawal kiya ke achha batao woh aisa kaunsa kalma hai? Ek nahin hum das kehne ko tayyar hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya kaho La Ilaha Illallah bas yeh sunna tha ke shor-o-ghul kar diya aur kehne lage is ke siwa jo tu mange hum dene ko tayyar hain. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya agar tum suraj ko bhi la kar mere hath par rakh do toh bhi toh tum se is kalme ke siwa aur kuch nahin mangunga. Sare ke sare mare gusse aur ghazab ke bhuna kar khade ho gaye aur kehne lage wallah hum tujhe aur tere Allah ko galiyan denge jis ne tujhe yeh hukm diya hai. Ab yeh chale aur un ke sardar yeh kehte rahe ke jao apne deen par aur apne maboodon ki ibadat par jame raho. Maloom ho gaya ke is shakhs ka toh irada hi aur hai yeh toh bada banna chahta hai (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke un ke bhag jane ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne chacha se kaha ke aap hi is kalme ko padh lijiye us ne kaha nahin main toh apne baap dadon aur qoum ke badon ke deen par hi rahunga. Is par Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko farmaya ke jise tu chahe hidayat nahin kar sakta aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt Abu Talib bimar the aur isi wajah se woh mara bhi. Jis waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) tashreef laye us waqt Abu Talib ke paas ek aadmi ke baithne ki jagah khali thi baqi tamam ghar aadmiyon se bhara hua tha toh Abu Jahl khabees ne khayal kiya ke agar aap (ﷺ) aa kar apne chacha ke paas baith gaye toh zyada asar daal sakenge is liye yeh maloon kood kar wahan ja baitha aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ko darwaza ke paas hi baithna pada. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne jab ek kalma kehne ko kaha toh sab ne jawab diya ke ek nahin das hum sab muntazir hain farmayiye woh kya kalma hai? Aur jab kalma-e-tauheed aap ki zabani suna toh kapde jhadte hue bhag khade hue aur kehne lage lo aur suno yeh toh sare maboodon ka ek mabood bana raha hai. Is par yeh aayatein, azaab tak, utrin. Imam Tirmidhi is riwayat ko Hasan kehte hain. Hum ne toh yeh baat na apne deen mein dekhi na nasraniyon ke deen mein. Yeh bilkul ghalat aur jhoot aur be-sanad baat hai. Yeh kaise kuch ta'ajjub ki baat hai ke Allah Miyan ko koi aur nazar hi na aaya aur us par Quran utar diya. Jaise ek aur aayat mein un ka qaul hai (وَقَالُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ ھٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَـتَيْنِ عَظِيْمٍ) (Az-Zukhruf: 31) yani un dono shahron mein ke kisi bade aadmi par yeh Quran kyun na utara gaya?

Jis ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hua ke kya yehi log Rabb ki Rahmat ki taqseem karne wale hain? Yeh toh is qadar mohtaj hain ke in ki apni roziyan aur darjay bhi hum taqseem karte hain. Aur inhein logon ke hathon mein Allah ka fazl dekh kar hasad aa raha hai? Hum ne Aal-e-Ibrahim ko Kitab-o-Hikmat aur bohat bari saltanat di thi. In sab ke waqiat kayi martaba bayan ho chuke hain ke kis tarah un par un ke gunahon ki wajah se Allah ke azab toot pade. Ibn-e-Jarir ka farman hai ke jis khair-o-sharr ke woh duniya mein mustahiq the use unhon ne jald talab kiya. Yehi baat theek hai, Zahhak aur Ismail ki tafsir ka mahasil bhi yehi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne un ki is takzeeb aur hansi ke muqable mein apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sabr ki taleem di aur bardasht ki talqeen ki. Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki firasat. Zal-ayd se murad ilmi aur amli quwwat wala hai aur sirf quwwat wale ke ma'ani bhi hote hain jaise farman hai (Wassama'a banaynaha bi-aydin wa inna lamusi'oon) (Az-Zariyat: 47), Mujahid farmate hain murad ita'at ki taqat hai. Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ko ibadat ki qudrat aur Islam ki fiqh ata farmayi gayi thi. Ye mazkoor hai ke aap har raat tihayi raat tak tahajjud mein khade rehte the aur ek din baad ek din hamesha rozay se rehte the. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Allah ko sab se zyada pasand Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ki raat ki namaz aur unhi ke rozay the. Aap aadhi raat sote aur tihayi raat qayam karte aur chatha hissa raat ka phir so jate, aur ek din roza rakhte ek din na rakhte aur dushmanan-e-deen se jihad karne mein peeth na dikhate aur apne har haal mein Allah ki taraf raghbat-o-rujoo rakhte. Pahadon ko un ke sath musakhkhar kar diya tha. Woh aap ke sath suraj ke dhalne ke waqt aur din ke aakhri waqt tasbeeh bayan karte. Jaise farman hai (Ya jibaalu awwibi ma'ahu wattayr, wa alanna lahul hadeed) (Saba: 10) yani Allah ne pahadon ko un ke sath rujoo karne ka hukum diya tha. Isi tarah parinday bhi aap ki aawaz sun kar aap ke sath Allah ki paki bayan karne lag jate, udte hue parind paas se guzarte aur aap Taurat padhte hote to aap ke sath woh bhi tilawat mein mashghool ho jate aur udna bhool jate balkay thahar jate. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Fatah-e-Makkah wale din Zuha ke waqt Hazrat Umm-e-Hani ke ghar mein aath rakat namaz ada ki.

Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain mera khayal hai ke yeh bhi waqt-e-namaz hai jaise farman hai (Inna sakhkarnal jibala ma'ahu yusabbihna bil-ashiyyi wal-ishraq) (Surah (Sad: 18). Abdullah bin Haris bin Naufal kehte hain ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) Duha ki namaz nahin padhte thay. Ek din main unhein Hazrat Umm-e-Hani (R.A) ke yahan le gaya aur kaha ke aap in se woh hadith bayan kijiye jo aap ne mujh se bayan farmayi thi. Toh Mai Sahiba ne farmaya Fatah-e-Makkah wale din mere ghar mein mere paas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye. Phir ek bartan mein pani bharwaya aur ek kapda taan kar nahane baith gaye, phir ghar ke ek kone mein pani chhidak kar aath raka'at Salat-e-Duha ki ada keen, un ka qayam, ruku, sajdah aur juloos sab qareeb qareeb barabar thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas jab yeh sun kar wahan se nikle toh farmane lage poore Quran ko main ne padh liya, main nahin janta ke Duha ki namaz kya hai, aaj mujhe maloom hua ke (Yusabbihna bil-ashiyyi wal-ishraq) (Surah (Sad: 18) wali aayat mein bhi Ishraq se murad yahi Duha hai. Chunancha is ke baad unhon ne apne agle qaul se ruju kar liya. Jab Hazrat Dawood (A.S) Allah ki pakeezgi aur buzurgi bayan farmate toh parindey bhi hawaon mein ruk jate thay aur Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ki matahuti mein un ki tasbeeh ka sath dete thay. Aur is ki saltanat hum ne mazboot kar di aur badshahon ko jin jin cheezon ki zaroorat padti hai hum ne use sab de dein. Char hazar toh un ki muhafiz sipah thi. Is qadar fauj thi ke har raat taintis hazar fauji pehrey par chadhte thay lekin jo aaj ki raat aate phir saal bhar tak un ki bari na aati. Chalees hazar aadmi har waqt un ki khidmat mein musallah tayyar rehte. Ek riwayat mein hai ke un ke zamane mein Bani Israel ke do aadmiyon mein ek muqadma hua. Ek ne dusre par dawa kiya ke is ne meri gaye ghasab kar li hai. Dusre ne is jurm se inkar kiya. Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ne mudda'i se daleel talab ki, woh koi gawah pesh na kar saka. Aap ne farmaya achha tumhein kal faisla sunaya jayega. Raat ko Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ko khwab mein hukm hua ke daweedar ko qatl kar do. Subah aap ne dono ko bulwaya aur hukm diya ke is mudda'i ko qatl kar diya jaye. Us ne kaha ae Allah ke Nabi! Aap mere hi qatl ka hukm de rahe hain halankeh is ne meri gaye chura li hai. Aap ne farmaya yeh mera hukm nahin, yeh Allah ka faisla hai aur namumkin hai ke yeh tal jaye, toh tayyar ho ja. Tab us ne kaha ae Allah ke Rasool! Main apne dawe mein toh sacha hoon, is ne meri gaye ghasab kar li hai. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko mere qatl ka hukm mere is muqadmay ki wajah se nahin diya. Is ki wajah aur hi hai aur ise sirf main hi janta hoon. Baat yeh hai ke aaj main ne ise fareb se qatl kar diya hai jis ka kisi ko ilm nahin. Pas is ke badle mein Allah ne aap ko qisas ka hukm diya hai. Chunancha woh qatl kar diya gaya.

Ab toh Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ki haibat har shakhs ke dil mein baith gayi. Hum ne unhein hikmat di thi yani fahm-o-aql, zeraki aur danai, adl-o-firasat, Kitabullah aur us ki itteba, nabuwwat-o-risalat waghera aur jhagron ka faisla karne ka sahih tariqa. Yani gawah lena, qasam khulwana, mudda'i ke zimme baar-e-suboot dalna, mudda'i alaih se qasam lena. Yehi tariqa faislon ka Anbiya (A.S) ka aur nek logon ka raha aur yehi tariqa is ummat mein ra'ij hai. Garz Hazrat Dawood (A.S) mamle ki teh ko pahunch jate the aur haq-o-batil, sach-jhoot mein sahih aur khare ka imtiyaz kar lete the. Kalam bhi aap ka saaf hota tha aur hukm bhi adl par mabni hota tha. Aap hi ne 'Amma Ba'ad' ka kehna ijad kiya hai aur 'Fasl-ul-Khitab' se is ki taraf bhi ishara hai.))

Phir un ki tabahi ki wajah bhi bayan hui ke ye rasoolon ke dushman the, unhein jhoota kehte the. Unhein sirf soor ka intezar hai aur is mein bhi koi der nahin, bas woh ek aawaz hogi ke jis ke kaan mein padi behosh-o-bejaan ho gaya. Siwaye un ke jinhein Rabb ne mustasna kar diya hai. Qitt ke ma'ani kitab aur hisse ke hain. Mushrikeen ki bewaqoofi aur un ka azabon ko mahal samajh kar nidar ho kar azabon ke talab karne ka zikr ho raha hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke unhon ne kaha Allah agar ye sahi hai to hum par aasman se patthar barsa ya aur koi dard-naak azab-e-aasmani hamein pahuncha aur ye bhi kaha gaya hai ke unhon ne apna jannat ka hissa yahan talab kiya aur ye jo kuch kaha ye ba-wajah use jhoota samajhne aur mahal janne ke tha. Ibn-e-Jarir ka farman hai ke jis khair-o-sharr ke woh duniya mein mustahiq the use unhon ne jald talab kiya. Yehi baat theek hai, Zahhak aur Ismail ki tafsir ka mahasil bhi yehi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne un ki is takzeeb aur hansi ke muqable mein apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sabr ki taleem di aur bardasht ki talqeen ki. Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki firasat. Zal-ayd se murad ilmi aur amli quwwat wala hai aur sirf quwwat wale ke ma'ani bhi hote hain jaise farman hai (Wassama'a banaynaha bi-aydin wa inna lamusi'oon) (Az-Zariyat: 47), Mujahid farmate hain murad ita'at ki taqat hai. Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ko ibadat ki qudrat aur Islam ki fiqh ata farmayi gayi thi. Ye mazkoor hai ke aap har raat tihayi raat tak tahajjud mein khade rehte the aur ek din baad ek din hamesha rozay se rehte the. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Allah ko sab se zyada pasand Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ki raat ki namaz aur unhi ke rozay the. Aap aadhi raat sote aur tihayi raat qayam karte aur chatha hissa raat ka phir so jate, aur ek din roza rakhte ek din na rakhte aur dushmanan-e-deen se jihad karne mein peeth na dikhate aur apne har haal mein Allah ki taraf raghbat-o-rujoo rakhte. Pahadon ko un ke sath musakhkhar kar diya tha. Woh aap ke sath suraj ke dhalne ke waqt aur din ke aakhri waqt tasbeeh bayan karte. Jaise farman hai (Ya jibaalu awwibi ma'ahu wattayr, wa alanna lahul hadeed) (Saba: 10) yani Allah ne pahadon ko un ke sath rujoo karne ka hukum diya tha. Isi tarah parinday bhi aap ki aawaz sun kar aap ke sath Allah ki paki bayan karne lag jate, udte hue parind paas se guzarte aur aap Taurat padhte hote to aap ke sath woh bhi tilawat mein mashghool ho jate aur udna bhool jate balkay thahar jate. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Fatah-e-Makkah wale din Zuha ke waqt Hazrat Umm-e-Hani ke ghar mein aath rakat namaz ada ki.

Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain mera khayal hai ke yeh bhi waqt-e-namaz hai jaise farman hai (Inna sakhkarnal jibala ma'ahu yusabbihna bil-ashiyyi wal-ishraq) (Surah (Sad: 18). Abdullah bin Haris bin Naufal kehte hain ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) Duha ki namaz nahin padhte thay. Ek din main unhein Hazrat Umm-e-Hani (R.A) ke yahan le gaya aur kaha ke aap in se woh hadith bayan kijiye jo aap ne mujh se bayan farmayi thi. Toh Mai Sahiba ne farmaya Fatah-e-Makkah wale din mere ghar mein mere paas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye. Phir ek bartan mein pani bharwaya aur ek kapda taan kar nahane baith gaye, phir ghar ke ek kone mein pani chhidak kar aath raka'at Salat-e-Duha ki ada keen, un ka qayam, ruku, sajdah aur juloos sab qareeb qareeb barabar thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas jab yeh sun kar wahan se nikle toh farmane lage poore Quran ko main ne padh liya, main nahin janta ke Duha ki namaz kya hai, aaj mujhe maloom hua ke (Yusabbihna bil-ashiyyi wal-ishraq) (Surah (Sad: 18) wali aayat mein bhi Ishraq se murad yahi Duha hai. Chunancha is ke baad unhon ne apne agle qaul se ruju kar liya. Jab Hazrat Dawood (A.S) Allah ki pakeezgi aur buzurgi bayan farmate toh parindey bhi hawaon mein ruk jate thay aur Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ki matahuti mein un ki tasbeeh ka sath dete thay. Aur is ki saltanat hum ne mazboot kar di aur badshahon ko jin jin cheezon ki zaroorat padti hai hum ne use sab de dein. Char hazar toh un ki muhafiz sipah thi. Is qadar fauj thi ke har raat taintis hazar fauji pehrey par chadhte thay lekin jo aaj ki raat aate phir saal bhar tak un ki bari na aati. Chalees hazar aadmi har waqt un ki khidmat mein musallah tayyar rehte. Ek riwayat mein hai ke un ke zamane mein Bani Israel ke do aadmiyon mein ek muqadma hua. Ek ne dusre par dawa kiya ke is ne meri gaye ghasab kar li hai. Dusre ne is jurm se inkar kiya. Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ne mudda'i se daleel talab ki, woh koi gawah pesh na kar saka. Aap ne farmaya achha tumhein kal faisla sunaya jayega. Raat ko Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ko khwab mein hukm hua ke daweedar ko qatl kar do. Subah aap ne dono ko bulwaya aur hukm diya ke is mudda'i ko qatl kar diya jaye. Us ne kaha ae Allah ke Nabi! Aap mere hi qatl ka hukm de rahe hain halankeh is ne meri gaye chura li hai. Aap ne farmaya yeh mera hukm nahin, yeh Allah ka faisla hai aur namumkin hai ke yeh tal jaye, toh tayyar ho ja. Tab us ne kaha ae Allah ke Rasool! Main apne dawe mein toh sacha hoon, is ne meri gaye ghasab kar li hai. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko mere qatl ka hukm mere is muqadmay ki wajah se nahin diya. Is ki wajah aur hi hai aur ise sirf main hi janta hoon. Baat yeh hai ke aaj main ne ise fareb se qatl kar diya hai jis ka kisi ko ilm nahin. Pas is ke badle mein Allah ne aap ko qisas ka hukm diya hai. Chunancha woh qatl kar diya gaya.

Ab toh Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ki haibat har shakhs ke dil mein baith gayi. Hum ne unhein hikmat di thi yani fahm-o-aql, zeraki aur danai, adl-o-firasat, Kitabullah aur us ki itteba, nabuwwat-o-risalat waghera aur jhagron ka faisla karne ka sahih tariqa. Yani gawah lena, qasam khulwana, mudda'i ke zimme baar-e-suboot dalna, mudda'i alaih se qasam lena. Yehi tariqa faislon ka Anbiya (A.S) ka aur nek logon ka raha aur yehi tariqa is ummat mein ra'ij hai. Garz Hazrat Dawood (A.S) mamle ki teh ko pahunch jate the aur haq-o-batil, sach-jhoot mein sahih aur khare ka imtiyaz kar lete the. Kalam bhi aap ka saaf hota tha aur hukm bhi adl par mabni hota tha. Aap hi ne 'Amma Ba'ad' ka kehna ijad kiya hai aur 'Fasl-ul-Khitab' se is ki taraf bhi ishara hai.))

Phir un ki tabahi ki wajah bhi bayan hui ke ye rasoolon ke dushman the, unhein jhoota kehte the. Unhein sirf soor ka intezar hai aur is mein bhi koi der nahin, bas woh ek aawaz hogi ke jis ke kaan mein padi behosh-o-bejaan ho gaya. Siwaye un ke jinhein Rabb ne mustasna kar diya hai. Qitt ke ma'ani kitab aur hisse ke hain. Mushrikeen ki bewaqoofi aur un ka azabon ko mahal samajh kar nidar ho kar azabon ke talab karne ka zikr ho raha hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ka farman hai ke jis khair-o-sharr ke woh duniya mein mustahiq the use unhon ne jald talab kiya. Yehi baat theek hai, Zahhak aur Ismail ki tafsir ka mahasil bhi yehi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne un ki is takzeeb aur hansi ke muqable mein apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sabr ki taleem di aur bardasht ki talqeen ki. Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki firasat. Zal-ayd se murad ilmi aur amli quwwat wala hai aur sirf quwwat wale ke ma'ani bhi hote hain jaise farman hai (Wassama'a banaynaha bi-aydin wa inna lamusi'oon) (Az-Zariyat: 47), Mujahid farmate hain murad ita'at ki taqat hai. Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ko ibadat ki qudrat aur Islam ki fiqh ata farmayi gayi thi. Ye mazkoor hai ke aap har raat tihayi raat tak tahajjud mein khade rehte the aur ek din baad ek din hamesha rozay se rehte the. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Allah ko sab se zyada pasand Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ki raat ki namaz aur unhi ke rozay the. Aap aadhi raat sote aur tihayi raat qayam karte aur chatha hissa raat ka phir so jate, aur ek din roza rakhte ek din na rakhte aur dushmanan-e-deen se jihad karne mein peeth na dikhate aur apne har haal mein Allah ki taraf raghbat-o-rujoo rakhte. Pahadon ko un ke sath musakhkhar kar diya tha. Woh aap ke sath suraj ke dhalne ke waqt aur din ke aakhri waqt tasbeeh bayan karte. Jaise farman hai (Ya jibaalu awwibi ma'ahu wattayr, wa alanna lahul hadeed) (Saba: 10) yani Allah ne pahadon ko un ke sath rujoo karne ka hukum diya tha. Isi tarah parinday bhi aap ki aawaz sun kar aap ke sath Allah ki paki bayan karne lag jate, udte hue parind paas se guzarte aur aap Taurat padhte hote to aap ke sath woh bhi tilawat mein mashghool ho jate aur udna bhool jate balkay thahar jate. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Fatah-e-Makkah wale din Zuha ke waqt Hazrat Umm-e-Hani ke ghar mein aath rakat namaz ada ki.

Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain mera khayal hai ke yeh bhi waqt-e-namaz hai jaise farman hai (Inna sakhkarnal jibala ma'ahu yusabbihna bil-ashiyyi wal-ishraq) (Surah (Sad: 18). Abdullah bin Haris bin Naufal kehte hain ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) Duha ki namaz nahin padhte thay. Ek din main unhein Hazrat Umm-e-Hani (R.A) ke yahan le gaya aur kaha ke aap in se woh hadith bayan kijiye jo aap ne mujh se bayan farmayi thi. Toh Mai Sahiba ne farmaya Fatah-e-Makkah wale din mere ghar mein mere paas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye. Phir ek bartan mein pani bharwaya aur ek kapda taan kar nahane baith gaye, phir ghar ke ek kone mein pani chhidak kar aath raka'at Salat-e-Duha ki ada keen, un ka qayam, ruku, sajdah aur juloos sab qareeb qareeb barabar thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas jab yeh sun kar wahan se nikle toh farmane lage poore Quran ko main ne padh liya, main nahin janta ke Duha ki namaz kya hai, aaj mujhe maloom hua ke (Yusabbihna bil-ashiyyi wal-ishraq) (Surah (Sad: 18) wali aayat mein bhi Ishraq se murad yahi Duha hai. Chunancha is ke baad unhon ne apne agle qaul se ruju kar liya. Jab Hazrat Dawood (A.S) Allah ki pakeezgi aur buzurgi bayan farmate toh parindey bhi hawaon mein ruk jate thay aur Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ki matahuti mein un ki tasbeeh ka sath dete thay. Aur is ki saltanat hum ne mazboot kar di aur badshahon ko jin jin cheezon ki zaroorat padti hai hum ne use sab de dein. Char hazar toh un ki muhafiz sipah thi. Is qadar fauj thi ke har raat taintis hazar fauji pehrey par chadhte thay lekin jo aaj ki raat aate phir saal bhar tak un ki bari na aati. Chalees hazar aadmi har waqt un ki khidmat mein musallah tayyar rehte. Ek riwayat mein hai ke un ke zamane mein Bani Israel ke do aadmiyon mein ek muqadma hua. Ek ne dusre par dawa kiya ke is ne meri gaye ghasab kar li hai. Dusre ne is jurm se inkar kiya. Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ne mudda'i se daleel talab ki, woh koi gawah pesh na kar saka. Aap ne farmaya achha tumhein kal faisla sunaya jayega. Raat ko Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ko khwab mein hukm hua ke daweedar ko qatl kar do. Subah aap ne dono ko bulwaya aur hukm diya ke is mudda'i ko qatl kar diya jaye. Us ne kaha ae Allah ke Nabi! Aap mere hi qatl ka hukm de rahe hain halankeh is ne meri gaye chura li hai. Aap ne farmaya yeh mera hukm nahin, yeh Allah ka faisla hai aur namumkin hai ke yeh tal jaye, toh tayyar ho ja. Tab us ne kaha ae Allah ke Rasool! Main apne dawe mein toh sacha hoon, is ne meri gaye ghasab kar li hai. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko mere qatl ka hukm mere is muqadmay ki wajah se nahin diya. Is ki wajah aur hi hai aur ise sirf main hi janta hoon. Baat yeh hai ke aaj main ne ise fareb se qatl kar diya hai jis ka kisi ko ilm nahin. Pas is ke badle mein Allah ne aap ko qisas ka hukm diya hai. Chunancha woh qatl kar diya gaya.

Yani gawah lena, qasam khulwana, mudda'i ke zimme baar-e-suboot dalna, mudda'i alaih se qasam lena. Yehi tariqa faislon ka Anbiya (A.S) ka aur nek logon ka raha aur yehi tariqa is ummat mein ra'ij hai. Garz Hazrat Dawood (A.S) mamle ki teh ko pahunch jate the aur haq-o-batil, sach-jhoot mein sahih aur khare ka imtiyaz kar lete the. Kalam bhi aap ka saaf hota tha aur hukm bhi adl par mabni hota tha. Yani gawah lena, qasam khulwana, mudda'i ke zimme baar-e-suboot dalna, mudda'i alaih se qasam lena. Yehi tariqa faislon ka Anbiya (A.S) ka aur nek logon ka raha aur yehi tariqa is ummat mein ra'ij hai. Garz Hazrat Dawood (A.S) mamle ki teh ko pahunch jate the aur haq-o-batil, sach-jhoot mein sahih aur khare ka imtiyaz kar lete the. Kalam bhi aap ka saaf hota tha aur hukm bhi adl par mabni hota tha. Aap hi ne 'Amma Ba'ad' ka kehna ijad kiya hai aur 'Fasl-ul-Khitab' se is ki taraf bhi ishara hai.))

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein ek hadees hai lekin woh bhi sabit nahin kyunke is ka ek rawi Yazeed Raqashi hai go woh nihayat nek shakhs hai lekin hai zaeef. Pas aula yeh hai ke Quran mein jo hai aur jis par yeh shamil hai woh haq hai. Hazrat Dawood A.S ka unhein dekh kar ghabrana is wajah se tha ke woh apne tanhai ke khaas khalwat khane mein thay aur pehra daron ko mana kiya tha ke koi bhi aaj andar na aaye aur yakayak in dono ko jo dekha to ghabra gaye. 'Azzani' al-kh, se matlab baat cheet mein ghalib aa jana dusre par chha jana hai. Hazrat Dawood A.S samajh gaye ke yeh Allah ki aazmaish hai pas woh ruku sajda karte hue Allah ki taraf jhuk pade. Mazkoor hai ke chalees din tak sajde se sar na uthaya pas hum ne use bakhsh diya. Yeh yaad rahe ke jo kaam awam ke liye nekiyon ke hote hain wohi kaam khawas ke liye baaz martaba badiyon ke ban jate hain. Yeh aayat sajde ki hai ya nahin? Is ki baat Imam Shafi R.H ka jadeed mazhab to yeh hai ke yahan sajda zaroori nahin yeh to sajda-e-shukr hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke 'Saad' zaroori sajdon mein se nahin, haan main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is mein sajda karte hue dekha hai (Bukhari waghera). Nasai mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne yahan sajda kar ke farmaya yeh sajda Hazrat Dawood A.S ka to tauba ke liye tha aur hamara shukr ke liye hai. Tirmidhi mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ne khwab mein dekha goya main ek darakht ke peeche namaz parh raha hoon aur namaz mein main ne sajde ki aayat tilawat ki aur sajda kiya to mere sath us darakht ne bhi sajda kiya aur main ne suna ke woh yeh dua maang raha tha yani Aye Allah! Mere is sajde ko tu mere liye apne paas ajar aur khazane ka sabab bana aur is se tu mera bojh halka kar de aur ise mujh se qabool farma jaise ke tu ne apne bande Dawood A.S ke sajde ko qabool farmaya. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain main ne dekha ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne khade ho kar namaz ada ki aur sajde ki aayat ko parh kar sajda kiya aur is sajde mein wohi dua parhi jo us shakhs ne darakht ki dua naqal ki thi. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A is aayat ke sajde par yeh daleel warid karte thay ke Quran ne farmaya hai is ki aulad mein se Dawood, Sulaiman hain jinhein hum ne hidayat ki thi pas tu aye Nabi ﷺ in ki hidayat ki pairwi kar, pas Huzoor ﷺ in ki iqtida ke mamoor thay aur yeh saaf sabit hai ke Hazrat Dawood A.S ne sajda kiya aur Huzoor ﷺ ne bhi yeh sajda kiya. Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ka bayan hai ke main ne khwab mein dekha goya main Surah Saad likh raha hoon jab aayat-e-sajda tak pahuncha to main ne dekha ke qalam aur dawaat aur mere aas paas ki tamam cheezon ne sajda kiya.

Unhon ne apna yeh khwab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bayan kiya phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ki tilawat ke waqt barabar sajda karte rahe (Ahmed). Abu Dawood mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par Surah Saad parhi aur sajde ki aayat tak pahunch kar mimbar se utar kar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sajda tak pahunche toh logon ne sajde ki tayyari ki. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh toh ek Nabi ki tauba ka sajda tha lekin main dekhta hoon ke tum sajda karne ke liye tayyar ho gaye ho, chunancha Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) utre aur sajda kiya. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai hum ne use bakhsh diya. Qayamat ke din us ki bari manzilat aur qadr hogi, Nabiyon aur aadilon ka darja woh payenge. Hadith mein hai aadil log noor ke mimbaron par Rahman ke dayen janib honge. Allah ke dono haath dayen hain. Yeh aadil woh hain jo apne ahl-o-ayal mein aur jin ke woh maalik hon adl-o-insaf karte hain. Aur hadith mein hai sab se zyada Allah ke dost aur sab se zyada us ke muqarrab woh badshah honge jo aadil hon aur sab se zyada dushman aur sab se sakht azaab wale woh honge jo zalim badshah hon (Tirmidhi waghera). Hazrat Malik bin Dinar farmate hain Qayamat ke din Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko Arsh ke paye ke paas khara kiya jayega aur Allah Ta'ala hukum dega ke aye Dawood jis pyari, dardnaak, meethi aur jaazib aawaz se tum meri tareefein duniya mein karte the ab bhi karo. Aap (A.S / Alaihis Salam) farmayenge Bari Ta'ala ab woh aawaz kahan rahi? Allah farmayega main ne wahi aawaz aaj tumhein phir ata farmayi. Ab Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) apni dilkash aur dilruba aawaz nikal kar nihayat wajd ki halat mein Allah ki hamd-o-sana bayan karenge jise sun kar jannati aur nematon ko bhi bhool jayenge aur yeh surili aawaz aur noorani gala unhein sab nematon se hata kar apni taraf mutawajja karega.

Hazrat Dawood A.S ka unhein dekh kar ghabrana is wajah se tha ke woh apne tanhai ke khaas khalwat khane mein thay aur pehra daron ko mana kiya tha ke koi bhi aaj andar na aaye aur yakayak in dono ko jo dekha to ghabra gaye. 'Azzani' al-kh, se matlab baat cheet mein ghalib aa jana dusre par chha jana hai. Hazrat Dawood A.S samajh gaye ke yeh Allah ki aazmaish hai pas woh ruku sajda karte hue Allah ki taraf jhuk pade. Mazkoor hai ke chalees din tak sajde se sar na uthaya pas hum ne use bakhsh diya. Yeh yaad rahe ke jo kaam awam ke liye nekiyon ke hote hain wohi kaam khawas ke liye baaz martaba badiyon ke ban jate hain. Yeh aayat sajde ki hai ya nahin? Is ki baat Imam Shafi R.H ka jadeed mazhab to yeh hai ke yahan sajda zaroori nahin yeh to sajda-e-shukr hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke 'Saad' zaroori sajdon mein se nahin, haan main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is mein sajda karte hue dekha hai (Bukhari waghera). Nasai mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne yahan sajda kar ke farmaya yeh sajda Hazrat Dawood A.S ka to tauba ke liye tha aur hamara shukr ke liye hai. Tirmidhi mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ne khwab mein dekha goya main ek darakht ke peeche namaz parh raha hoon aur namaz mein main ne sajde ki aayat tilawat ki aur sajda kiya to mere sath us darakht ne bhi sajda kiya aur main ne suna ke woh yeh dua maang raha tha yani Aye Allah! Mere is sajde ko tu mere liye apne paas ajar aur khazane ka sabab bana aur is se tu mera bojh halka kar de aur ise mujh se qabool farma jaise ke tu ne apne bande Dawood A.S ke sajde ko qabool farmaya. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain main ne dekha ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne khade ho kar namaz ada ki aur sajde ki aayat ko parh kar sajda kiya aur is sajde mein wohi dua parhi jo us shakhs ne darakht ki dua naqal ki thi. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A is aayat ke sajde par yeh daleel warid karte thay ke Quran ne farmaya hai is ki aulad mein se Dawood, Sulaiman hain jinhein hum ne hidayat ki thi pas tu aye Nabi ﷺ in ki hidayat ki pairwi kar, pas Huzoor ﷺ in ki iqtida ke mamoor thay aur yeh saaf sabit hai ke Hazrat Dawood A.S ne sajda kiya aur Huzoor ﷺ ne bhi yeh sajda kiya. Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ka bayan hai ke main ne khwab mein dekha goya main Surah Saad likh raha hoon jab aayat-e-sajda tak pahuncha to main ne dekha ke qalam aur dawaat aur mere aas paas ki tamam cheezon ne sajda kiya.

Unhon ne apna yeh khwab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bayan kiya phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ki tilawat ke waqt barabar sajda karte rahe (Ahmed). Abu Dawood mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par Surah Saad parhi aur sajde ki aayat tak pahunch kar mimbar se utar kar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sajda tak pahunche toh logon ne sajde ki tayyari ki. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh toh ek Nabi ki tauba ka sajda tha lekin main dekhta hoon ke tum sajda karne ke liye tayyar ho gaye ho, chunancha Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) utre aur sajda kiya. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai hum ne use bakhsh diya. Qayamat ke din us ki bari manzilat aur qadr hogi, Nabiyon aur aadilon ka darja woh payenge. Hadith mein hai aadil log noor ke mimbaron par Rahman ke dayen janib honge. Allah ke dono haath dayen hain. Yeh aadil woh hain jo apne ahl-o-ayal mein aur jin ke woh maalik hon adl-o-insaf karte hain. Aur hadith mein hai sab se zyada Allah ke dost aur sab se zyada us ke muqarrab woh badshah honge jo aadil hon aur sab se zyada dushman aur sab se sakht azaab wale woh honge jo zalim badshah hon (Tirmidhi waghera). Hazrat Malik bin Dinar farmate hain Qayamat ke din Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko Arsh ke paye ke paas khara kiya jayega aur Allah Ta'ala hukum dega ke aye Dawood jis pyari, dardnaak, meethi aur jaazib aawaz se tum meri tareefein duniya mein karte the ab bhi karo. Aap (A.S / Alaihis Salam) farmayenge Bari Ta'ala ab woh aawaz kahan rahi? Allah farmayega main ne wahi aawaz aaj tumhein phir ata farmayi. Ab Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) apni dilkash aur dilruba aawaz nikal kar nihayat wajd ki halat mein Allah ki hamd-o-sana bayan karenge jise sun kar jannati aur nematon ko bhi bhool jayenge aur yeh surili aawaz aur noorani gala unhein sab nematon se hata kar apni taraf mutawajja karega.

Sahib-e-Ikhtiyar logon ke liye insaaf ka hukum. Is aayat mein baadshah aur zi-ikhtiyar logon ko hukum ho raha hai ke woh adl-o-insaaf ke sath Quran-o-Hadith ke mutabiq faislay karein warna Allah ki raah se bhatak jayenge aur jo bhatak kar apne hisab ke din ko bhool jaye woh sakht azabon mein mubtala hoga. Hazrat Abu Zur'ah (R.H) se baadshah-e-waqt Waleed bin Abdul Malik ne ek martaba daryaft kiya ke kya Khalifa-e-waqt se bhi Allah Ta'ala ke haan hisab liya jayega? Aap ne farmaya sach bata doon? Khalifa ne kaha zaroor sach hi batao aur aap ko har tarah aman hai. Farmaya ae Ameer-ul-Momineen Allah ke nazdeek aap se bahut bada darja Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ka tha unhein khilafat ke sath hi sath Allah Ta'ala ne nabuwat bhi de rakhi thi lekin is ke bawajood Kitabullah un se kehti hai (Ya Dawoodu Inna Ja'alnaka Khalifatan Fil-Ardi Fahkum Bainan-Nasi Bil-Haqqi Wala Tattabi'il-Hawa Fayudillaka 'An Sabeelillahi Innallazeena Yadilluna 'An Sabeelillahi Lahum 'Azabun Shadeedum Bima Nasu Yawmal-Hisab) (Surah (Sad: 26). Ikrimah farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke un ke liye Yawm-ul-Hisab ko sakht azab hain is ke bhool jaane ke ba'is. Suddi kehte hain un ke liye sakht azab hain is wajah se ke unhon ne Yawm-ul-Hisab ke liye a'maal jama nahin kiye. Aayat ke lafzon se isi qaul ko zyada munasibat hai wallahu Ta'ala A'lam.)

Irshad hai ke makhlooq ki paidaish abas aur bekar nahin, yeh sab ibadat-e-Khaliq ke liye paida ki gayi hai, phir ek waqt aane wala hai ke manne wale ki sarbulandi ki jaye aur na manne walon ko sakht saza di jaye. Kafiron ka khayal hai ke hum ne unhein yunhi paida kar diya hai? Aur aakhirat aur dusri zindagi koi cheez nahin, yeh ghalat hai. In kafiron ko Qayamat ke din badi kharabi hogi kyunke us aag mein unhein jalna padega jo un ke liye Allah ke farishton ne bhadka rakhi hai. Yeh namumkin hai aur anhoni baat hai ke momin-o-mufsid ko aur parhezgar aur badkar ko ek jaisa kar dein. Agar Qayamat aane wali hi na ho to yeh dono anjam ke lihaz se yaksan hi rahe, halanke yeh khilaf-e-insaf hai, Qayamat zaroor aayegi, nek-kar Jannat mein aur gunahgar Jahannam mein jayenge. Pas aqli iqtiza bhi dar-e-aakhirat ke suboot ko hi chahta hai. Hum dekhte hain ke ek zalim papi Allah ki dargah se randa hua duniya mein khush-waqt hai, maal, aulad, faraghat, tandurusti sab kuch us ke paas hai aur ek momin muttaqi pak-daman ek ek paise se tang, ek ek rahat se door rahe, to hikmat-e-Aleem-o-Hakeem-o-Aadil ka iqtiza yeh tha ke koi aisa waqt bhi aaye ke us namak-haram se us ki namak-harami ka badla liya jaye aur is sabir-o-shakir farmanbardar ki nekiyon ka use badla diya jaye aur yahi dar-e-aakhirat mein hona hai. Pas sabit hua ke is jahan ke baad ek jahan yaqeenan hai. Chunke yeh pak taleem Quran se hi hasil hui hai aur is neki ka rahbar yahi hai, isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke yeh mubarak kitab hum ne teri taraf nazil farmayi hai taake log ise samjhein aur zi-aql log is se nasihat hasil kar sakein. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain, jis ne Quran ke alfaaz hifz kar liye aur Quran par amal nahin kiya us ne Quran mein tadabbur-o-ghaur bhi nahin kiya. Log kehte hain hum ne poora Quran padh liya lekin Quran ki ek nasihat ya Quran ke ek hukum ka namuna mein nazar nahin aata, aisa na chahiye. Asal ghaur-o-khooz aur nasihat-o-ibrat amal hai.

Hazrat Sulaiman Hazrat Dawood ke waris. Allah Ta'ala ne jo ek badi nemat Hazrat Dawood A.S ko ata farmayi thi us ka zikr farma raha hai ke un ki nabuwat ka waris un ke ladke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko bana diya. Isi liye sirf Hazrat Sulaiman ka zikr kiya warna un ke aur bache bhi thay. Ek sau auratein aap ki londiyon ke alawa thin. Chunancha aur ayat mein hai (WA WARITHA SULAIMANU DAWUDA WA QALA YA AYYUHAN-NASU 'ULLIMNA MANTIQAT-TAIRI WA UTEENA MIN KULLI SHAI'IN INNA HAZA LAHUWAL FADLUL MUBEEN 16) (An-Naml: 16) yani Hazrat Dawood ke waris Hazrat Sulaiman huye yani nabuwat aap ke baad unhein mili. Yeh bhi bade achhe bande thay yani khoob ibadat guzar thay aur Allah ki taraf jhukne wale thay. Makhool kehte hain ke janab Dawood Nabi ne ek martaba aap se chand sawalat kiye aur un ke maqool jawabat pa kar farmaya ke aap Nabi-ullah hain. Poocha ke sab se achhi cheez kya hai? Jawab diya ke Allah ki taraf sakeenat aur iman. Poocha ke sab se zyada meethi cheez kya hai? Jawab mila Allah ki rahmat. Poocha sab se zyada thandak wali cheez kya hai? Jawab diya Allah ka logon se darguzar karna aur logon ka aapas mein ek dusre ko maaf kar dena (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke samne un ki badshahat ke zamane mein un ke ghode pesh kiye gaye. Yeh bahut tez raftar thay jo teen tangon par khade rehte thay aur ek pair yunhi sa zameen par tikta tha. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yeh par-dar ghode thay, tadaad mein bees thay. Ibrahim Tamimi ne ghodon ki tadaad bees hazar batlayi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Abu Dawood mein hai Huzoor ﷺ Tabuk ya Khyber ke safar se wapas aaye thay, ghar mein tashreef farma thay jab tez hawa ke jhonke se ghar ke kone ka parda hat gaya, wahan Hazrat Aisha R.A ki khelne ki gudiya rakhi hui thin. Huzoor ﷺ ki nazar bhi pad gayi. Daryaft kiya yeh kya hai? Hazrat Aisha R.A ne jawab diya meri gudiya hain. Aap ne dekha ke beech mein ek ghoda sa bana hua hai jis ke do par bhi kapde ke lage huye hain. Poocha yeh kya hai? Kaha ghoda hai. Farmaya aur yeh is ke upar dono taraf kapde ke kya bane huye hain? Kaha yeh dono is ke par hain. Farmaya achha ghoda aur is ke par bhi? Siddiqa ne arz kiya kya aap ne nahin suna ke Hazrat Sulaiman ke par-dar ghode thay, yeh sun kar Huzoor ﷺ hans diye yahan tak ke aap ke aakhri daant dikhayi dene lage. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S un ke dekhne bhalne mein is qadar mashghool ho gaye ke Asr ki namaz ka khayal hi na raha, bilkul bhool gaye. Jaise ke Huzoor ﷺ jang-e-Khandaq wale din ladayi ki mashghuliyat ki wajah se Asr ki namaz na padh sake thay aur Maghrib ke baad ada ki. Chunancha Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke suraj doobne ke baad Hazrat Umar R.A kuffar-e-Quraish ko bura kehte huye Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor ﷺ main to Asr ki namaz bhi na padh saka. Aap ne farmaya main bhi ab tak ada nahin kar saka. Chunancha hum Bathaan mein gaye wahan wuzu kiya aur suraj ke ghuroob hone ke baad Asr ki namaz ada ki aur phir Maghrib padhi.

Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Deen-e-Sulaiman mein jangi masaleh ki wajah se takheer-e-namaz jaiz ho aur yeh jangi ghore thay jinhein isi maqsad se rakha tha. Chunancha baaz ulama ne yeh kaha bhi hai ke salat-e-khauf ke jaari hone se pehle yahi haal tha. Baaz kehte hain jab talwarein tani hui hon, lashkar bhar gaye hon aur namaz ke liye ruku-o-sujud ka imkan hi na ho tab yeh hukm hai jaise sahaba (R.A) ne Tustar ki fatah ke baad mauqa par kiya tha lekin hamara pehla qaul hi theek hai is liye ke is ke baad hi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ka un ghoron ko dobara talab karna waghera bayan hua hai. Unhein wapas mangwa kar un ke kaat dalne ka hukm diya aur farmaya mere Rabb ki ibadat se mujhe is cheez ne ghafil kar diya, main aisi cheez hi nahin rakhne ka. Chunancha un ki kochein kaat di gayin aur un ki gardanein mari gayin. Lekin Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke aap ne ghoron ke peshani ke baalon waghera par haath phera. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi isi qaul ko ikhtiyar karte hain ke bila wajah janwaron ko eeza pahunchani mamnoo hai, un janwaron ka koi qasoor na tha jo unhein katwa dete lekin main kehta hoon ke mumkin hai yeh baat un ki shar' mein jaiz ho, khusoosan aise waqt jabke woh yaad-e-Allah mein harij hue aur waqt-e-namaz nikal gaya to darasal yeh gussa bhi Allah ke liye tha. Chunancha isi wajah se un ghoron se bhi tez aur halki cheez Allah ne apne Nabi ko ata farmayi yani hawa un ke tabe kar di. Hazrat Abu Qatada (R.A) aur Hazrat Abu Dahma aksar hajj kiya karte thay, un ka bayan hai ke ek martaba ek gaon mein hamari ek badwi se mulaqat hui, us ne kaha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne mera haath tham kar mujhe bahut kuch deeni taleem di, is mein yeh bhi farmaya ke Allah se dar kar tu jis cheez ko chorega Allah tujhe us se behtar ata farmayega.

Baaz kehte hain jab talwarein tani hui hon, lashkar bhar gaye hon aur namaz ke liye ruku-o-sujud ka imkan hi na ho tab yeh hukm hai jaise sahaba (R.A) ne Tustar ki fatah ke baad mauqa par kiya tha lekin hamara pehla qaul hi theek hai is liye ke is ke baad hi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ka un ghoron ko dobara talab karna waghera bayan hua hai. Unhein wapas mangwa kar un ke kaat dalne ka hukm diya aur farmaya mere Rabb ki ibadat se mujhe is cheez ne ghafil kar diya, main aisi cheez hi nahin rakhne ka. Chunancha un ki kochein kaat di gayin aur un ki gardanein mari gayin. Lekin Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke aap ne ghoron ke peshani ke baalon waghera par haath phera. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi isi qaul ko ikhtiyar karte hain ke bila wajah janwaron ko eeza pahunchani mamnoo hai, un janwaron ka koi qasoor na tha jo unhein katwa dete lekin main kehta hoon ke mumkin hai yeh baat un ki shar' mein jaiz ho, khusoosan aise waqt jabke woh yaad-e-Allah mein harij hue aur waqt-e-namaz nikal gaya to darasal yeh gussa bhi Allah ke liye tha. Chunancha isi wajah se un ghoron se bhi tez aur halki cheez Allah ne apne Nabi ko ata farmayi yani hawa un ke tabe kar di. Hazrat Abu Qatada (R.A) aur Hazrat Abu Dahma aksar hajj kiya karte thay, un ka bayan hai ke ek martaba ek gaon mein hamari ek badwi se mulaqat hui, us ne kaha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne mera haath tham kar mujhe bahut kuch deeni taleem di, is mein yeh bhi farmaya ke Allah se dar kar tu jis cheez ko chorega Allah tujhe us se behtar ata farmayega.

Hazrat Sulaiman Hazrat Dawood ke waris. Allah Ta'ala ne jo ek badi nemat Hazrat Dawood A.S ko ata farmayi thi us ka zikr farma raha hai ke un ki nabuwat ka waris un ke ladke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko bana diya. Isi liye sirf Hazrat Sulaiman ka zikr kiya warna un ke aur bache bhi thay. Ek sau auratein aap ki londiyon ke alawa thin. Chunancha aur ayat mein hai (WA WARITHA SULAIMANU DAWUDA WA QALA YA AYYUHAN-NASU 'ULLIMNA MANTIQAT-TAIRI WA UTEENA MIN KULLI SHAI'IN INNA HAZA LAHUWAL FADLUL MUBEEN 16) (An-Naml: 16) yani Hazrat Dawood ke waris Hazrat Sulaiman huye yani nabuwat aap ke baad unhein mili. Yeh bhi bade achhe bande thay yani khoob ibadat guzar thay aur Allah ki taraf jhukne wale thay. Makhool kehte hain ke janab Dawood Nabi ne ek martaba aap se chand sawalat kiye aur un ke maqool jawabat pa kar farmaya ke aap Nabi-ullah hain. Poocha ke sab se achhi cheez kya hai? Jawab diya ke Allah ki taraf sakeenat aur iman. Poocha ke sab se zyada meethi cheez kya hai? Jawab mila Allah ki rahmat. Poocha sab se zyada thandak wali cheez kya hai? Jawab diya Allah ka logon se darguzar karna aur logon ka aapas mein ek dusre ko maaf kar dena (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke samne un ki badshahat ke zamane mein un ke ghode pesh kiye gaye. Yeh bahut tez raftar thay jo teen tangon par khade rehte thay aur ek pair yunhi sa zameen par tikta tha. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yeh par-dar ghode thay, tadaad mein bees thay. Ibrahim Tamimi ne ghodon ki tadaad bees hazar batlayi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Abu Dawood mein hai Huzoor ﷺ Tabuk ya Khyber ke safar se wapas aaye thay, ghar mein tashreef farma thay jab tez hawa ke jhonke se ghar ke kone ka parda hat gaya, wahan Hazrat Aisha R.A ki khelne ki gudiya rakhi hui thin. Huzoor ﷺ ki nazar bhi pad gayi. Daryaft kiya yeh kya hai? Hazrat Aisha R.A ne jawab diya meri gudiya hain. Aap ne dekha ke beech mein ek ghoda sa bana hua hai jis ke do par bhi kapde ke lage huye hain. Poocha yeh kya hai? Kaha ghoda hai. Farmaya aur yeh is ke upar dono taraf kapde ke kya bane huye hain? Kaha yeh dono is ke par hain. Farmaya achha ghoda aur is ke par bhi? Siddiqa ne arz kiya kya aap ne nahin suna ke Hazrat Sulaiman ke par-dar ghode thay, yeh sun kar Huzoor ﷺ hans diye yahan tak ke aap ke aakhri daant dikhayi dene lage. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S un ke dekhne bhalne mein is qadar mashghool ho gaye ke Asr ki namaz ka khayal hi na raha, bilkul bhool gaye. Jaise ke Huzoor ﷺ jang-e-Khandaq wale din ladayi ki mashghuliyat ki wajah se Asr ki namaz na padh sake thay aur Maghrib ke baad ada ki. Chunancha Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke suraj doobne ke baad Hazrat Umar R.A kuffar-e-Quraish ko bura kehte huye Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor ﷺ main to Asr ki namaz bhi na padh saka. Aap ne farmaya main bhi ab tak ada nahin kar saka. Chunancha hum Bathaan mein gaye wahan wuzu kiya aur suraj ke ghuroob hone ke baad Asr ki namaz ada ki aur phir Maghrib padhi.

Sulaiman A.S ka tafseeli tazkira. Hum ne Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka imtehan liya aur un ki kursi par ek jism daal diya, yani shaitan phir woh apne takht-o-taj ki taraf laut aaye. Is shaitan ka naam Sakhr tha ya Asif tha ya Saro tha ya Haqeeq tha. Yeh waqea aksar mufassireen ne zikr kiya hai, kisi ne tafseel ke sath, kisi ne ikhtisar ke sath. Hazrat Qatada R.A is waqea ko is tarah bayan karte hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki tameer ka is tarah hukum hua ke lohay ki aawaz bhi na suni jaye. Aap ne har chand tadbeerein keen, lekin kargar na huin. Phir aap ne suna ke samundar mein ek shaitan hai jis ka naam Sakhr hai, woh albatta aisi tarkeeb bata sakta hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke ise kisi tarah lao. Ek darya samundar mein milta tha, har saatwein din is mein labalab pani aa jata tha aur yahi pani yeh shaitan peeta tha. Is ka pani nikal diya gaya aur bilkul khali kar ke pani ko band kar ke is ke aane wale din ise sharab se pur kar diya gaya. Jab shaitan aaya aur yeh haal dekha to kehne laga yeh to mazay ki cheez hai lekin aql ki dushman jahalat ko taraqqi dene wali cheez hai. Chunancha woh pyasa hi chala gaya. Jab pyas ki shiddat hui to majbooran yeh sab kuch kehte hue peena hi para. Ab aql jati rahi aur ise Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki angoothi dikhayi gayi ya mondhon ke darmiyan se mohar laga di gayi. Yeh bebas ho gaya. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki hukumat isi angoothi ki wajah se thi. Jab yeh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas pohancha to aap ne ise yeh kaam sar-anjaam dene ka hukum diya. Yeh hudhud ke anday le aaya aur unhein jama kar ke un par sheesha rakh diya. Hudhud aaya, us ne apne anday dekhe, charon taraf ghooma lekin dekha ke hath nahin aa sakte, ur kar wapas chala gaya aur almas le aaya aur ise us sheeshay par rakh kar sheeshay ko kaatna shuru kar diya. Aakhir woh kat gaya aur hudhud apne anday le gaya aur is almas ko bhi le liya gaya aur isi se patthar kaat kaat kar imarat shuru hui. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S jab bait-ul-khala mein ya hammam mein jate to angoothi utaar jate. Ek din hammam mein jana tha aur yeh shaitan aap ke sath tha, aap us waqt farzi ghusal ke liye ja rahe thay, angoothi isi ko sonp di aur chale gaye. Us ne angoothi samundar mein phenk di aur shaitan par Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki shakal daal di gayi aur aap se takht-o-taj chhin gaya. Sab cheezon par shaitan ne qabza kar liya siwaye aap ki biwiyon ke. Ab is se bohat si ghair-maroof baatein zuhoor mein aane lageen. Is zamana mein ek sahib thay jo aise hi thay jaise Huzoor ﷺ ke zamana mein Hazrat Farooq R.A. Us ne kaha aazmaish karni chahiye, mujhe to yeh shakhs Sulaiman maloom nahin hota. Chunancha ek roz us ne kaha kyun janab! Agar koi shakhs raat ko junubi ho jaye aur mausam zara thanda ho aur woh suraj tulu hone tak ghusal na kare to koi harj to nahin? Us ne kaha hargiz nahin. Chalees din tak yeh takht-e-Sulaiman par raha, phir aap ki machli ke pait se angoothi mil gayi, hath mein daalte hi phir tamam cheezein aap ki muti ho gayin. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai.

Suddi farmate hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki ek sau biwiyan thin, aap ko sab se zyada aitbar un mein se ek biwi par tha jin ka naam Jarawah tha. Jab janabi hone ya pakhane jate to apni angoothi unhi ko sonp jate. Ek martaba aap pakhane gaye, peeche se ek shaitan aap hi ki surat bana kar aaya aur biwi sahiba se angoothi talab ki, aap ne de di. Yeh aate hi takht par baith gaya. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S aaye aur angoothi talab ki to biwi sahiba ne farmaya, aap angoothi to le gaye. Aap samajh gaye ke yeh Allah ki aazmaish hai, nihayat pareshan haal se mahal se nikal gaye. Is shaitan ne chalees din tak hukumat ki, lekin ahkam ki tabdeeli ko dekh kar ulama ne samajh liya ke yeh Sulaiman A.S nahin. Chunancha un ki jamaat aap ki biwiyon ke paas aayi aur un se kaha, yeh kya mamla hai? Hamein Sulaiman A.S ki zaat mein shak pad gaya. Agar yeh sach-much Sulaiman A.S hai to is ki aql jaati rahi hai ya yeh ke yeh Sulaiman A.S hi nahin, warna aise khilaf-e-shara ahkam na deta. Auratein yeh sun kar rone lagin. Yeh yahan se wapas aa gaye aur takht ke gird-o-pesh use gher kar baith gaye aur Taurat khol kar us ki tilawat shuru kar di. Yeh khabeeth shaitan Kalam-e-Allah se bhaga aur angoothi samundar mein phenk di jise ek machhli nigal gayi. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S yunhi apne din guzarte the, ek martaba samundar ke kinare nikal gaye, bhook bahut lagi hui thi. Mahi-geeron ko machhliyan pakadte hue dekh kar un ke paas aa kar un se ek machhli mangi aur apna naam bhi bataya. Is par baaz logon ko bada taish aaya ke dekho bheek mangne wala apne tayin Sulaiman A.S batata hai, unhon ne aap ko marna peetna shuru kiya, aap zakhmi ho kar kinare ja kar apne zakhm ka khoon dhone lage. Baaz mahi-geeron ko reham aa gaya ke ek sail ko khwah-makhwah mara, jao bhai ise do machhliyan de aao, bhooka hai bhun khaye ga. Chunancha woh machhliyan aap ko de aaye, bhook ki wajah se aap apne zakhm ko aur khoon ko to bhool gaye aur jaldi se machhli ka pait chaak karne baith gaye. Qudrat-e-Allah se us ke pait se woh angoothi nikli, aap ne Allah ki tareef bayan ki aur angoothi ungli mein daali. Us waqt parindon ne aa kar aap par saya kar liya aur logon ne aap ko pehchan liya aur aap se mazrat karne lage. Aap ne farmaya yeh sab Amr-e-Ilahi tha, Allah ki taraf se ek imtihan tha. Aap aaye apne takht par baith gaye aur hukum diya ke is shaitan ko jahan bhi woh ho giraftar kar lao, chunancha use qaid kar liya gaya. Aap ne use ek lohay ke sandook mein band kiya aur qufl laga kar us par apni mohar laga di aur samundar mein phenkwa diya jo Qayamat tak wahin qaid rahe ga. Is ka naam Haqeeq tha. Aap ki yeh dua ke mujhe aisa mulk ata farmaya jaye jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho, yeh bhi poori hui aur aap ke tabe hawayein kar di gayin. Mujahid se marwi hai ke ek shaitan se jis ka naam Asif tha, ek martaba Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne poocha ke tum logon ko kis tarah fitne mein dalte ho?

Usne kaha zara mujhe angoothi dikhao main abhi aap ko dikha deta hoon, aap ne angoothi de di, usne use samundar mein phenk diya, takht-o-taj ka malik ban baitha aur aap ke libas mein logon ko rah-e-Allah se hatane laga. "Yaad rahe ke yeh sab waqiyat Bani Israel ke bayan karda hain" aur in sab se zyada munkar waqia woh hai jo Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai jiska oopar bayan hua, jismein aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Jarawah ka zikr hai. Ismein yeh bhi hai ke aakhir nabuwat yahan tak pahunchi thi ke ladke aap ko patthar maarte the. Aap ki biwiyon se jab ulama ne mamla ki tafteesh ki to unhon ne kaha ke haan hamein bhi iske Suleman hone se inkar hai kyunke woh halat-e-haiz mein hamare paas aata hai. Shaitan ko jab yeh maloom ho gaya ke raaz khul gaya hai to usne jadoo aur kufr ki kitabein likhwa kar kursi tale dafan kar diya aur phir logon ke samne unhein nikalwa kar unse kaha dekho in kitabon ki badaulat Suleman tum par hukumat kar raha tha, chunancha logon ne aap ko kafir kehna shuru kar diya. Hazrat Suleman samundar ke kinare mazdoori karte the, ek martaba ek shakhs ne bahut si machliyan khareedein, mazdoor ko bulaya, aap pahunche, usne kaha yeh utha lo, poocha mazdoori kya doge? Usne kaha ismein se ek machli tumhein de doonga, aap ne tokra sar par rakha, uske haan pahunchaya, usne ek machli de di, aap ne uska pait chaak kiya, pait chaak karte hi woh angoothi nikal padi, pehante hi kul shayateen, jinn, insaan phir tabe ho gaye aur jhurmat baandh kar hazir ho gaye, aap ne mulk par qabza kiya aur us shaitan ko sakht saza di. Pas "Summa Anab" se murad shaitan jo musallat kiya gaya tha uska lautna hai. Iski asnaad Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas tak hai. Hai to qawi lekin yeh zahir hai ke ise Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne Ahl-e-Kitab se liya hai, yeh bhi us waqt jab ise Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul maan lein. Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek jamaat Hazrat Suleman ko nahin manti thi to ajab nahin ke yeh behooda qissa usi khabeeth jamaat ka gadha hua ho. Ismein to woh cheezein bhi hain jo bilkul hi munkar hain, khusoosan us shaitan ka aap ki aurton ke paas jana aur aimma ne bhi aise hi qisse bayan to kiye hain lekin is baat ka sab ne inkar kiya hai aur kaha hai ke jinn unke paas nahin ja saka aur Nabi ke gharane ki aurton ki ismat-o-sharafat ka taqaza bhi yahi hai aur bhi bahut se logon ne in waqiyat ko bahut tafseel se bayan kiya hai lekin sab ki asal yahi hai ke woh Bani Israel aur Ahl-e-Kitab se liye gaye hain. Wallahu A'lam. Shaibani farmate hain aap ne apni angoothi Asqalan mein payi thi aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak tawazan aap paidal chale the. Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne sifat-e-Suleman mein Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar se ek ajeeb khabar riwayat ki hai. Abu Ishaq Misri kehte hain ke jab (اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ) (89).

(Al-Fajr: 7) ke qissay se Hazrat Ka'ab ne faraghat hasil ki toh Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne kaha Abu Ishaq aap Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki kursi ka zikr bhi kijiye. Farmaya ke woh hathi daant ki thi aur yaqoot, zabarjad aur lulu se murassa thi aur us ke charon taraf sonay ke khajoor ke darakht banay huay thay jin ke khushay bhi motiyon ke thay. Un mein se jo dayin janib thay un ke siray par sonay ke mor thay aur bayin taraf walon par sonay ke gidh thay. Is kursi ke pehlay darjay par dayin janib sonay ke do darakht sanobar ke thay aur bayin janib sonay ke do sher banay huay thay. Un ke siron par zabarjad ke do sutoon thay aur kursi ke donon janib angoor ki sunheri belein thin jo kursi ko dhanpay huay thin, us ke khushay bhi surkh moti ke thay. Phir kursi ke aala darjay par do sher bohat baray sonay ke banay huay thay jin ke andar khol tha, un mein mushk-o-ambar bhara rehta tha. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) kursi par aatay toh yeh sher harkat karte aur un ke ghoomnay se un ke andar se mushk-o-ambar charon taraf chhirak diya jata. Phir do mimbar sonay ke bichha diye jatay, ek aap ke wazeer ka aur ek us waqt ke sab se baray aalim ka. Phir kursi ke samnay sattar mimbar sonay ke aur bichhaye jatay jin par Bani Israel ke qazi, un ke ulama aur un ke sardar baithtay. Un ke peechay paintis mimbar sonay ke aur hotay thay jo khali raha kartay thay. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) jab tashreef laatay, pehlay zeenay par qadam rakhtay hi kursi un tamam cheezon samet ghoom jati, sher apna dayna qadam aagay barha deta aur gidh apna bayan par phaila deta. Jab doosray darjay par qadam rakhtay toh sher apna bayan paon phaila deta aur gidh apna dayan par. Jab aap teesray darjay par charh jatay aur kursi par baith jatay toh ek bara gidh aap ka taaj le kar aap ke sar par rakhta, phir kursi zor zor se ghoomti. Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne poocha aakhir is ki kya wajah? Farmaya woh ek sonay ki laat par thi jisay Sakhr Jinn ne banaya tha. Us ke ghoomtay hi neechay walay mor, gidh waghera sab oopar aa jatay aur sar jhukatay, par pharpharate jis se aap ke jism par mushk-o-ambar ka chhirkao ho jata. Phir ek sonay ka kabootar Taurat utha kar aap ke haath mein deta jisay aap tilawat farmatay. Lekin yeh riwayat bilkul ghareeb hai.
