Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki dua ka matlab yeh hai ke mujhe aisa mulk de ke mujh se koi aur chheen na sakay jaise ke us jism ka waqea hua jo aap ki kursi par daal diya gaya tha. Yeh matlab nahin ke aap doosron ke liye aisay mulk ke na milnay ki dua kartay hon. Lekin jin ba'az logon ne yeh ma'ani liye hain woh kuch theek nazar nahin aatay, balkay sahih matlab yahi hai ke aap ki dua ka yahi matlab tha ke mujhe aisa mulk aur saltanat di jaye ke mere baad phir kisi aur shakhs ko aisi saltanat na milay. Yahi aayat ke alfaaz se maloom hota hai aur yahi ahadees se bhi sabit hota hai.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba farmaya ek sarkash jinn ne guzashta shab mujh par zyadati ki aur meri namaz bigad dena chahi lekin Allah ne mujhe us par qabu de diya aur main ne chaha ke use masjid ke us sutoon se bandh doon taake subah tum sab use dekho lekin usi waqt mujhe mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki dua yaad aa gayi. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Rooh farmate hain phir Huzoor ﷺ ne use zaleel-o-khwar kar ke chhod diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ namaz mein khade hue to hum ne suna ke aap ne farmaya A'uzu billahi minka phir aap ne teen baar farmaya Al'anuka bi la'natillah phir aap ne apna haath is tarah badhaya ke goya aap kisi cheez ko lena chahte hain. Jab farigh hue to hum ne aap se in dono baaton ki wajah poochhi aap ne farmaya Allah ka dushman Iblees aag lekar mere munh mein daalne ke liye aaya to main ne teen martaba A'uzu padhi phir teen martaba us par la'nat bheji lekin woh phir bhi na hata phir main ne chaha ke use pakad kar bandh doon taake Madine ke ladke us se khelein agar hamare bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to main yahi karta. Hazrat Ata bin Yazeed Laithi namaz padh rahe the jo Abu Ubaid ne un ke samne se guzarna chaha unhon ne unhein apne haath se rok diya phir farmaya mujh se Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri ne hadith bayan ki ke Huzoor ﷺ subah ki namaz padha rahe the yeh bhi aap ke peeche the qira'at aap par khalt-malt ho gayi farigh ho kar farmaya kaash tum dekhte ke main ne Iblees ko pakad liya tha aur is qadar us ka gala ghonta ke us ke munh ki jhaag meri shahadat ki aur beech ki ungli par padi agar mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to woh subah hote is masjid ke sutoon se bandha hua hota aur Madina ke bachche use satate tum se jahan tak ho sake is baat ka khayal rakho ke namaz ki halat mein tumhare samne se koi guzarne na paye (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai Rabia bin Yazeed Abdullah Yalami kehte hain main Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A ke paas Taif ke ek baagh mein gaya jis ka naam Rabt tha aap us waqt ek Quraishi ka muhasra kiye hue the jo zaani aur sharabi tha. Main ne un se kaha mujhe pata chala hai ke aap yeh hadith bayan farmate hain ke jo ek ghoont sharab piye ga Allah Ta'ala chalees din tak us ki tauba qabool na farmaye ga aur bura aadmi woh hai jo maa ke pet mein hi bura ho gaya hai jo shakhs sirf namaz hi ki niyat se Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid mein jaye to woh gunahon se aisa paak ho jata hai jaise aaj hi paida hua. Woh sharabi jise Hazrat Abdullah pakde hue the woh sharab ka zikr sunte hi jhatka de kar apna haath chuda kar bhaag gaya. Ab Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya kisi ko halal nahin ke mere zimme woh baat kare jo main ne na ki. Main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yun suna hai jo shakhs sharab ka ek ghoont bhi pi le us ki chalees din ki namaz namaqbool hai. Agar woh tauba kare to Allah us ki tauba qabool farmata hai.

Phir agar dobara laute to phir chalees din tak ki namazein namaqbool hain phir agar tauba karle to tauba maqbool hai mujhe achi tarah yaad nahin ke teesri ya chauthi martaba mein farmaya ke phir agar laute ga to yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala use jahannumiyon ke badan ka khoon, peep, peshab waghera qayamat ke din pilaye ga aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apni makhlooq ko andhere mein paida kiya phir un par apna noor dala jis par woh noor us din pad gaya woh to hidayat wala ho gaya aur jis tak woh noor na pahuncha woh bhatak gaya. Isi liye main kehta hoon ke Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ke ilm ke mutabiq qalam chal chuka aur main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala se teen duayein ki jin mein se do to unhein mil gayin aur hamein umeed hai ke teesri hamare liye ho (1) Mujhe aisa hukm de jo tere hukm ke muwafiq ho (2) Mujhe aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke liye laiq na ho. Teesri dua yeh thi ke jo shakhs apne ghar se is masjid ki namaz ke irade hi se nikle to jab woh laute to aisa ho jaye goya aaj paida hua pas hamein Allah se umeed hai ke yeh hamare liye Allah ne di ho. Tabrani mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko apne liye ek ghar banane ka hukm diya Hazrat Dawood ne pehle apna ghar bana liya us par wahi aayi ke tum ne apna ghar mere ghar se pehle banaya aap ne arz kiya parwardigar yahi faisla kiya gaya tha phir masjid banani shuru ki deewarein poori ho gayin to ittefaqan tihai hissa gir gaya aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki jawab mila ke tu mera ghar nahin bana sakta. Poocha kyun? Farmaya is liye ke tere hathon se khoon baha hai. Arz kiya Allah Ta'ala woh bhi teri hi mohabbat mein farmaya haan lekin woh mere bande the main un par raham karta hoon. Aap ko yeh kalam sun kar sakht pareshani hui. Phir wahi aayi ke ghamgeen na ho main ise tere ladke Sulaiman ke hathon poora karaunga. Chunancha aap ke inteqal ke baad Hazrat Sulaiman ne ise banana shuru kiya jab poora kar chuke to badi badi qurbaniyan keen aur zabiha zibah kiye aur Bani Israel ko jama kar ke khoob khilaya pilaya Allah ki wahi aayi ke tu ne yeh sab kuch mere hukm ki tameel ki khushi mein kiya hai to mujh se maang jo mange ga paye ga. Arz kiya ke Allah Ta'ala mere teen sawal hain mujhe aisa faisla samjha jo tere faisle ke mutabiq ho aur aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho aur jo is ghar mein aaye sirf namaz ke irade se to woh apne gunahon se aisa azad ho jaye jaise aaj paida hua. In mein se do cheezein to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ata farma dein aur mujhe umeed hai ke teesri bhi de di gayi ho.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni har dua ko in lafzon se shuru farmate (Subhanallahi Rabbiyal A'lal Aliyyil Wahhab) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke inteqal ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se farmaya mujh se apni haajat talab karo. Aap ne arz kiya Allah Ta'ala mujhe aisa dil de jo tujh se darta rahe jaisa ke mere walid ka dil tujh se khauf kiya karta tha aur mere dil mein apni mohabbat daal de jaise ke mere walid ke dil mein teri mohabbat thi. Is par Allah Ta'ala bahut khush hua ke mera banda meri ain ata ke waqt bhi mujh se dara aur meri mohabbat talab karta hai, mujhe apni qasam main ise itni badi saltanat doonga jo is ke baad kisi ko na mile. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne un ki matahuti mein hawayein kar dein aur jinnaat ko bhi un ka matahat bana diya aur isi qadar mulk-o-maal par bhi, unhein hisab-e-qayamat se azaad kar diya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke Bari Ta'ala Sulaiman ke sath bhi isi lutf-o-karam se pesh aana jaisa aaj lutf-o-karam tera mujh par raha, to wahi aayi ke Sulaiman se keh do woh bhi isi tarah mera rahe jis tarah tu mera tha, to main bhi us ke sath ho. Khubsurat pyare wafadar tez-rau ghodon ko kaat dala to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne unhein un ke ewaz un se behtar ata farmaye. Yani hawa ko un ke tabe-e-farman kar diya jo mahine bhar ki raah ko subh ki ek ghadi mein tay kar deti thi aur isi tarah shaam ko jahan ka irada karte zara si der mein pahuncha deti. Jinnaat ko bhi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke tabe kar diya, un mein se baaz badi unchi lambi sangeen pukhta imarat ke banane ke kaam sar-anjaam dete jo insani taqat se bahar tha aur baaz ghota-khor thay jo samundar ki teh mein se lulu jawahar aur deegar qisam qisam ki nafees-o-nadir cheezein la dete thay. Phir aur kuch thay jo bhari bhari bediyon mein jakde rehte thay. Yeh ya to woh thay jo hukumat se sartabi karte thay ya kaam-kaaj mein shararat aur kami karte thay ya logon ko satate aur eeza dete thay. Yeh hai hamari meherbani aur hamari bakhshish aur hamara inaam aur hamara atiya, ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai jis se jo chahe sulook kar sab be-hisab hai kisi par pakad nahin. Jo teri zaban se niklega woh haq hoga. Sahih hadith mein hai jab Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ikhtiyar diya gaya ke agar chahein abd-o-rasool rahein yani jo hukm kiya jaye baja late rahein Allah ke farman ke mutabiq taqseem karte rahein aur agar chahein nabi aur badshah bana diye jayein jise chahein dein jise chahein na dein aur is ka koi hisab Allah ke han na liya jaye to aap ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se mashwara liya aur aap ke mashware se pehli baat qabool farmayi kyunke fazeelat ke lihaz se aula aur aala wahi hai. Go nabuwat-o-saltanat bhi badi cheez hai. Isi liye Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka dunyawi izz-o-jah bayan karte hi farmaya ke woh dar-e-akhirat mein bhi hamare paas bade martabe aur behtareen buzurgi aur aala-tar qareeb wala hai.

Sulaiman A.S ka tafseeli tazkira. Hum ne Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka imtehan liya aur un ki kursi par ek jism daal diya, yani shaitan phir woh apne takht-o-taj ki taraf laut aaye. Is shaitan ka naam Sakhr tha ya Asif tha ya Saro tha ya Haqeeq tha. Yeh waqea aksar mufassireen ne zikr kiya hai, kisi ne tafseel ke sath, kisi ne ikhtisar ke sath. Hazrat Qatada R.A is waqea ko is tarah bayan karte hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki tameer ka is tarah hukum hua ke lohay ki aawaz bhi na suni jaye. Aap ne har chand tadbeerein keen, lekin kargar na huin. Phir aap ne suna ke samundar mein ek shaitan hai jis ka naam Sakhr hai, woh albatta aisi tarkeeb bata sakta hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke ise kisi tarah lao. Ek darya samundar mein milta tha, har saatwein din is mein labalab pani aa jata tha aur yahi pani yeh shaitan peeta tha. Is ka pani nikal diya gaya aur bilkul khali kar ke pani ko band kar ke is ke aane wale din ise sharab se pur kar diya gaya. Jab shaitan aaya aur yeh haal dekha to kehne laga yeh to mazay ki cheez hai lekin aql ki dushman jahalat ko taraqqi dene wali cheez hai. Chunancha woh pyasa hi chala gaya. Jab pyas ki shiddat hui to majbooran yeh sab kuch kehte hue peena hi para. Ab aql jati rahi aur ise Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki angoothi dikhayi gayi ya mondhon ke darmiyan se mohar laga di gayi. Yeh bebas ho gaya. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki hukumat isi angoothi ki wajah se thi. Jab yeh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas pohancha to aap ne ise yeh kaam sar-anjaam dene ka hukum diya. Yeh hudhud ke anday le aaya aur unhein jama kar ke un par sheesha rakh diya. Hudhud aaya, us ne apne anday dekhe, charon taraf ghooma lekin dekha ke hath nahin aa sakte, ur kar wapas chala gaya aur almas le aaya aur ise us sheeshay par rakh kar sheeshay ko kaatna shuru kar diya. Aakhir woh kat gaya aur hudhud apne anday le gaya aur is almas ko bhi le liya gaya aur isi se patthar kaat kaat kar imarat shuru hui. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S jab bait-ul-khala mein ya hammam mein jate to angoothi utaar jate. Ek din hammam mein jana tha aur yeh shaitan aap ke sath tha, aap us waqt farzi ghusal ke liye ja rahe thay, angoothi isi ko sonp di aur chale gaye. Us ne angoothi samundar mein phenk di aur shaitan par Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki shakal daal di gayi aur aap se takht-o-taj chhin gaya. Sab cheezon par shaitan ne qabza kar liya siwaye aap ki biwiyon ke. Ab is se bohat si ghair-maroof baatein zuhoor mein aane lageen. Is zamana mein ek sahib thay jo aise hi thay jaise Huzoor ﷺ ke zamana mein Hazrat Farooq R.A. Us ne kaha aazmaish karni chahiye, mujhe to yeh shakhs Sulaiman maloom nahin hota. Chunancha ek roz us ne kaha kyun janab! Agar koi shakhs raat ko junubi ho jaye aur mausam zara thanda ho aur woh suraj tulu hone tak ghusal na kare to koi harj to nahin? Us ne kaha hargiz nahin. Chalees din tak yeh takht-e-Sulaiman par raha, phir aap ki machli ke pait se angoothi mil gayi, hath mein daalte hi phir tamam cheezein aap ki muti ho gayin. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai.

Suddi farmate hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki ek sau biwiyan thin, aap ko sab se zyada aitbar un mein se ek biwi par tha jin ka naam Jarawah tha. Jab janabi hone ya pakhane jate to apni angoothi unhi ko sonp jate. Ek martaba aap pakhane gaye, peeche se ek shaitan aap hi ki surat bana kar aaya aur biwi sahiba se angoothi talab ki, aap ne de di. Yeh aate hi takht par baith gaya. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S aaye aur angoothi talab ki to biwi sahiba ne farmaya, aap angoothi to le gaye. Aap samajh gaye ke yeh Allah ki aazmaish hai, nihayat pareshan haal se mahal se nikal gaye. Is shaitan ne chalees din tak hukumat ki, lekin ahkam ki tabdeeli ko dekh kar ulama ne samajh liya ke yeh Sulaiman A.S nahin. Chunancha un ki jamaat aap ki biwiyon ke paas aayi aur un se kaha, yeh kya mamla hai? Hamein Sulaiman A.S ki zaat mein shak pad gaya. Agar yeh sach-much Sulaiman A.S hai to is ki aql jaati rahi hai ya yeh ke yeh Sulaiman A.S hi nahin, warna aise khilaf-e-shara ahkam na deta. Auratein yeh sun kar rone lagin. Yeh yahan se wapas aa gaye aur takht ke gird-o-pesh use gher kar baith gaye aur Taurat khol kar us ki tilawat shuru kar di. Yeh khabeeth shaitan Kalam-e-Allah se bhaga aur angoothi samundar mein phenk di jise ek machhli nigal gayi. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S yunhi apne din guzarte the, ek martaba samundar ke kinare nikal gaye, bhook bahut lagi hui thi. Mahi-geeron ko machhliyan pakadte hue dekh kar un ke paas aa kar un se ek machhli mangi aur apna naam bhi bataya. Is par baaz logon ko bada taish aaya ke dekho bheek mangne wala apne tayin Sulaiman A.S batata hai, unhon ne aap ko marna peetna shuru kiya, aap zakhmi ho kar kinare ja kar apne zakhm ka khoon dhone lage. Baaz mahi-geeron ko reham aa gaya ke ek sail ko khwah-makhwah mara, jao bhai ise do machhliyan de aao, bhooka hai bhun khaye ga. Chunancha woh machhliyan aap ko de aaye, bhook ki wajah se aap apne zakhm ko aur khoon ko to bhool gaye aur jaldi se machhli ka pait chaak karne baith gaye. Qudrat-e-Allah se us ke pait se woh angoothi nikli, aap ne Allah ki tareef bayan ki aur angoothi ungli mein daali. Us waqt parindon ne aa kar aap par saya kar liya aur logon ne aap ko pehchan liya aur aap se mazrat karne lage. Aap ne farmaya yeh sab Amr-e-Ilahi tha, Allah ki taraf se ek imtihan tha. Aap aaye apne takht par baith gaye aur hukum diya ke is shaitan ko jahan bhi woh ho giraftar kar lao, chunancha use qaid kar liya gaya. Aap ne use ek lohay ke sandook mein band kiya aur qufl laga kar us par apni mohar laga di aur samundar mein phenkwa diya jo Qayamat tak wahin qaid rahe ga. Is ka naam Haqeeq tha. Aap ki yeh dua ke mujhe aisa mulk ata farmaya jaye jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho, yeh bhi poori hui aur aap ke tabe hawayein kar di gayin. Mujahid se marwi hai ke ek shaitan se jis ka naam Asif tha, ek martaba Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne poocha ke tum logon ko kis tarah fitne mein dalte ho?

Usne kaha zara mujhe angoothi dikhao main abhi aap ko dikha deta hoon, aap ne angoothi de di, usne use samundar mein phenk diya, takht-o-taj ka malik ban baitha aur aap ke libas mein logon ko rah-e-Allah se hatane laga. "Yaad rahe ke yeh sab waqiyat Bani Israel ke bayan karda hain" aur in sab se zyada munkar waqia woh hai jo Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai jiska oopar bayan hua, jismein aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Jarawah ka zikr hai. Ismein yeh bhi hai ke aakhir nabuwat yahan tak pahunchi thi ke ladke aap ko patthar maarte the. Aap ki biwiyon se jab ulama ne mamla ki tafteesh ki to unhon ne kaha ke haan hamein bhi iske Suleman hone se inkar hai kyunke woh halat-e-haiz mein hamare paas aata hai. Shaitan ko jab yeh maloom ho gaya ke raaz khul gaya hai to usne jadoo aur kufr ki kitabein likhwa kar kursi tale dafan kar diya aur phir logon ke samne unhein nikalwa kar unse kaha dekho in kitabon ki badaulat Suleman tum par hukumat kar raha tha, chunancha logon ne aap ko kafir kehna shuru kar diya. Hazrat Suleman samundar ke kinare mazdoori karte the, ek martaba ek shakhs ne bahut si machliyan khareedein, mazdoor ko bulaya, aap pahunche, usne kaha yeh utha lo, poocha mazdoori kya doge? Usne kaha ismein se ek machli tumhein de doonga, aap ne tokra sar par rakha, uske haan pahunchaya, usne ek machli de di, aap ne uska pait chaak kiya, pait chaak karte hi woh angoothi nikal padi, pehante hi kul shayateen, jinn, insaan phir tabe ho gaye aur jhurmat baandh kar hazir ho gaye, aap ne mulk par qabza kiya aur us shaitan ko sakht saza di. Pas "Summa Anab" se murad shaitan jo musallat kiya gaya tha uska lautna hai. Iski asnaad Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas tak hai. Hai to qawi lekin yeh zahir hai ke ise Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne Ahl-e-Kitab se liya hai, yeh bhi us waqt jab ise Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul maan lein. Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek jamaat Hazrat Suleman ko nahin manti thi to ajab nahin ke yeh behooda qissa usi khabeeth jamaat ka gadha hua ho. Ismein to woh cheezein bhi hain jo bilkul hi munkar hain, khusoosan us shaitan ka aap ki aurton ke paas jana aur aimma ne bhi aise hi qisse bayan to kiye hain lekin is baat ka sab ne inkar kiya hai aur kaha hai ke jinn unke paas nahin ja saka aur Nabi ke gharane ki aurton ki ismat-o-sharafat ka taqaza bhi yahi hai aur bhi bahut se logon ne in waqiyat ko bahut tafseel se bayan kiya hai lekin sab ki asal yahi hai ke woh Bani Israel aur Ahl-e-Kitab se liye gaye hain. Wallahu A'lam. Shaibani farmate hain aap ne apni angoothi Asqalan mein payi thi aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak tawazan aap paidal chale the. Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne sifat-e-Suleman mein Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar se ek ajeeb khabar riwayat ki hai. Abu Ishaq Misri kehte hain ke jab (اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ) (89).

(Al-Fajr: 7) ke qissay se Hazrat Ka'ab ne faraghat hasil ki toh Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne kaha Abu Ishaq aap Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki kursi ka zikr bhi kijiye. Farmaya ke woh hathi daant ki thi aur yaqoot, zabarjad aur lulu se murassa thi aur us ke charon taraf sonay ke khajoor ke darakht banay huay thay jin ke khushay bhi motiyon ke thay. Un mein se jo dayin janib thay un ke siray par sonay ke mor thay aur bayin taraf walon par sonay ke gidh thay. Is kursi ke pehlay darjay par dayin janib sonay ke do darakht sanobar ke thay aur bayin janib sonay ke do sher banay huay thay. Un ke siron par zabarjad ke do sutoon thay aur kursi ke donon janib angoor ki sunheri belein thin jo kursi ko dhanpay huay thin, us ke khushay bhi surkh moti ke thay. Phir kursi ke aala darjay par do sher bohat baray sonay ke banay huay thay jin ke andar khol tha, un mein mushk-o-ambar bhara rehta tha. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) kursi par aatay toh yeh sher harkat karte aur un ke ghoomnay se un ke andar se mushk-o-ambar charon taraf chhirak diya jata. Phir do mimbar sonay ke bichha diye jatay, ek aap ke wazeer ka aur ek us waqt ke sab se baray aalim ka. Phir kursi ke samnay sattar mimbar sonay ke aur bichhaye jatay jin par Bani Israel ke qazi, un ke ulama aur un ke sardar baithtay. Un ke peechay paintis mimbar sonay ke aur hotay thay jo khali raha kartay thay. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) jab tashreef laatay, pehlay zeenay par qadam rakhtay hi kursi un tamam cheezon samet ghoom jati, sher apna dayna qadam aagay barha deta aur gidh apna bayan par phaila deta. Jab doosray darjay par qadam rakhtay toh sher apna bayan paon phaila deta aur gidh apna dayan par. Jab aap teesray darjay par charh jatay aur kursi par baith jatay toh ek bara gidh aap ka taaj le kar aap ke sar par rakhta, phir kursi zor zor se ghoomti. Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne poocha aakhir is ki kya wajah? Farmaya woh ek sonay ki laat par thi jisay Sakhr Jinn ne banaya tha. Us ke ghoomtay hi neechay walay mor, gidh waghera sab oopar aa jatay aur sar jhukatay, par pharpharate jis se aap ke jism par mushk-o-ambar ka chhirkao ho jata. Phir ek sonay ka kabootar Taurat utha kar aap ke haath mein deta jisay aap tilawat farmatay. Lekin yeh riwayat bilkul ghareeb hai. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki dua ka matlab yeh hai ke mujhe aisa mulk de ke mujh se koi aur chheen na sakay jaise ke us jism ka waqea hua jo aap ki kursi par daal diya gaya tha. Yeh matlab nahin ke aap doosron ke liye aisay mulk ke na milnay ki dua kartay hon. Lekin jin ba'az logon ne yeh ma'ani liye hain woh kuch theek nazar nahin aatay, balkay sahih matlab yahi hai ke aap ki dua ka yahi matlab tha ke mujhe aisa mulk aur saltanat di jaye ke mere baad phir kisi aur shakhs ko aisi saltanat na milay. Yahi aayat ke alfaaz se maloom hota hai aur yahi ahadees se bhi sabit hota hai.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba farmaya ek sarkash jinn ne guzashta shab mujh par zyadati ki aur meri namaz bigad dena chahi lekin Allah ne mujhe us par qabu de diya aur main ne chaha ke use masjid ke us sutoon se bandh doon taake subah tum sab use dekho lekin usi waqt mujhe mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki dua yaad aa gayi. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Rooh farmate hain phir Huzoor ﷺ ne use zaleel-o-khwar kar ke chhod diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ namaz mein khade hue to hum ne suna ke aap ne farmaya A'uzu billahi minka phir aap ne teen baar farmaya Al'anuka bi la'natillah phir aap ne apna haath is tarah badhaya ke goya aap kisi cheez ko lena chahte hain. Jab farigh hue to hum ne aap se in dono baaton ki wajah poochhi aap ne farmaya Allah ka dushman Iblees aag lekar mere munh mein daalne ke liye aaya to main ne teen martaba A'uzu padhi phir teen martaba us par la'nat bheji lekin woh phir bhi na hata phir main ne chaha ke use pakad kar bandh doon taake Madine ke ladke us se khelein agar hamare bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to main yahi karta. Hazrat Ata bin Yazeed Laithi namaz padh rahe the jo Abu Ubaid ne un ke samne se guzarna chaha unhon ne unhein apne haath se rok diya phir farmaya mujh se Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri ne hadith bayan ki ke Huzoor ﷺ subah ki namaz padha rahe the yeh bhi aap ke peeche the qira'at aap par khalt-malt ho gayi farigh ho kar farmaya kaash tum dekhte ke main ne Iblees ko pakad liya tha aur is qadar us ka gala ghonta ke us ke munh ki jhaag meri shahadat ki aur beech ki ungli par padi agar mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to woh subah hote is masjid ke sutoon se bandha hua hota aur Madina ke bachche use satate tum se jahan tak ho sake is baat ka khayal rakho ke namaz ki halat mein tumhare samne se koi guzarne na paye (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai Rabia bin Yazeed Abdullah Yalami kehte hain main Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A ke paas Taif ke ek baagh mein gaya jis ka naam Rabt tha aap us waqt ek Quraishi ka muhasra kiye hue the jo zaani aur sharabi tha. Main ne un se kaha mujhe pata chala hai ke aap yeh hadith bayan farmate hain ke jo ek ghoont sharab piye ga Allah Ta'ala chalees din tak us ki tauba qabool na farmaye ga aur bura aadmi woh hai jo maa ke pet mein hi bura ho gaya hai jo shakhs sirf namaz hi ki niyat se Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid mein jaye to woh gunahon se aisa paak ho jata hai jaise aaj hi paida hua. Woh sharabi jise Hazrat Abdullah pakde hue the woh sharab ka zikr sunte hi jhatka de kar apna haath chuda kar bhaag gaya. Ab Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya kisi ko halal nahin ke mere zimme woh baat kare jo main ne na ki. Main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yun suna hai jo shakhs sharab ka ek ghoont bhi pi le us ki chalees din ki namaz namaqbool hai. Agar woh tauba kare to Allah us ki tauba qabool farmata hai.

Phir agar dobara laute to phir chalees din tak ki namazein namaqbool hain phir agar tauba karle to tauba maqbool hai mujhe achi tarah yaad nahin ke teesri ya chauthi martaba mein farmaya ke phir agar laute ga to yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala use jahannumiyon ke badan ka khoon, peep, peshab waghera qayamat ke din pilaye ga aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apni makhlooq ko andhere mein paida kiya phir un par apna noor dala jis par woh noor us din pad gaya woh to hidayat wala ho gaya aur jis tak woh noor na pahuncha woh bhatak gaya. Isi liye main kehta hoon ke Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ke ilm ke mutabiq qalam chal chuka aur main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala se teen duayein ki jin mein se do to unhein mil gayin aur hamein umeed hai ke teesri hamare liye ho (1) Mujhe aisa hukm de jo tere hukm ke muwafiq ho (2) Mujhe aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke liye laiq na ho. Teesri dua yeh thi ke jo shakhs apne ghar se is masjid ki namaz ke irade hi se nikle to jab woh laute to aisa ho jaye goya aaj paida hua pas hamein Allah se umeed hai ke yeh hamare liye Allah ne di ho. Tabrani mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko apne liye ek ghar banane ka hukm diya Hazrat Dawood ne pehle apna ghar bana liya us par wahi aayi ke tum ne apna ghar mere ghar se pehle banaya aap ne arz kiya parwardigar yahi faisla kiya gaya tha phir masjid banani shuru ki deewarein poori ho gayin to ittefaqan tihai hissa gir gaya aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki jawab mila ke tu mera ghar nahin bana sakta. Poocha kyun? Farmaya is liye ke tere hathon se khoon baha hai. Arz kiya Allah Ta'ala woh bhi teri hi mohabbat mein farmaya haan lekin woh mere bande the main un par raham karta hoon. Aap ko yeh kalam sun kar sakht pareshani hui. Phir wahi aayi ke ghamgeen na ho main ise tere ladke Sulaiman ke hathon poora karaunga. Chunancha aap ke inteqal ke baad Hazrat Sulaiman ne ise banana shuru kiya jab poora kar chuke to badi badi qurbaniyan keen aur zabiha zibah kiye aur Bani Israel ko jama kar ke khoob khilaya pilaya Allah ki wahi aayi ke tu ne yeh sab kuch mere hukm ki tameel ki khushi mein kiya hai to mujh se maang jo mange ga paye ga. Arz kiya ke Allah Ta'ala mere teen sawal hain mujhe aisa faisla samjha jo tere faisle ke mutabiq ho aur aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho aur jo is ghar mein aaye sirf namaz ke irade se to woh apne gunahon se aisa azad ho jaye jaise aaj paida hua. In mein se do cheezein to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ata farma dein aur mujhe umeed hai ke teesri bhi de di gayi ho.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni har dua ko in lafzon se shuru farmate (Subhanallahi Rabbiyal A'lal Aliyyil Wahhab) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke inteqal ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se farmaya mujh se apni haajat talab karo. Aap ne arz kiya Allah Ta'ala mujhe aisa dil de jo tujh se darta rahe jaisa ke mere walid ka dil tujh se khauf kiya karta tha aur mere dil mein apni mohabbat daal de jaise ke mere walid ke dil mein teri mohabbat thi. Is par Allah Ta'ala bahut khush hua ke mera banda meri ain ata ke waqt bhi mujh se dara aur meri mohabbat talab karta hai, mujhe apni qasam main ise itni badi saltanat doonga jo is ke baad kisi ko na mile. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne un ki matahuti mein hawayein kar dein aur jinnaat ko bhi un ka matahat bana diya aur isi qadar mulk-o-maal par bhi, unhein hisab-e-qayamat se azaad kar diya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke Bari Ta'ala Sulaiman ke sath bhi isi lutf-o-karam se pesh aana jaisa aaj lutf-o-karam tera mujh par raha, to wahi aayi ke Sulaiman se keh do woh bhi isi tarah mera rahe jis tarah tu mera tha, to main bhi us ke sath ho. Khubsurat pyare wafadar tez-rau ghodon ko kaat dala to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne unhein un ke ewaz un se behtar ata farmaye. Yani hawa ko un ke tabe-e-farman kar diya jo mahine bhar ki raah ko subh ki ek ghadi mein tay kar deti thi aur isi tarah shaam ko jahan ka irada karte zara si der mein pahuncha deti. Jinnaat ko bhi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke tabe kar diya, un mein se baaz badi unchi lambi sangeen pukhta imarat ke banane ke kaam sar-anjaam dete jo insani taqat se bahar tha aur baaz ghota-khor thay jo samundar ki teh mein se lulu jawahar aur deegar qisam qisam ki nafees-o-nadir cheezein la dete thay. Phir aur kuch thay jo bhari bhari bediyon mein jakde rehte thay. Yeh ya to woh thay jo hukumat se sartabi karte thay ya kaam-kaaj mein shararat aur kami karte thay ya logon ko satate aur eeza dete thay. Yeh hai hamari meherbani aur hamari bakhshish aur hamara inaam aur hamara atiya, ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai jis se jo chahe sulook kar sab be-hisab hai kisi par pakad nahin. Jo teri zaban se niklega woh haq hoga. Sahih hadith mein hai jab Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ikhtiyar diya gaya ke agar chahein abd-o-rasool rahein yani jo hukm kiya jaye baja late rahein Allah ke farman ke mutabiq taqseem karte rahein aur agar chahein nabi aur badshah bana diye jayein jise chahein dein jise chahein na dein aur is ka koi hisab Allah ke han na liya jaye to aap ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se mashwara liya aur aap ke mashware se pehli baat qabool farmayi kyunke fazeelat ke lihaz se aula aur aala wahi hai. Go nabuwat-o-saltanat bhi badi cheez hai. Isi liye Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka dunyawi izz-o-jah bayan karte hi farmaya ke woh dar-e-akhirat mein bhi hamare paas bade martabe aur behtareen buzurgi aur aala-tar qareeb wala hai.

Sulaiman A.S ka tafseeli tazkira. Hum ne Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka imtehan liya aur un ki kursi par ek jism daal diya, yani shaitan phir woh apne takht-o-taj ki taraf laut aaye. Is shaitan ka naam Sakhr tha ya Asif tha ya Saro tha ya Haqeeq tha. Yeh waqea aksar mufassireen ne zikr kiya hai, kisi ne tafseel ke sath, kisi ne ikhtisar ke sath. Hazrat Qatada R.A is waqea ko is tarah bayan karte hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki tameer ka is tarah hukum hua ke lohay ki aawaz bhi na suni jaye. Aap ne har chand tadbeerein keen, lekin kargar na huin. Phir aap ne suna ke samundar mein ek shaitan hai jis ka naam Sakhr hai, woh albatta aisi tarkeeb bata sakta hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke ise kisi tarah lao. Ek darya samundar mein milta tha, har saatwein din is mein labalab pani aa jata tha aur yahi pani yeh shaitan peeta tha. Is ka pani nikal diya gaya aur bilkul khali kar ke pani ko band kar ke is ke aane wale din ise sharab se pur kar diya gaya. Jab shaitan aaya aur yeh haal dekha to kehne laga yeh to mazay ki cheez hai lekin aql ki dushman jahalat ko taraqqi dene wali cheez hai. Chunancha woh pyasa hi chala gaya. Jab pyas ki shiddat hui to majbooran yeh sab kuch kehte hue peena hi para. Ab aql jati rahi aur ise Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki angoothi dikhayi gayi ya mondhon ke darmiyan se mohar laga di gayi. Yeh bebas ho gaya. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki hukumat isi angoothi ki wajah se thi. Jab yeh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas pohancha to aap ne ise yeh kaam sar-anjaam dene ka hukum diya. Yeh hudhud ke anday le aaya aur unhein jama kar ke un par sheesha rakh diya. Hudhud aaya, us ne apne anday dekhe, charon taraf ghooma lekin dekha ke hath nahin aa sakte, ur kar wapas chala gaya aur almas le aaya aur ise us sheeshay par rakh kar sheeshay ko kaatna shuru kar diya. Aakhir woh kat gaya aur hudhud apne anday le gaya aur is almas ko bhi le liya gaya aur isi se patthar kaat kaat kar imarat shuru hui. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S jab bait-ul-khala mein ya hammam mein jate to angoothi utaar jate. Ek din hammam mein jana tha aur yeh shaitan aap ke sath tha, aap us waqt farzi ghusal ke liye ja rahe thay, angoothi isi ko sonp di aur chale gaye. Us ne angoothi samundar mein phenk di aur shaitan par Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki shakal daal di gayi aur aap se takht-o-taj chhin gaya. Sab cheezon par shaitan ne qabza kar liya siwaye aap ki biwiyon ke. Ab is se bohat si ghair-maroof baatein zuhoor mein aane lageen. Is zamana mein ek sahib thay jo aise hi thay jaise Huzoor ﷺ ke zamana mein Hazrat Farooq R.A. Us ne kaha aazmaish karni chahiye, mujhe to yeh shakhs Sulaiman maloom nahin hota. Chunancha ek roz us ne kaha kyun janab! Agar koi shakhs raat ko junubi ho jaye aur mausam zara thanda ho aur woh suraj tulu hone tak ghusal na kare to koi harj to nahin? Us ne kaha hargiz nahin. Chalees din tak yeh takht-e-Sulaiman par raha, phir aap ki machli ke pait se angoothi mil gayi, hath mein daalte hi phir tamam cheezein aap ki muti ho gayin. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai.

Suddi farmate hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki ek sau biwiyan thin, aap ko sab se zyada aitbar un mein se ek biwi par tha jin ka naam Jarawah tha. Jab janabi hone ya pakhane jate to apni angoothi unhi ko sonp jate. Ek martaba aap pakhane gaye, peeche se ek shaitan aap hi ki surat bana kar aaya aur biwi sahiba se angoothi talab ki, aap ne de di. Yeh aate hi takht par baith gaya. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S aaye aur angoothi talab ki to biwi sahiba ne farmaya, aap angoothi to le gaye. Aap samajh gaye ke yeh Allah ki aazmaish hai, nihayat pareshan haal se mahal se nikal gaye. Is shaitan ne chalees din tak hukumat ki, lekin ahkam ki tabdeeli ko dekh kar ulama ne samajh liya ke yeh Sulaiman A.S nahin. Chunancha un ki jamaat aap ki biwiyon ke paas aayi aur un se kaha, yeh kya mamla hai? Hamein Sulaiman A.S ki zaat mein shak pad gaya. Agar yeh sach-much Sulaiman A.S hai to is ki aql jaati rahi hai ya yeh ke yeh Sulaiman A.S hi nahin, warna aise khilaf-e-shara ahkam na deta. Auratein yeh sun kar rone lagin. Yeh yahan se wapas aa gaye aur takht ke gird-o-pesh use gher kar baith gaye aur Taurat khol kar us ki tilawat shuru kar di. Yeh khabeeth shaitan Kalam-e-Allah se bhaga aur angoothi samundar mein phenk di jise ek machhli nigal gayi. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S yunhi apne din guzarte the, ek martaba samundar ke kinare nikal gaye, bhook bahut lagi hui thi. Mahi-geeron ko machhliyan pakadte hue dekh kar un ke paas aa kar un se ek machhli mangi aur apna naam bhi bataya. Is par baaz logon ko bada taish aaya ke dekho bheek mangne wala apne tayin Sulaiman A.S batata hai, unhon ne aap ko marna peetna shuru kiya, aap zakhmi ho kar kinare ja kar apne zakhm ka khoon dhone lage. Baaz mahi-geeron ko reham aa gaya ke ek sail ko khwah-makhwah mara, jao bhai ise do machhliyan de aao, bhooka hai bhun khaye ga. Chunancha woh machhliyan aap ko de aaye, bhook ki wajah se aap apne zakhm ko aur khoon ko to bhool gaye aur jaldi se machhli ka pait chaak karne baith gaye. Qudrat-e-Allah se us ke pait se woh angoothi nikli, aap ne Allah ki tareef bayan ki aur angoothi ungli mein daali. Us waqt parindon ne aa kar aap par saya kar liya aur logon ne aap ko pehchan liya aur aap se mazrat karne lage. Aap ne farmaya yeh sab Amr-e-Ilahi tha, Allah ki taraf se ek imtihan tha. Aap aaye apne takht par baith gaye aur hukum diya ke is shaitan ko jahan bhi woh ho giraftar kar lao, chunancha use qaid kar liya gaya. Aap ne use ek lohay ke sandook mein band kiya aur qufl laga kar us par apni mohar laga di aur samundar mein phenkwa diya jo Qayamat tak wahin qaid rahe ga. Is ka naam Haqeeq tha. Aap ki yeh dua ke mujhe aisa mulk ata farmaya jaye jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho, yeh bhi poori hui aur aap ke tabe hawayein kar di gayin. Mujahid se marwi hai ke ek shaitan se jis ka naam Asif tha, ek martaba Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne poocha ke tum logon ko kis tarah fitne mein dalte ho?

Usne kaha zara mujhe angoothi dikhao main abhi aap ko dikha deta hoon, aap ne angoothi de di, usne use samundar mein phenk diya, takht-o-taj ka malik ban baitha aur aap ke libas mein logon ko rah-e-Allah se hatane laga. "Yaad rahe ke yeh sab waqiyat Bani Israel ke bayan karda hain" aur in sab se zyada munkar waqia woh hai jo Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai jiska oopar bayan hua, jismein aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Jarawah ka zikr hai. Ismein yeh bhi hai ke aakhir nabuwat yahan tak pahunchi thi ke ladke aap ko patthar maarte the. Aap ki biwiyon se jab ulama ne mamla ki tafteesh ki to unhon ne kaha ke haan hamein bhi iske Suleman hone se inkar hai kyunke woh halat-e-haiz mein hamare paas aata hai. Shaitan ko jab yeh maloom ho gaya ke raaz khul gaya hai to usne jadoo aur kufr ki kitabein likhwa kar kursi tale dafan kar diya aur phir logon ke samne unhein nikalwa kar unse kaha dekho in kitabon ki badaulat Suleman tum par hukumat kar raha tha, chunancha logon ne aap ko kafir kehna shuru kar diya. Hazrat Suleman samundar ke kinare mazdoori karte the, ek martaba ek shakhs ne bahut si machliyan khareedein, mazdoor ko bulaya, aap pahunche, usne kaha yeh utha lo, poocha mazdoori kya doge? Usne kaha ismein se ek machli tumhein de doonga, aap ne tokra sar par rakha, uske haan pahunchaya, usne ek machli de di, aap ne uska pait chaak kiya, pait chaak karte hi woh angoothi nikal padi, pehante hi kul shayateen, jinn, insaan phir tabe ho gaye aur jhurmat baandh kar hazir ho gaye, aap ne mulk par qabza kiya aur us shaitan ko sakht saza di. Pas "Summa Anab" se murad shaitan jo musallat kiya gaya tha uska lautna hai. Iski asnaad Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas tak hai. Hai to qawi lekin yeh zahir hai ke ise Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne Ahl-e-Kitab se liya hai, yeh bhi us waqt jab ise Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul maan lein. Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek jamaat Hazrat Suleman ko nahin manti thi to ajab nahin ke yeh behooda qissa usi khabeeth jamaat ka gadha hua ho. Ismein to woh cheezein bhi hain jo bilkul hi munkar hain, khusoosan us shaitan ka aap ki aurton ke paas jana aur aimma ne bhi aise hi qisse bayan to kiye hain lekin is baat ka sab ne inkar kiya hai aur kaha hai ke jinn unke paas nahin ja saka aur Nabi ke gharane ki aurton ki ismat-o-sharafat ka taqaza bhi yahi hai aur bhi bahut se logon ne in waqiyat ko bahut tafseel se bayan kiya hai lekin sab ki asal yahi hai ke woh Bani Israel aur Ahl-e-Kitab se liye gaye hain. Wallahu A'lam. Shaibani farmate hain aap ne apni angoothi Asqalan mein payi thi aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak tawazan aap paidal chale the. Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne sifat-e-Suleman mein Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar se ek ajeeb khabar riwayat ki hai. Abu Ishaq Misri kehte hain ke jab (اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ) (89).

(Al-Fajr: 7) ke qissay se Hazrat Ka'ab ne faraghat hasil ki toh Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne kaha Abu Ishaq aap Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki kursi ka zikr bhi kijiye. Farmaya ke woh hathi daant ki thi aur yaqoot, zabarjad aur lulu se murassa thi aur us ke charon taraf sonay ke khajoor ke darakht banay huay thay jin ke khushay bhi motiyon ke thay. Un mein se jo dayin janib thay un ke siray par sonay ke mor thay aur bayin taraf walon par sonay ke gidh thay. Is kursi ke pehlay darjay par dayin janib sonay ke do darakht sanobar ke thay aur bayin janib sonay ke do sher banay huay thay. Un ke siron par zabarjad ke do sutoon thay aur kursi ke donon janib angoor ki sunheri belein thin jo kursi ko dhanpay huay thin, us ke khushay bhi surkh moti ke thay. Phir kursi ke aala darjay par do sher bohat baray sonay ke banay huay thay jin ke andar khol tha, un mein mushk-o-ambar bhara rehta tha. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) kursi par aatay toh yeh sher harkat karte aur un ke ghoomnay se un ke andar se mushk-o-ambar charon taraf chhirak diya jata. Phir do mimbar sonay ke bichha diye jatay, ek aap ke wazeer ka aur ek us waqt ke sab se baray aalim ka. Phir kursi ke samnay sattar mimbar sonay ke aur bichhaye jatay jin par Bani Israel ke qazi, un ke ulama aur un ke sardar baithtay. Un ke peechay paintis mimbar sonay ke aur hotay thay jo khali raha kartay thay. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) jab tashreef laatay, pehlay zeenay par qadam rakhtay hi kursi un tamam cheezon samet ghoom jati, sher apna dayna qadam aagay barha deta aur gidh apna bayan par phaila deta. Jab doosray darjay par qadam rakhtay toh sher apna bayan paon phaila deta aur gidh apna dayan par. Jab aap teesray darjay par charh jatay aur kursi par baith jatay toh ek bara gidh aap ka taaj le kar aap ke sar par rakhta, phir kursi zor zor se ghoomti. Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne poocha aakhir is ki kya wajah? Farmaya woh ek sonay ki laat par thi jisay Sakhr Jinn ne banaya tha. Us ke ghoomtay hi neechay walay mor, gidh waghera sab oopar aa jatay aur sar jhukatay, par pharpharate jis se aap ke jism par mushk-o-ambar ka chhirkao ho jata. Phir ek sonay ka kabootar Taurat utha kar aap ke haath mein deta jisay aap tilawat farmatay. Lekin yeh riwayat bilkul ghareeb hai. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki dua ka matlab yeh hai ke mujhe aisa mulk de ke mujh se koi aur chheen na sakay jaise ke us jism ka waqea hua jo aap ki kursi par daal diya gaya tha. Yeh matlab nahin ke aap doosron ke liye aisay mulk ke na milnay ki dua kartay hon. Lekin jin ba'az logon ne yeh ma'ani liye hain woh kuch theek nazar nahin aatay, balkay sahih matlab yahi hai ke aap ki dua ka yahi matlab tha ke mujhe aisa mulk aur saltanat di jaye ke mere baad phir kisi aur shakhs ko aisi saltanat na milay. Yahi aayat ke alfaaz se maloom hota hai aur yahi ahadees se bhi sabit hota hai.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba farmaya ek sarkash jinn ne guzashta shab mujh par zyadati ki aur meri namaz bigad dena chahi lekin Allah ne mujhe us par qabu de diya aur main ne chaha ke use masjid ke us sutoon se bandh doon taake subah tum sab use dekho lekin usi waqt mujhe mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki dua yaad aa gayi. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Rooh farmate hain phir Huzoor ﷺ ne use zaleel-o-khwar kar ke chhod diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ namaz mein khade hue to hum ne suna ke aap ne farmaya A'uzu billahi minka phir aap ne teen baar farmaya Al'anuka bi la'natillah phir aap ne apna haath is tarah badhaya ke goya aap kisi cheez ko lena chahte hain. Jab farigh hue to hum ne aap se in dono baaton ki wajah poochhi aap ne farmaya Allah ka dushman Iblees aag lekar mere munh mein daalne ke liye aaya to main ne teen martaba A'uzu padhi phir teen martaba us par la'nat bheji lekin woh phir bhi na hata phir main ne chaha ke use pakad kar bandh doon taake Madine ke ladke us se khelein agar hamare bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to main yahi karta. Hazrat Ata bin Yazeed Laithi namaz padh rahe the jo Abu Ubaid ne un ke samne se guzarna chaha unhon ne unhein apne haath se rok diya phir farmaya mujh se Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri ne hadith bayan ki ke Huzoor ﷺ subah ki namaz padha rahe the yeh bhi aap ke peeche the qira'at aap par khalt-malt ho gayi farigh ho kar farmaya kaash tum dekhte ke main ne Iblees ko pakad liya tha aur is qadar us ka gala ghonta ke us ke munh ki jhaag meri shahadat ki aur beech ki ungli par padi agar mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to woh subah hote is masjid ke sutoon se bandha hua hota aur Madina ke bachche use satate tum se jahan tak ho sake is baat ka khayal rakho ke namaz ki halat mein tumhare samne se koi guzarne na paye (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai Rabia bin Yazeed Abdullah Yalami kehte hain main Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A ke paas Taif ke ek baagh mein gaya jis ka naam Rabt tha aap us waqt ek Quraishi ka muhasra kiye hue the jo zaani aur sharabi tha. Main ne un se kaha mujhe pata chala hai ke aap yeh hadith bayan farmate hain ke jo ek ghoont sharab piye ga Allah Ta'ala chalees din tak us ki tauba qabool na farmaye ga aur bura aadmi woh hai jo maa ke pet mein hi bura ho gaya hai jo shakhs sirf namaz hi ki niyat se Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid mein jaye to woh gunahon se aisa paak ho jata hai jaise aaj hi paida hua. Woh sharabi jise Hazrat Abdullah pakde hue the woh sharab ka zikr sunte hi jhatka de kar apna haath chuda kar bhaag gaya. Ab Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya kisi ko halal nahin ke mere zimme woh baat kare jo main ne na ki. Main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yun suna hai jo shakhs sharab ka ek ghoont bhi pi le us ki chalees din ki namaz namaqbool hai. Agar woh tauba kare to Allah us ki tauba qabool farmata hai.

Phir agar dobara laute to phir chalees din tak ki namazein namaqbool hain phir agar tauba karle to tauba maqbool hai mujhe achi tarah yaad nahin ke teesri ya chauthi martaba mein farmaya ke phir agar laute ga to yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala use jahannumiyon ke badan ka khoon, peep, peshab waghera qayamat ke din pilaye ga aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apni makhlooq ko andhere mein paida kiya phir un par apna noor dala jis par woh noor us din pad gaya woh to hidayat wala ho gaya aur jis tak woh noor na pahuncha woh bhatak gaya. Isi liye main kehta hoon ke Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ke ilm ke mutabiq qalam chal chuka aur main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala se teen duayein ki jin mein se do to unhein mil gayin aur hamein umeed hai ke teesri hamare liye ho (1) Mujhe aisa hukm de jo tere hukm ke muwafiq ho (2) Mujhe aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke liye laiq na ho. Teesri dua yeh thi ke jo shakhs apne ghar se is masjid ki namaz ke irade hi se nikle to jab woh laute to aisa ho jaye goya aaj paida hua pas hamein Allah se umeed hai ke yeh hamare liye Allah ne di ho. Tabrani mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko apne liye ek ghar banane ka hukm diya Hazrat Dawood ne pehle apna ghar bana liya us par wahi aayi ke tum ne apna ghar mere ghar se pehle banaya aap ne arz kiya parwardigar yahi faisla kiya gaya tha phir masjid banani shuru ki deewarein poori ho gayin to ittefaqan tihai hissa gir gaya aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki jawab mila ke tu mera ghar nahin bana sakta. Poocha kyun? Farmaya is liye ke tere hathon se khoon baha hai. Arz kiya Allah Ta'ala woh bhi teri hi mohabbat mein farmaya haan lekin woh mere bande the main un par raham karta hoon. Aap ko yeh kalam sun kar sakht pareshani hui. Phir wahi aayi ke ghamgeen na ho main ise tere ladke Sulaiman ke hathon poora karaunga. Chunancha aap ke inteqal ke baad Hazrat Sulaiman ne ise banana shuru kiya jab poora kar chuke to badi badi qurbaniyan keen aur zabiha zibah kiye aur Bani Israel ko jama kar ke khoob khilaya pilaya Allah ki wahi aayi ke tu ne yeh sab kuch mere hukm ki tameel ki khushi mein kiya hai to mujh se maang jo mange ga paye ga. Arz kiya ke Allah Ta'ala mere teen sawal hain mujhe aisa faisla samjha jo tere faisle ke mutabiq ho aur aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho aur jo is ghar mein aaye sirf namaz ke irade se to woh apne gunahon se aisa azad ho jaye jaise aaj paida hua. In mein se do cheezein to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ata farma dein aur mujhe umeed hai ke teesri bhi de di gayi ho.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni har dua ko in lafzon se shuru farmate (Subhanallahi Rabbiyal A'lal Aliyyil Wahhab) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke inteqal ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se farmaya mujh se apni haajat talab karo. Aap ne arz kiya Allah Ta'ala mujhe aisa dil de jo tujh se darta rahe jaisa ke mere walid ka dil tujh se khauf kiya karta tha aur mere dil mein apni mohabbat daal de jaise ke mere walid ke dil mein teri mohabbat thi. Is par Allah Ta'ala bahut khush hua ke mera banda meri ain ata ke waqt bhi mujh se dara aur meri mohabbat talab karta hai, mujhe apni qasam main ise itni badi saltanat doonga jo is ke baad kisi ko na mile. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne un ki matahuti mein hawayein kar dein aur jinnaat ko bhi un ka matahat bana diya aur isi qadar mulk-o-maal par bhi, unhein hisab-e-qayamat se azaad kar diya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke Bari Ta'ala Sulaiman ke sath bhi isi lutf-o-karam se pesh aana jaisa aaj lutf-o-karam tera mujh par raha, to wahi aayi ke Sulaiman se keh do woh bhi isi tarah mera rahe jis tarah tu mera tha, to main bhi us ke sath ho. Khubsurat pyare wafadar tez-rau ghodon ko kaat dala to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne unhein un ke ewaz un se behtar ata farmaye. Yani hawa ko un ke tabe-e-farman kar diya jo mahine bhar ki raah ko subh ki ek ghadi mein tay kar deti thi aur isi tarah shaam ko jahan ka irada karte zara si der mein pahuncha deti. Jinnaat ko bhi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke tabe kar diya, un mein se baaz badi unchi lambi sangeen pukhta imarat ke banane ke kaam sar-anjaam dete jo insani taqat se bahar tha aur baaz ghota-khor thay jo samundar ki teh mein se lulu jawahar aur deegar qisam qisam ki nafees-o-nadir cheezein la dete thay. Phir aur kuch thay jo bhari bhari bediyon mein jakde rehte thay. Yeh ya to woh thay jo hukumat se sartabi karte thay ya kaam-kaaj mein shararat aur kami karte thay ya logon ko satate aur eeza dete thay. Yeh hai hamari meherbani aur hamari bakhshish aur hamara inaam aur hamara atiya, ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai jis se jo chahe sulook kar sab be-hisab hai kisi par pakad nahin. Jo teri zaban se niklega woh haq hoga. Sahih hadith mein hai jab Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ikhtiyar diya gaya ke agar chahein abd-o-rasool rahein yani jo hukm kiya jaye baja late rahein Allah ke farman ke mutabiq taqseem karte rahein aur agar chahein nabi aur badshah bana diye jayein jise chahein dein jise chahein na dein aur is ka koi hisab Allah ke han na liya jaye to aap ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se mashwara liya aur aap ke mashware se pehli baat qabool farmayi kyunke fazeelat ke lihaz se aula aur aala wahi hai. Go nabuwat-o-saltanat bhi badi cheez hai. Isi liye Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka dunyawi izz-o-jah bayan karte hi farmaya ke woh dar-e-akhirat mein bhi hamare paas bade martabe aur behtareen buzurgi aur aala-tar qareeb wala hai.

Sulaiman A.S ka tafseeli tazkira. Hum ne Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka imtehan liya aur un ki kursi par ek jism daal diya, yani shaitan phir woh apne takht-o-taj ki taraf laut aaye. Is shaitan ka naam Sakhr tha ya Asif tha ya Saro tha ya Haqeeq tha. Yeh waqea aksar mufassireen ne zikr kiya hai, kisi ne tafseel ke sath, kisi ne ikhtisar ke sath. Hazrat Qatada R.A is waqea ko is tarah bayan karte hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki tameer ka is tarah hukum hua ke lohay ki aawaz bhi na suni jaye. Aap ne har chand tadbeerein keen, lekin kargar na huin. Phir aap ne suna ke samundar mein ek shaitan hai jis ka naam Sakhr hai, woh albatta aisi tarkeeb bata sakta hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke ise kisi tarah lao. Ek darya samundar mein milta tha, har saatwein din is mein labalab pani aa jata tha aur yahi pani yeh shaitan peeta tha. Is ka pani nikal diya gaya aur bilkul khali kar ke pani ko band kar ke is ke aane wale din ise sharab se pur kar diya gaya. Jab shaitan aaya aur yeh haal dekha to kehne laga yeh to mazay ki cheez hai lekin aql ki dushman jahalat ko taraqqi dene wali cheez hai. Chunancha woh pyasa hi chala gaya. Jab pyas ki shiddat hui to majbooran yeh sab kuch kehte hue peena hi para. Ab aql jati rahi aur ise Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki angoothi dikhayi gayi ya mondhon ke darmiyan se mohar laga di gayi. Yeh bebas ho gaya. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki hukumat isi angoothi ki wajah se thi. Jab yeh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas pohancha to aap ne ise yeh kaam sar-anjaam dene ka hukum diya. Yeh hudhud ke anday le aaya aur unhein jama kar ke un par sheesha rakh diya. Hudhud aaya, us ne apne anday dekhe, charon taraf ghooma lekin dekha ke hath nahin aa sakte, ur kar wapas chala gaya aur almas le aaya aur ise us sheeshay par rakh kar sheeshay ko kaatna shuru kar diya. Aakhir woh kat gaya aur hudhud apne anday le gaya aur is almas ko bhi le liya gaya aur isi se patthar kaat kaat kar imarat shuru hui. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S jab bait-ul-khala mein ya hammam mein jate to angoothi utaar jate. Ek din hammam mein jana tha aur yeh shaitan aap ke sath tha, aap us waqt farzi ghusal ke liye ja rahe thay, angoothi isi ko sonp di aur chale gaye. Us ne angoothi samundar mein phenk di aur shaitan par Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki shakal daal di gayi aur aap se takht-o-taj chhin gaya. Sab cheezon par shaitan ne qabza kar liya siwaye aap ki biwiyon ke. Ab is se bohat si ghair-maroof baatein zuhoor mein aane lageen. Is zamana mein ek sahib thay jo aise hi thay jaise Huzoor ﷺ ke zamana mein Hazrat Farooq R.A. Us ne kaha aazmaish karni chahiye, mujhe to yeh shakhs Sulaiman maloom nahin hota. Chunancha ek roz us ne kaha kyun janab! Agar koi shakhs raat ko junubi ho jaye aur mausam zara thanda ho aur woh suraj tulu hone tak ghusal na kare to koi harj to nahin? Us ne kaha hargiz nahin. Chalees din tak yeh takht-e-Sulaiman par raha, phir aap ki machli ke pait se angoothi mil gayi, hath mein daalte hi phir tamam cheezein aap ki muti ho gayin. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai.

Suddi farmate hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki ek sau biwiyan thin, aap ko sab se zyada aitbar un mein se ek biwi par tha jin ka naam Jarawah tha. Jab janabi hone ya pakhane jate to apni angoothi unhi ko sonp jate. Ek martaba aap pakhane gaye, peeche se ek shaitan aap hi ki surat bana kar aaya aur biwi sahiba se angoothi talab ki, aap ne de di. Yeh aate hi takht par baith gaya. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S aaye aur angoothi talab ki to biwi sahiba ne farmaya, aap angoothi to le gaye. Aap samajh gaye ke yeh Allah ki aazmaish hai, nihayat pareshan haal se mahal se nikal gaye. Is shaitan ne chalees din tak hukumat ki, lekin ahkam ki tabdeeli ko dekh kar ulama ne samajh liya ke yeh Sulaiman A.S nahin. Chunancha un ki jamaat aap ki biwiyon ke paas aayi aur un se kaha, yeh kya mamla hai? Hamein Sulaiman A.S ki zaat mein shak pad gaya. Agar yeh sach-much Sulaiman A.S hai to is ki aql jaati rahi hai ya yeh ke yeh Sulaiman A.S hi nahin, warna aise khilaf-e-shara ahkam na deta. Auratein yeh sun kar rone lagin. Yeh yahan se wapas aa gaye aur takht ke gird-o-pesh use gher kar baith gaye aur Taurat khol kar us ki tilawat shuru kar di. Yeh khabeeth shaitan Kalam-e-Allah se bhaga aur angoothi samundar mein phenk di jise ek machhli nigal gayi. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S yunhi apne din guzarte the, ek martaba samundar ke kinare nikal gaye, bhook bahut lagi hui thi. Mahi-geeron ko machhliyan pakadte hue dekh kar un ke paas aa kar un se ek machhli mangi aur apna naam bhi bataya. Is par baaz logon ko bada taish aaya ke dekho bheek mangne wala apne tayin Sulaiman A.S batata hai, unhon ne aap ko marna peetna shuru kiya, aap zakhmi ho kar kinare ja kar apne zakhm ka khoon dhone lage. Baaz mahi-geeron ko reham aa gaya ke ek sail ko khwah-makhwah mara, jao bhai ise do machhliyan de aao, bhooka hai bhun khaye ga. Chunancha woh machhliyan aap ko de aaye, bhook ki wajah se aap apne zakhm ko aur khoon ko to bhool gaye aur jaldi se machhli ka pait chaak karne baith gaye. Qudrat-e-Allah se us ke pait se woh angoothi nikli, aap ne Allah ki tareef bayan ki aur angoothi ungli mein daali. Us waqt parindon ne aa kar aap par saya kar liya aur logon ne aap ko pehchan liya aur aap se mazrat karne lage. Aap ne farmaya yeh sab Amr-e-Ilahi tha, Allah ki taraf se ek imtihan tha. Aap aaye apne takht par baith gaye aur hukum diya ke is shaitan ko jahan bhi woh ho giraftar kar lao, chunancha use qaid kar liya gaya. Aap ne use ek lohay ke sandook mein band kiya aur qufl laga kar us par apni mohar laga di aur samundar mein phenkwa diya jo Qayamat tak wahin qaid rahe ga. Is ka naam Haqeeq tha. Aap ki yeh dua ke mujhe aisa mulk ata farmaya jaye jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho, yeh bhi poori hui aur aap ke tabe hawayein kar di gayin. Mujahid se marwi hai ke ek shaitan se jis ka naam Asif tha, ek martaba Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne poocha ke tum logon ko kis tarah fitne mein dalte ho?

Usne kaha zara mujhe angoothi dikhao main abhi aap ko dikha deta hoon, aap ne angoothi de di, usne use samundar mein phenk diya, takht-o-taj ka malik ban baitha aur aap ke libas mein logon ko rah-e-Allah se hatane laga. "Yaad rahe ke yeh sab waqiyat Bani Israel ke bayan karda hain" aur in sab se zyada munkar waqia woh hai jo Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai jiska oopar bayan hua, jismein aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Jarawah ka zikr hai. Ismein yeh bhi hai ke aakhir nabuwat yahan tak pahunchi thi ke ladke aap ko patthar maarte the. Aap ki biwiyon se jab ulama ne mamla ki tafteesh ki to unhon ne kaha ke haan hamein bhi iske Suleman hone se inkar hai kyunke woh halat-e-haiz mein hamare paas aata hai. Shaitan ko jab yeh maloom ho gaya ke raaz khul gaya hai to usne jadoo aur kufr ki kitabein likhwa kar kursi tale dafan kar diya aur phir logon ke samne unhein nikalwa kar unse kaha dekho in kitabon ki badaulat Suleman tum par hukumat kar raha tha, chunancha logon ne aap ko kafir kehna shuru kar diya. Hazrat Suleman samundar ke kinare mazdoori karte the, ek martaba ek shakhs ne bahut si machliyan khareedein, mazdoor ko bulaya, aap pahunche, usne kaha yeh utha lo, poocha mazdoori kya doge? Usne kaha ismein se ek machli tumhein de doonga, aap ne tokra sar par rakha, uske haan pahunchaya, usne ek machli de di, aap ne uska pait chaak kiya, pait chaak karte hi woh angoothi nikal padi, pehante hi kul shayateen, jinn, insaan phir tabe ho gaye aur jhurmat baandh kar hazir ho gaye, aap ne mulk par qabza kiya aur us shaitan ko sakht saza di. Pas "Summa Anab" se murad shaitan jo musallat kiya gaya tha uska lautna hai. Iski asnaad Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas tak hai. Hai to qawi lekin yeh zahir hai ke ise Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne Ahl-e-Kitab se liya hai, yeh bhi us waqt jab ise Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul maan lein. Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek jamaat Hazrat Suleman ko nahin manti thi to ajab nahin ke yeh behooda qissa usi khabeeth jamaat ka gadha hua ho. Ismein to woh cheezein bhi hain jo bilkul hi munkar hain, khusoosan us shaitan ka aap ki aurton ke paas jana aur aimma ne bhi aise hi qisse bayan to kiye hain lekin is baat ka sab ne inkar kiya hai aur kaha hai ke jinn unke paas nahin ja saka aur Nabi ke gharane ki aurton ki ismat-o-sharafat ka taqaza bhi yahi hai aur bhi bahut se logon ne in waqiyat ko bahut tafseel se bayan kiya hai lekin sab ki asal yahi hai ke woh Bani Israel aur Ahl-e-Kitab se liye gaye hain. Wallahu A'lam. Shaibani farmate hain aap ne apni angoothi Asqalan mein payi thi aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak tawazan aap paidal chale the. Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne sifat-e-Suleman mein Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar se ek ajeeb khabar riwayat ki hai. Abu Ishaq Misri kehte hain ke jab (اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ) (89).

(Al-Fajr: 7) ke qissay se Hazrat Ka'ab ne faraghat hasil ki toh Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne kaha Abu Ishaq aap Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki kursi ka zikr bhi kijiye. Farmaya ke woh hathi daant ki thi aur yaqoot, zabarjad aur lulu se murassa thi aur us ke charon taraf sonay ke khajoor ke darakht banay huay thay jin ke khushay bhi motiyon ke thay. Un mein se jo dayin janib thay un ke siray par sonay ke mor thay aur bayin taraf walon par sonay ke gidh thay. Is kursi ke pehlay darjay par dayin janib sonay ke do darakht sanobar ke thay aur bayin janib sonay ke do sher banay huay thay. Un ke siron par zabarjad ke do sutoon thay aur kursi ke donon janib angoor ki sunheri belein thin jo kursi ko dhanpay huay thin, us ke khushay bhi surkh moti ke thay. Phir kursi ke aala darjay par do sher bohat baray sonay ke banay huay thay jin ke andar khol tha, un mein mushk-o-ambar bhara rehta tha. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) kursi par aatay toh yeh sher harkat karte aur un ke ghoomnay se un ke andar se mushk-o-ambar charon taraf chhirak diya jata. Phir do mimbar sonay ke bichha diye jatay, ek aap ke wazeer ka aur ek us waqt ke sab se baray aalim ka. Phir kursi ke samnay sattar mimbar sonay ke aur bichhaye jatay jin par Bani Israel ke qazi, un ke ulama aur un ke sardar baithtay. Un ke peechay paintis mimbar sonay ke aur hotay thay jo khali raha kartay thay. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) jab tashreef laatay, pehlay zeenay par qadam rakhtay hi kursi un tamam cheezon samet ghoom jati, sher apna dayna qadam aagay barha deta aur gidh apna bayan par phaila deta. Jab doosray darjay par qadam rakhtay toh sher apna bayan paon phaila deta aur gidh apna dayan par. Jab aap teesray darjay par charh jatay aur kursi par baith jatay toh ek bara gidh aap ka taaj le kar aap ke sar par rakhta, phir kursi zor zor se ghoomti. Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne poocha aakhir is ki kya wajah? Farmaya woh ek sonay ki laat par thi jisay Sakhr Jinn ne banaya tha. Us ke ghoomtay hi neechay walay mor, gidh waghera sab oopar aa jatay aur sar jhukatay, par pharpharate jis se aap ke jism par mushk-o-ambar ka chhirkao ho jata. Phir ek sonay ka kabootar Taurat utha kar aap ke haath mein deta jisay aap tilawat farmatay. Lekin yeh riwayat bilkul ghareeb hai. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki dua ka matlab yeh hai ke mujhe aisa mulk de ke mujh se koi aur chheen na sakay jaise ke us jism ka waqea hua jo aap ki kursi par daal diya gaya tha. Yeh matlab nahin ke aap doosron ke liye aisay mulk ke na milnay ki dua kartay hon. Lekin jin ba'az logon ne yeh ma'ani liye hain woh kuch theek nazar nahin aatay, balkay sahih matlab yahi hai ke aap ki dua ka yahi matlab tha ke mujhe aisa mulk aur saltanat di jaye ke mere baad phir kisi aur shakhs ko aisi saltanat na milay. Yahi aayat ke alfaaz se maloom hota hai aur yahi ahadees se bhi sabit hota hai.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba farmaya ek sarkash jinn ne guzashta shab mujh par zyadati ki aur meri namaz bigad dena chahi lekin Allah ne mujhe us par qabu de diya aur main ne chaha ke use masjid ke us sutoon se bandh doon taake subah tum sab use dekho lekin usi waqt mujhe mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki dua yaad aa gayi. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Rooh farmate hain phir Huzoor ﷺ ne use zaleel-o-khwar kar ke chhod diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ namaz mein khade hue to hum ne suna ke aap ne farmaya A'uzu billahi minka phir aap ne teen baar farmaya Al'anuka bi la'natillah phir aap ne apna haath is tarah badhaya ke goya aap kisi cheez ko lena chahte hain. Jab farigh hue to hum ne aap se in dono baaton ki wajah poochhi aap ne farmaya Allah ka dushman Iblees aag lekar mere munh mein daalne ke liye aaya to main ne teen martaba A'uzu padhi phir teen martaba us par la'nat bheji lekin woh phir bhi na hata phir main ne chaha ke use pakad kar bandh doon taake Madine ke ladke us se khelein agar hamare bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to main yahi karta. Hazrat Ata bin Yazeed Laithi namaz padh rahe the jo Abu Ubaid ne un ke samne se guzarna chaha unhon ne unhein apne haath se rok diya phir farmaya mujh se Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri ne hadith bayan ki ke Huzoor ﷺ subah ki namaz padha rahe the yeh bhi aap ke peeche the qira'at aap par khalt-malt ho gayi farigh ho kar farmaya kaash tum dekhte ke main ne Iblees ko pakad liya tha aur is qadar us ka gala ghonta ke us ke munh ki jhaag meri shahadat ki aur beech ki ungli par padi agar mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to woh subah hote is masjid ke sutoon se bandha hua hota aur Madina ke bachche use satate tum se jahan tak ho sake is baat ka khayal rakho ke namaz ki halat mein tumhare samne se koi guzarne na paye (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai Rabia bin Yazeed Abdullah Yalami kehte hain main Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A ke paas Taif ke ek baagh mein gaya jis ka naam Rabt tha aap us waqt ek Quraishi ka muhasra kiye hue the jo zaani aur sharabi tha. Main ne un se kaha mujhe pata chala hai ke aap yeh hadith bayan farmate hain ke jo ek ghoont sharab piye ga Allah Ta'ala chalees din tak us ki tauba qabool na farmaye ga aur bura aadmi woh hai jo maa ke pet mein hi bura ho gaya hai jo shakhs sirf namaz hi ki niyat se Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid mein jaye to woh gunahon se aisa paak ho jata hai jaise aaj hi paida hua. Woh sharabi jise Hazrat Abdullah pakde hue the woh sharab ka zikr sunte hi jhatka de kar apna haath chuda kar bhaag gaya. Ab Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya kisi ko halal nahin ke mere zimme woh baat kare jo main ne na ki. Main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yun suna hai jo shakhs sharab ka ek ghoont bhi pi le us ki chalees din ki namaz namaqbool hai. Agar woh tauba kare to Allah us ki tauba qabool farmata hai.

Phir agar dobara laute to phir chalees din tak ki namazein namaqbool hain phir agar tauba karle to tauba maqbool hai mujhe achi tarah yaad nahin ke teesri ya chauthi martaba mein farmaya ke phir agar laute ga to yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala use jahannumiyon ke badan ka khoon, peep, peshab waghera qayamat ke din pilaye ga aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apni makhlooq ko andhere mein paida kiya phir un par apna noor dala jis par woh noor us din pad gaya woh to hidayat wala ho gaya aur jis tak woh noor na pahuncha woh bhatak gaya. Isi liye main kehta hoon ke Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ke ilm ke mutabiq qalam chal chuka aur main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala se teen duayein ki jin mein se do to unhein mil gayin aur hamein umeed hai ke teesri hamare liye ho (1) Mujhe aisa hukm de jo tere hukm ke muwafiq ho (2) Mujhe aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke liye laiq na ho. Teesri dua yeh thi ke jo shakhs apne ghar se is masjid ki namaz ke irade hi se nikle to jab woh laute to aisa ho jaye goya aaj paida hua pas hamein Allah se umeed hai ke yeh hamare liye Allah ne di ho. Tabrani mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko apne liye ek ghar banane ka hukm diya Hazrat Dawood ne pehle apna ghar bana liya us par wahi aayi ke tum ne apna ghar mere ghar se pehle banaya aap ne arz kiya parwardigar yahi faisla kiya gaya tha phir masjid banani shuru ki deewarein poori ho gayin to ittefaqan tihai hissa gir gaya aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki jawab mila ke tu mera ghar nahin bana sakta. Poocha kyun? Farmaya is liye ke tere hathon se khoon baha hai. Arz kiya Allah Ta'ala woh bhi teri hi mohabbat mein farmaya haan lekin woh mere bande the main un par raham karta hoon. Aap ko yeh kalam sun kar sakht pareshani hui. Phir wahi aayi ke ghamgeen na ho main ise tere ladke Sulaiman ke hathon poora karaunga. Chunancha aap ke inteqal ke baad Hazrat Sulaiman ne ise banana shuru kiya jab poora kar chuke to badi badi qurbaniyan keen aur zabiha zibah kiye aur Bani Israel ko jama kar ke khoob khilaya pilaya Allah ki wahi aayi ke tu ne yeh sab kuch mere hukm ki tameel ki khushi mein kiya hai to mujh se maang jo mange ga paye ga. Arz kiya ke Allah Ta'ala mere teen sawal hain mujhe aisa faisla samjha jo tere faisle ke mutabiq ho aur aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho aur jo is ghar mein aaye sirf namaz ke irade se to woh apne gunahon se aisa azad ho jaye jaise aaj paida hua. In mein se do cheezein to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ata farma dein aur mujhe umeed hai ke teesri bhi de di gayi ho.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni har dua ko in lafzon se shuru farmate (Subhanallahi Rabbiyal A'lal Aliyyil Wahhab) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke inteqal ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se farmaya mujh se apni haajat talab karo. Aap ne arz kiya Allah Ta'ala mujhe aisa dil de jo tujh se darta rahe jaisa ke mere walid ka dil tujh se khauf kiya karta tha aur mere dil mein apni mohabbat daal de jaise ke mere walid ke dil mein teri mohabbat thi. Is par Allah Ta'ala bahut khush hua ke mera banda meri ain ata ke waqt bhi mujh se dara aur meri mohabbat talab karta hai, mujhe apni qasam main ise itni badi saltanat doonga jo is ke baad kisi ko na mile. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne un ki matahuti mein hawayein kar dein aur jinnaat ko bhi un ka matahat bana diya aur isi qadar mulk-o-maal par bhi, unhein hisab-e-qayamat se azaad kar diya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke Bari Ta'ala Sulaiman ke sath bhi isi lutf-o-karam se pesh aana jaisa aaj lutf-o-karam tera mujh par raha, to wahi aayi ke Sulaiman se keh do woh bhi isi tarah mera rahe jis tarah tu mera tha, to main bhi us ke sath ho. Khubsurat pyare wafadar tez-rau ghodon ko kaat dala to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne unhein un ke ewaz un se behtar ata farmaye. Yani hawa ko un ke tabe-e-farman kar diya jo mahine bhar ki raah ko subh ki ek ghadi mein tay kar deti thi aur isi tarah shaam ko jahan ka irada karte zara si der mein pahuncha deti. Jinnaat ko bhi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke tabe kar diya, un mein se baaz badi unchi lambi sangeen pukhta imarat ke banane ke kaam sar-anjaam dete jo insani taqat se bahar tha aur baaz ghota-khor thay jo samundar ki teh mein se lulu jawahar aur deegar qisam qisam ki nafees-o-nadir cheezein la dete thay. Phir aur kuch thay jo bhari bhari bediyon mein jakde rehte thay. Yeh ya to woh thay jo hukumat se sartabi karte thay ya kaam-kaaj mein shararat aur kami karte thay ya logon ko satate aur eeza dete thay. Yeh hai hamari meherbani aur hamari bakhshish aur hamara inaam aur hamara atiya, ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai jis se jo chahe sulook kar sab be-hisab hai kisi par pakad nahin. Jo teri zaban se niklega woh haq hoga. Sahih hadith mein hai jab Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ikhtiyar diya gaya ke agar chahein abd-o-rasool rahein yani jo hukm kiya jaye baja late rahein Allah ke farman ke mutabiq taqseem karte rahein aur agar chahein nabi aur badshah bana diye jayein jise chahein dein jise chahein na dein aur is ka koi hisab Allah ke han na liya jaye to aap ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se mashwara liya aur aap ke mashware se pehli baat qabool farmayi kyunke fazeelat ke lihaz se aula aur aala wahi hai. Go nabuwat-o-saltanat bhi badi cheez hai. Isi liye Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka dunyawi izz-o-jah bayan karte hi farmaya ke woh dar-e-akhirat mein bhi hamare paas bade martabe aur behtareen buzurgi aur aala-tar qareeb wala hai.

Sulaiman A.S ka tafseeli tazkira. Hum ne Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka imtehan liya aur un ki kursi par ek jism daal diya, yani shaitan phir woh apne takht-o-taj ki taraf laut aaye. Is shaitan ka naam Sakhr tha ya Asif tha ya Saro tha ya Haqeeq tha. Yeh waqea aksar mufassireen ne zikr kiya hai, kisi ne tafseel ke sath, kisi ne ikhtisar ke sath. Hazrat Qatada R.A is waqea ko is tarah bayan karte hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki tameer ka is tarah hukum hua ke lohay ki aawaz bhi na suni jaye. Aap ne har chand tadbeerein keen, lekin kargar na huin. Phir aap ne suna ke samundar mein ek shaitan hai jis ka naam Sakhr hai, woh albatta aisi tarkeeb bata sakta hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke ise kisi tarah lao. Ek darya samundar mein milta tha, har saatwein din is mein labalab pani aa jata tha aur yahi pani yeh shaitan peeta tha. Is ka pani nikal diya gaya aur bilkul khali kar ke pani ko band kar ke is ke aane wale din ise sharab se pur kar diya gaya. Jab shaitan aaya aur yeh haal dekha to kehne laga yeh to mazay ki cheez hai lekin aql ki dushman jahalat ko taraqqi dene wali cheez hai. Chunancha woh pyasa hi chala gaya. Jab pyas ki shiddat hui to majbooran yeh sab kuch kehte hue peena hi para. Ab aql jati rahi aur ise Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki angoothi dikhayi gayi ya mondhon ke darmiyan se mohar laga di gayi. Yeh bebas ho gaya. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki hukumat isi angoothi ki wajah se thi. Jab yeh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas pohancha to aap ne ise yeh kaam sar-anjaam dene ka hukum diya. Yeh hudhud ke anday le aaya aur unhein jama kar ke un par sheesha rakh diya. Hudhud aaya, us ne apne anday dekhe, charon taraf ghooma lekin dekha ke hath nahin aa sakte, ur kar wapas chala gaya aur almas le aaya aur ise us sheeshay par rakh kar sheeshay ko kaatna shuru kar diya. Aakhir woh kat gaya aur hudhud apne anday le gaya aur is almas ko bhi le liya gaya aur isi se patthar kaat kaat kar imarat shuru hui. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S jab bait-ul-khala mein ya hammam mein jate to angoothi utaar jate. Ek din hammam mein jana tha aur yeh shaitan aap ke sath tha, aap us waqt farzi ghusal ke liye ja rahe thay, angoothi isi ko sonp di aur chale gaye. Us ne angoothi samundar mein phenk di aur shaitan par Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki shakal daal di gayi aur aap se takht-o-taj chhin gaya. Sab cheezon par shaitan ne qabza kar liya siwaye aap ki biwiyon ke. Ab is se bohat si ghair-maroof baatein zuhoor mein aane lageen. Is zamana mein ek sahib thay jo aise hi thay jaise Huzoor ﷺ ke zamana mein Hazrat Farooq R.A. Us ne kaha aazmaish karni chahiye, mujhe to yeh shakhs Sulaiman maloom nahin hota. Chunancha ek roz us ne kaha kyun janab! Agar koi shakhs raat ko junubi ho jaye aur mausam zara thanda ho aur woh suraj tulu hone tak ghusal na kare to koi harj to nahin? Us ne kaha hargiz nahin. Chalees din tak yeh takht-e-Sulaiman par raha, phir aap ki machli ke pait se angoothi mil gayi, hath mein daalte hi phir tamam cheezein aap ki muti ho gayin. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai.

Suddi farmate hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki ek sau biwiyan thin, aap ko sab se zyada aitbar un mein se ek biwi par tha jin ka naam Jarawah tha. Jab janabi hone ya pakhane jate to apni angoothi unhi ko sonp jate. Ek martaba aap pakhane gaye, peeche se ek shaitan aap hi ki surat bana kar aaya aur biwi sahiba se angoothi talab ki, aap ne de di. Yeh aate hi takht par baith gaya. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S aaye aur angoothi talab ki to biwi sahiba ne farmaya, aap angoothi to le gaye. Aap samajh gaye ke yeh Allah ki aazmaish hai, nihayat pareshan haal se mahal se nikal gaye. Is shaitan ne chalees din tak hukumat ki, lekin ahkam ki tabdeeli ko dekh kar ulama ne samajh liya ke yeh Sulaiman A.S nahin. Chunancha un ki jamaat aap ki biwiyon ke paas aayi aur un se kaha, yeh kya mamla hai? Hamein Sulaiman A.S ki zaat mein shak pad gaya. Agar yeh sach-much Sulaiman A.S hai to is ki aql jaati rahi hai ya yeh ke yeh Sulaiman A.S hi nahin, warna aise khilaf-e-shara ahkam na deta. Auratein yeh sun kar rone lagin. Yeh yahan se wapas aa gaye aur takht ke gird-o-pesh use gher kar baith gaye aur Taurat khol kar us ki tilawat shuru kar di. Yeh khabeeth shaitan Kalam-e-Allah se bhaga aur angoothi samundar mein phenk di jise ek machhli nigal gayi. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S yunhi apne din guzarte the, ek martaba samundar ke kinare nikal gaye, bhook bahut lagi hui thi. Mahi-geeron ko machhliyan pakadte hue dekh kar un ke paas aa kar un se ek machhli mangi aur apna naam bhi bataya. Is par baaz logon ko bada taish aaya ke dekho bheek mangne wala apne tayin Sulaiman A.S batata hai, unhon ne aap ko marna peetna shuru kiya, aap zakhmi ho kar kinare ja kar apne zakhm ka khoon dhone lage. Baaz mahi-geeron ko reham aa gaya ke ek sail ko khwah-makhwah mara, jao bhai ise do machhliyan de aao, bhooka hai bhun khaye ga. Chunancha woh machhliyan aap ko de aaye, bhook ki wajah se aap apne zakhm ko aur khoon ko to bhool gaye aur jaldi se machhli ka pait chaak karne baith gaye. Qudrat-e-Allah se us ke pait se woh angoothi nikli, aap ne Allah ki tareef bayan ki aur angoothi ungli mein daali. Us waqt parindon ne aa kar aap par saya kar liya aur logon ne aap ko pehchan liya aur aap se mazrat karne lage. Aap ne farmaya yeh sab Amr-e-Ilahi tha, Allah ki taraf se ek imtihan tha. Aap aaye apne takht par baith gaye aur hukum diya ke is shaitan ko jahan bhi woh ho giraftar kar lao, chunancha use qaid kar liya gaya. Aap ne use ek lohay ke sandook mein band kiya aur qufl laga kar us par apni mohar laga di aur samundar mein phenkwa diya jo Qayamat tak wahin qaid rahe ga. Is ka naam Haqeeq tha. Aap ki yeh dua ke mujhe aisa mulk ata farmaya jaye jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho, yeh bhi poori hui aur aap ke tabe hawayein kar di gayin. Mujahid se marwi hai ke ek shaitan se jis ka naam Asif tha, ek martaba Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne poocha ke tum logon ko kis tarah fitne mein dalte ho?

Usne kaha zara mujhe angoothi dikhao main abhi aap ko dikha deta hoon, aap ne angoothi de di, usne use samundar mein phenk diya, takht-o-taj ka malik ban baitha aur aap ke libas mein logon ko rah-e-Allah se hatane laga. "Yaad rahe ke yeh sab waqiyat Bani Israel ke bayan karda hain" aur in sab se zyada munkar waqia woh hai jo Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai jiska oopar bayan hua, jismein aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Jarawah ka zikr hai. Ismein yeh bhi hai ke aakhir nabuwat yahan tak pahunchi thi ke ladke aap ko patthar maarte the. Aap ki biwiyon se jab ulama ne mamla ki tafteesh ki to unhon ne kaha ke haan hamein bhi iske Suleman hone se inkar hai kyunke woh halat-e-haiz mein hamare paas aata hai. Shaitan ko jab yeh maloom ho gaya ke raaz khul gaya hai to usne jadoo aur kufr ki kitabein likhwa kar kursi tale dafan kar diya aur phir logon ke samne unhein nikalwa kar unse kaha dekho in kitabon ki badaulat Suleman tum par hukumat kar raha tha, chunancha logon ne aap ko kafir kehna shuru kar diya. Hazrat Suleman samundar ke kinare mazdoori karte the, ek martaba ek shakhs ne bahut si machliyan khareedein, mazdoor ko bulaya, aap pahunche, usne kaha yeh utha lo, poocha mazdoori kya doge? Usne kaha ismein se ek machli tumhein de doonga, aap ne tokra sar par rakha, uske haan pahunchaya, usne ek machli de di, aap ne uska pait chaak kiya, pait chaak karte hi woh angoothi nikal padi, pehante hi kul shayateen, jinn, insaan phir tabe ho gaye aur jhurmat baandh kar hazir ho gaye, aap ne mulk par qabza kiya aur us shaitan ko sakht saza di. Pas "Summa Anab" se murad shaitan jo musallat kiya gaya tha uska lautna hai. Iski asnaad Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas tak hai. Hai to qawi lekin yeh zahir hai ke ise Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne Ahl-e-Kitab se liya hai, yeh bhi us waqt jab ise Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul maan lein. Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek jamaat Hazrat Suleman ko nahin manti thi to ajab nahin ke yeh behooda qissa usi khabeeth jamaat ka gadha hua ho. Ismein to woh cheezein bhi hain jo bilkul hi munkar hain, khusoosan us shaitan ka aap ki aurton ke paas jana aur aimma ne bhi aise hi qisse bayan to kiye hain lekin is baat ka sab ne inkar kiya hai aur kaha hai ke jinn unke paas nahin ja saka aur Nabi ke gharane ki aurton ki ismat-o-sharafat ka taqaza bhi yahi hai aur bhi bahut se logon ne in waqiyat ko bahut tafseel se bayan kiya hai lekin sab ki asal yahi hai ke woh Bani Israel aur Ahl-e-Kitab se liye gaye hain. Wallahu A'lam. Shaibani farmate hain aap ne apni angoothi Asqalan mein payi thi aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak tawazan aap paidal chale the. Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne sifat-e-Suleman mein Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar se ek ajeeb khabar riwayat ki hai. Abu Ishaq Misri kehte hain ke jab (اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ) (89).

(Al-Fajr: 7) ke qissay se Hazrat Ka'ab ne faraghat hasil ki toh Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne kaha Abu Ishaq aap Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki kursi ka zikr bhi kijiye. Farmaya ke woh hathi daant ki thi aur yaqoot, zabarjad aur lulu se murassa thi aur us ke charon taraf sonay ke khajoor ke darakht banay huay thay jin ke khushay bhi motiyon ke thay. Un mein se jo dayin janib thay un ke siray par sonay ke mor thay aur bayin taraf walon par sonay ke gidh thay. Is kursi ke pehlay darjay par dayin janib sonay ke do darakht sanobar ke thay aur bayin janib sonay ke do sher banay huay thay. Un ke siron par zabarjad ke do sutoon thay aur kursi ke donon janib angoor ki sunheri belein thin jo kursi ko dhanpay huay thin, us ke khushay bhi surkh moti ke thay. Phir kursi ke aala darjay par do sher bohat baray sonay ke banay huay thay jin ke andar khol tha, un mein mushk-o-ambar bhara rehta tha. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) kursi par aatay toh yeh sher harkat karte aur un ke ghoomnay se un ke andar se mushk-o-ambar charon taraf chhirak diya jata. Phir do mimbar sonay ke bichha diye jatay, ek aap ke wazeer ka aur ek us waqt ke sab se baray aalim ka. Phir kursi ke samnay sattar mimbar sonay ke aur bichhaye jatay jin par Bani Israel ke qazi, un ke ulama aur un ke sardar baithtay. Un ke peechay paintis mimbar sonay ke aur hotay thay jo khali raha kartay thay. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) jab tashreef laatay, pehlay zeenay par qadam rakhtay hi kursi un tamam cheezon samet ghoom jati, sher apna dayna qadam aagay barha deta aur gidh apna bayan par phaila deta. Jab doosray darjay par qadam rakhtay toh sher apna bayan paon phaila deta aur gidh apna dayan par. Jab aap teesray darjay par charh jatay aur kursi par baith jatay toh ek bara gidh aap ka taaj le kar aap ke sar par rakhta, phir kursi zor zor se ghoomti. Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne poocha aakhir is ki kya wajah? Farmaya woh ek sonay ki laat par thi jisay Sakhr Jinn ne banaya tha. Us ke ghoomtay hi neechay walay mor, gidh waghera sab oopar aa jatay aur sar jhukatay, par pharpharate jis se aap ke jism par mushk-o-ambar ka chhirkao ho jata. Phir ek sonay ka kabootar Taurat utha kar aap ke haath mein deta jisay aap tilawat farmatay. Lekin yeh riwayat bilkul ghareeb hai. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki dua ka matlab yeh hai ke mujhe aisa mulk de ke mujh se koi aur chheen na sakay jaise ke us jism ka waqea hua jo aap ki kursi par daal diya gaya tha. Yeh matlab nahin ke aap doosron ke liye aisay mulk ke na milnay ki dua kartay hon.
