Lekin jin ba'az logon ne yeh ma'ani liye hain woh kuch theek nazar nahin aatay, balkay sahih matlab yahi hai ke aap ki dua ka yahi matlab tha ke mujhe aisa mulk aur saltanat di jaye ke mere baad phir kisi aur shakhs ko aisi saltanat na milay. Yahi aayat ke alfaaz se maloom hota hai aur yahi ahadees se bhi sabit hota hai.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba farmaya ek sarkash jinn ne guzashta shab mujh par zyadati ki aur meri namaz bigad dena chahi lekin Allah ne mujhe us par qabu de diya aur main ne chaha ke use masjid ke us sutoon se bandh doon taake subah tum sab use dekho lekin usi waqt mujhe mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki dua yaad aa gayi. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Rooh farmate hain phir Huzoor ﷺ ne use zaleel-o-khwar kar ke chhod diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ namaz mein khade hue to hum ne suna ke aap ne farmaya A'uzu billahi minka phir aap ne teen baar farmaya Al'anuka bi la'natillah phir aap ne apna haath is tarah badhaya ke goya aap kisi cheez ko lena chahte hain. Jab farigh hue to hum ne aap se in dono baaton ki wajah poochhi aap ne farmaya Allah ka dushman Iblees aag lekar mere munh mein daalne ke liye aaya to main ne teen martaba A'uzu padhi phir teen martaba us par la'nat bheji lekin woh phir bhi na hata phir main ne chaha ke use pakad kar bandh doon taake Madine ke ladke us se khelein agar hamare bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to main yahi karta. Hazrat Ata bin Yazeed Laithi namaz padh rahe the jo Abu Ubaid ne un ke samne se guzarna chaha unhon ne unhein apne haath se rok diya phir farmaya mujh se Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri ne hadith bayan ki ke Huzoor ﷺ subah ki namaz padha rahe the yeh bhi aap ke peeche the qira'at aap par khalt-malt ho gayi farigh ho kar farmaya kaash tum dekhte ke main ne Iblees ko pakad liya tha aur is qadar us ka gala ghonta ke us ke munh ki jhaag meri shahadat ki aur beech ki ungli par padi agar mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to woh subah hote is masjid ke sutoon se bandha hua hota aur Madina ke bachche use satate tum se jahan tak ho sake is baat ka khayal rakho ke namaz ki halat mein tumhare samne se koi guzarne na paye (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai Rabia bin Yazeed Abdullah Yalami kehte hain main Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A ke paas Taif ke ek baagh mein gaya jis ka naam Rabt tha aap us waqt ek Quraishi ka muhasra kiye hue the jo zaani aur sharabi tha. Main ne un se kaha mujhe pata chala hai ke aap yeh hadith bayan farmate hain ke jo ek ghoont sharab piye ga Allah Ta'ala chalees din tak us ki tauba qabool na farmaye ga aur bura aadmi woh hai jo maa ke pet mein hi bura ho gaya hai jo shakhs sirf namaz hi ki niyat se Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid mein jaye to woh gunahon se aisa paak ho jata hai jaise aaj hi paida hua. Woh sharabi jise Hazrat Abdullah pakde hue the woh sharab ka zikr sunte hi jhatka de kar apna haath chuda kar bhaag gaya. Ab Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya kisi ko halal nahin ke mere zimme woh baat kare jo main ne na ki. Main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yun suna hai jo shakhs sharab ka ek ghoont bhi pi le us ki chalees din ki namaz namaqbool hai. Agar woh tauba kare to Allah us ki tauba qabool farmata hai.

Phir agar dobara laute to phir chalees din tak ki namazein namaqbool hain phir agar tauba karle to tauba maqbool hai mujhe achi tarah yaad nahin ke teesri ya chauthi martaba mein farmaya ke phir agar laute ga to yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala use jahannumiyon ke badan ka khoon, peep, peshab waghera qayamat ke din pilaye ga aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apni makhlooq ko andhere mein paida kiya phir un par apna noor dala jis par woh noor us din pad gaya woh to hidayat wala ho gaya aur jis tak woh noor na pahuncha woh bhatak gaya. Isi liye main kehta hoon ke Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ke ilm ke mutabiq qalam chal chuka aur main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala se teen duayein ki jin mein se do to unhein mil gayin aur hamein umeed hai ke teesri hamare liye ho (1) Mujhe aisa hukm de jo tere hukm ke muwafiq ho (2) Mujhe aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke liye laiq na ho. Teesri dua yeh thi ke jo shakhs apne ghar se is masjid ki namaz ke irade hi se nikle to jab woh laute to aisa ho jaye goya aaj paida hua pas hamein Allah se umeed hai ke yeh hamare liye Allah ne di ho. Tabrani mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko apne liye ek ghar banane ka hukm diya Hazrat Dawood ne pehle apna ghar bana liya us par wahi aayi ke tum ne apna ghar mere ghar se pehle banaya aap ne arz kiya parwardigar yahi faisla kiya gaya tha phir masjid banani shuru ki deewarein poori ho gayin to ittefaqan tihai hissa gir gaya aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki jawab mila ke tu mera ghar nahin bana sakta. Poocha kyun? Farmaya is liye ke tere hathon se khoon baha hai. Arz kiya Allah Ta'ala woh bhi teri hi mohabbat mein farmaya haan lekin woh mere bande the main un par raham karta hoon. Aap ko yeh kalam sun kar sakht pareshani hui. Phir wahi aayi ke ghamgeen na ho main ise tere ladke Sulaiman ke hathon poora karaunga. Chunancha aap ke inteqal ke baad Hazrat Sulaiman ne ise banana shuru kiya jab poora kar chuke to badi badi qurbaniyan keen aur zabiha zibah kiye aur Bani Israel ko jama kar ke khoob khilaya pilaya Allah ki wahi aayi ke tu ne yeh sab kuch mere hukm ki tameel ki khushi mein kiya hai to mujh se maang jo mange ga paye ga. Arz kiya ke Allah Ta'ala mere teen sawal hain mujhe aisa faisla samjha jo tere faisle ke mutabiq ho aur aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho aur jo is ghar mein aaye sirf namaz ke irade se to woh apne gunahon se aisa azad ho jaye jaise aaj paida hua. In mein se do cheezein to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ata farma dein aur mujhe umeed hai ke teesri bhi de di gayi ho.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni har dua ko in lafzon se shuru farmate (Subhanallahi Rabbiyal A'lal Aliyyil Wahhab) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke inteqal ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se farmaya mujh se apni haajat talab karo. Aap ne arz kiya Allah Ta'ala mujhe aisa dil de jo tujh se darta rahe jaisa ke mere walid ka dil tujh se khauf kiya karta tha aur mere dil mein apni mohabbat daal de jaise ke mere walid ke dil mein teri mohabbat thi. Is par Allah Ta'ala bahut khush hua ke mera banda meri ain ata ke waqt bhi mujh se dara aur meri mohabbat talab karta hai, mujhe apni qasam main ise itni badi saltanat doonga jo is ke baad kisi ko na mile. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne un ki matahuti mein hawayein kar dein aur jinnaat ko bhi un ka matahat bana diya aur isi qadar mulk-o-maal par bhi, unhein hisab-e-qayamat se azaad kar diya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke Bari Ta'ala Sulaiman ke sath bhi isi lutf-o-karam se pesh aana jaisa aaj lutf-o-karam tera mujh par raha, to wahi aayi ke Sulaiman se keh do woh bhi isi tarah mera rahe jis tarah tu mera tha, to main bhi us ke sath ho. Khubsurat pyare wafadar tez-rau ghodon ko kaat dala to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne unhein un ke ewaz un se behtar ata farmaye. Yani hawa ko un ke tabe-e-farman kar diya jo mahine bhar ki raah ko subh ki ek ghadi mein tay kar deti thi aur isi tarah shaam ko jahan ka irada karte zara si der mein pahuncha deti. Jinnaat ko bhi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke tabe kar diya, un mein se baaz badi unchi lambi sangeen pukhta imarat ke banane ke kaam sar-anjaam dete jo insani taqat se bahar tha aur baaz ghota-khor thay jo samundar ki teh mein se lulu jawahar aur deegar qisam qisam ki nafees-o-nadir cheezein la dete thay. Phir aur kuch thay jo bhari bhari bediyon mein jakde rehte thay. Yeh ya to woh thay jo hukumat se sartabi karte thay ya kaam-kaaj mein shararat aur kami karte thay ya logon ko satate aur eeza dete thay. Yeh hai hamari meherbani aur hamari bakhshish aur hamara inaam aur hamara atiya, ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai jis se jo chahe sulook kar sab be-hisab hai kisi par pakad nahin. Jo teri zaban se niklega woh haq hoga. Sahih hadith mein hai jab Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ikhtiyar diya gaya ke agar chahein abd-o-rasool rahein yani jo hukm kiya jaye baja late rahein Allah ke farman ke mutabiq taqseem karte rahein aur agar chahein nabi aur badshah bana diye jayein jise chahein dein jise chahein na dein aur is ka koi hisab Allah ke han na liya jaye to aap ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se mashwara liya aur aap ke mashware se pehli baat qabool farmayi kyunke fazeelat ke lihaz se aula aur aala wahi hai. Go nabuwat-o-saltanat bhi badi cheez hai. Isi liye Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka dunyawi izz-o-jah bayan karte hi farmaya ke woh dar-e-akhirat mein bhi hamare paas bade martabe aur behtareen buzurgi aur aala-tar qareeb wala hai.

Sulaiman A.S ka tafseeli tazkira. Hum ne Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka imtehan liya aur un ki kursi par ek jism daal diya, yani shaitan phir woh apne takht-o-taj ki taraf laut aaye. Is shaitan ka naam Sakhr tha ya Asif tha ya Saro tha ya Haqeeq tha. Yeh waqea aksar mufassireen ne zikr kiya hai, kisi ne tafseel ke sath, kisi ne ikhtisar ke sath. Hazrat Qatada R.A is waqea ko is tarah bayan karte hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki tameer ka is tarah hukum hua ke lohay ki aawaz bhi na suni jaye. Aap ne har chand tadbeerein keen, lekin kargar na huin. Phir aap ne suna ke samundar mein ek shaitan hai jis ka naam Sakhr hai, woh albatta aisi tarkeeb bata sakta hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke ise kisi tarah lao. Ek darya samundar mein milta tha, har saatwein din is mein labalab pani aa jata tha aur yahi pani yeh shaitan peeta tha. Is ka pani nikal diya gaya aur bilkul khali kar ke pani ko band kar ke is ke aane wale din ise sharab se pur kar diya gaya. Jab shaitan aaya aur yeh haal dekha to kehne laga yeh to mazay ki cheez hai lekin aql ki dushman jahalat ko taraqqi dene wali cheez hai. Chunancha woh pyasa hi chala gaya. Jab pyas ki shiddat hui to majbooran yeh sab kuch kehte hue peena hi para. Ab aql jati rahi aur ise Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki angoothi dikhayi gayi ya mondhon ke darmiyan se mohar laga di gayi. Yeh bebas ho gaya. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki hukumat isi angoothi ki wajah se thi. Jab yeh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas pohancha to aap ne ise yeh kaam sar-anjaam dene ka hukum diya. Yeh hudhud ke anday le aaya aur unhein jama kar ke un par sheesha rakh diya. Hudhud aaya, us ne apne anday dekhe, charon taraf ghooma lekin dekha ke hath nahin aa sakte, ur kar wapas chala gaya aur almas le aaya aur ise us sheeshay par rakh kar sheeshay ko kaatna shuru kar diya. Aakhir woh kat gaya aur hudhud apne anday le gaya aur is almas ko bhi le liya gaya aur isi se patthar kaat kaat kar imarat shuru hui. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S jab bait-ul-khala mein ya hammam mein jate to angoothi utaar jate. Ek din hammam mein jana tha aur yeh shaitan aap ke sath tha, aap us waqt farzi ghusal ke liye ja rahe thay, angoothi isi ko sonp di aur chale gaye. Us ne angoothi samundar mein phenk di aur shaitan par Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki shakal daal di gayi aur aap se takht-o-taj chhin gaya. Sab cheezon par shaitan ne qabza kar liya siwaye aap ki biwiyon ke. Ab is se bohat si ghair-maroof baatein zuhoor mein aane lageen. Is zamana mein ek sahib thay jo aise hi thay jaise Huzoor ﷺ ke zamana mein Hazrat Farooq R.A. Us ne kaha aazmaish karni chahiye, mujhe to yeh shakhs Sulaiman maloom nahin hota. Chunancha ek roz us ne kaha kyun janab! Agar koi shakhs raat ko junubi ho jaye aur mausam zara thanda ho aur woh suraj tulu hone tak ghusal na kare to koi harj to nahin? Us ne kaha hargiz nahin. Chalees din tak yeh takht-e-Sulaiman par raha, phir aap ki machli ke pait se angoothi mil gayi, hath mein daalte hi phir tamam cheezein aap ki muti ho gayin. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai.

Suddi farmate hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki ek sau biwiyan thin, aap ko sab se zyada aitbar un mein se ek biwi par tha jin ka naam Jarawah tha. Jab janabi hone ya pakhane jate to apni angoothi unhi ko sonp jate. Ek martaba aap pakhane gaye, peeche se ek shaitan aap hi ki surat bana kar aaya aur biwi sahiba se angoothi talab ki, aap ne de di. Yeh aate hi takht par baith gaya. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S aaye aur angoothi talab ki to biwi sahiba ne farmaya, aap angoothi to le gaye. Aap samajh gaye ke yeh Allah ki aazmaish hai, nihayat pareshan haal se mahal se nikal gaye. Is shaitan ne chalees din tak hukumat ki, lekin ahkam ki tabdeeli ko dekh kar ulama ne samajh liya ke yeh Sulaiman A.S nahin. Chunancha un ki jamaat aap ki biwiyon ke paas aayi aur un se kaha, yeh kya mamla hai? Hamein Sulaiman A.S ki zaat mein shak pad gaya. Agar yeh sach-much Sulaiman A.S hai to is ki aql jaati rahi hai ya yeh ke yeh Sulaiman A.S hi nahin, warna aise khilaf-e-shara ahkam na deta. Auratein yeh sun kar rone lagin. Yeh yahan se wapas aa gaye aur takht ke gird-o-pesh use gher kar baith gaye aur Taurat khol kar us ki tilawat shuru kar di. Yeh khabeeth shaitan Kalam-e-Allah se bhaga aur angoothi samundar mein phenk di jise ek machhli nigal gayi. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S yunhi apne din guzarte the, ek martaba samundar ke kinare nikal gaye, bhook bahut lagi hui thi. Mahi-geeron ko machhliyan pakadte hue dekh kar un ke paas aa kar un se ek machhli mangi aur apna naam bhi bataya. Is par baaz logon ko bada taish aaya ke dekho bheek mangne wala apne tayin Sulaiman A.S batata hai, unhon ne aap ko marna peetna shuru kiya, aap zakhmi ho kar kinare ja kar apne zakhm ka khoon dhone lage. Baaz mahi-geeron ko reham aa gaya ke ek sail ko khwah-makhwah mara, jao bhai ise do machhliyan de aao, bhooka hai bhun khaye ga. Chunancha woh machhliyan aap ko de aaye, bhook ki wajah se aap apne zakhm ko aur khoon ko to bhool gaye aur jaldi se machhli ka pait chaak karne baith gaye. Qudrat-e-Allah se us ke pait se woh angoothi nikli, aap ne Allah ki tareef bayan ki aur angoothi ungli mein daali. Us waqt parindon ne aa kar aap par saya kar liya aur logon ne aap ko pehchan liya aur aap se mazrat karne lage. Aap ne farmaya yeh sab Amr-e-Ilahi tha, Allah ki taraf se ek imtihan tha. Aap aaye apne takht par baith gaye aur hukum diya ke is shaitan ko jahan bhi woh ho giraftar kar lao, chunancha use qaid kar liya gaya. Aap ne use ek lohay ke sandook mein band kiya aur qufl laga kar us par apni mohar laga di aur samundar mein phenkwa diya jo Qayamat tak wahin qaid rahe ga. Is ka naam Haqeeq tha. Aap ki yeh dua ke mujhe aisa mulk ata farmaya jaye jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho, yeh bhi poori hui aur aap ke tabe hawayein kar di gayin. Mujahid se marwi hai ke ek shaitan se jis ka naam Asif tha, ek martaba Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne poocha ke tum logon ko kis tarah fitne mein dalte ho?

Usne kaha zara mujhe angoothi dikhao main abhi aap ko dikha deta hoon, aap ne angoothi de di, usne use samundar mein phenk diya, takht-o-taj ka malik ban baitha aur aap ke libas mein logon ko rah-e-Allah se hatane laga. "Yaad rahe ke yeh sab waqiyat Bani Israel ke bayan karda hain" aur in sab se zyada munkar waqia woh hai jo Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai jiska oopar bayan hua, jismein aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Jarawah ka zikr hai. Ismein yeh bhi hai ke aakhir nabuwat yahan tak pahunchi thi ke ladke aap ko patthar maarte the. Aap ki biwiyon se jab ulama ne mamla ki tafteesh ki to unhon ne kaha ke haan hamein bhi iske Suleman hone se inkar hai kyunke woh halat-e-haiz mein hamare paas aata hai. Shaitan ko jab yeh maloom ho gaya ke raaz khul gaya hai to usne jadoo aur kufr ki kitabein likhwa kar kursi tale dafan kar diya aur phir logon ke samne unhein nikalwa kar unse kaha dekho in kitabon ki badaulat Suleman tum par hukumat kar raha tha, chunancha logon ne aap ko kafir kehna shuru kar diya. Hazrat Suleman samundar ke kinare mazdoori karte the, ek martaba ek shakhs ne bahut si machliyan khareedein, mazdoor ko bulaya, aap pahunche, usne kaha yeh utha lo, poocha mazdoori kya doge? Usne kaha ismein se ek machli tumhein de doonga, aap ne tokra sar par rakha, uske haan pahunchaya, usne ek machli de di, aap ne uska pait chaak kiya, pait chaak karte hi woh angoothi nikal padi, pehante hi kul shayateen, jinn, insaan phir tabe ho gaye aur jhurmat baandh kar hazir ho gaye, aap ne mulk par qabza kiya aur us shaitan ko sakht saza di. Pas "Summa Anab" se murad shaitan jo musallat kiya gaya tha uska lautna hai. Iski asnaad Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas tak hai. Hai to qawi lekin yeh zahir hai ke ise Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne Ahl-e-Kitab se liya hai, yeh bhi us waqt jab ise Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul maan lein. Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek jamaat Hazrat Suleman ko nahin manti thi to ajab nahin ke yeh behooda qissa usi khabeeth jamaat ka gadha hua ho. Ismein to woh cheezein bhi hain jo bilkul hi munkar hain, khusoosan us shaitan ka aap ki aurton ke paas jana aur aimma ne bhi aise hi qisse bayan to kiye hain lekin is baat ka sab ne inkar kiya hai aur kaha hai ke jinn unke paas nahin ja saka aur Nabi ke gharane ki aurton ki ismat-o-sharafat ka taqaza bhi yahi hai aur bhi bahut se logon ne in waqiyat ko bahut tafseel se bayan kiya hai lekin sab ki asal yahi hai ke woh Bani Israel aur Ahl-e-Kitab se liye gaye hain. Wallahu A'lam. Shaibani farmate hain aap ne apni angoothi Asqalan mein payi thi aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak tawazan aap paidal chale the. Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne sifat-e-Suleman mein Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar se ek ajeeb khabar riwayat ki hai. Abu Ishaq Misri kehte hain ke jab (اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ) (89).

(Al-Fajr: 7) ke qissay se Hazrat Ka'ab ne faraghat hasil ki toh Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne kaha Abu Ishaq aap Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki kursi ka zikr bhi kijiye. Farmaya ke woh hathi daant ki thi aur yaqoot, zabarjad aur lulu se murassa thi aur us ke charon taraf sonay ke khajoor ke darakht banay huay thay jin ke khushay bhi motiyon ke thay. Un mein se jo dayin janib thay un ke siray par sonay ke mor thay aur bayin taraf walon par sonay ke gidh thay. Is kursi ke pehlay darjay par dayin janib sonay ke do darakht sanobar ke thay aur bayin janib sonay ke do sher banay huay thay. Un ke siron par zabarjad ke do sutoon thay aur kursi ke donon janib angoor ki sunheri belein thin jo kursi ko dhanpay huay thin, us ke khushay bhi surkh moti ke thay. Phir kursi ke aala darjay par do sher bohat baray sonay ke banay huay thay jin ke andar khol tha, un mein mushk-o-ambar bhara rehta tha. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) kursi par aatay toh yeh sher harkat karte aur un ke ghoomnay se un ke andar se mushk-o-ambar charon taraf chhirak diya jata. Phir do mimbar sonay ke bichha diye jatay, ek aap ke wazeer ka aur ek us waqt ke sab se baray aalim ka. Phir kursi ke samnay sattar mimbar sonay ke aur bichhaye jatay jin par Bani Israel ke qazi, un ke ulama aur un ke sardar baithtay. Un ke peechay paintis mimbar sonay ke aur hotay thay jo khali raha kartay thay. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) jab tashreef laatay, pehlay zeenay par qadam rakhtay hi kursi un tamam cheezon samet ghoom jati, sher apna dayna qadam aagay barha deta aur gidh apna bayan par phaila deta. Jab doosray darjay par qadam rakhtay toh sher apna bayan paon phaila deta aur gidh apna dayan par. Jab aap teesray darjay par charh jatay aur kursi par baith jatay toh ek bara gidh aap ka taaj le kar aap ke sar par rakhta, phir kursi zor zor se ghoomti. Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne poocha aakhir is ki kya wajah? Farmaya woh ek sonay ki laat par thi jisay Sakhr Jinn ne banaya tha. Us ke ghoomtay hi neechay walay mor, gidh waghera sab oopar aa jatay aur sar jhukatay, par pharpharate jis se aap ke jism par mushk-o-ambar ka chhirkao ho jata. Phir ek sonay ka kabootar Taurat utha kar aap ke haath mein deta jisay aap tilawat farmatay. Lekin yeh riwayat bilkul ghareeb hai. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki dua ka matlab yeh hai ke mujhe aisa mulk de ke mujh se koi aur chheen na sakay jaise ke us jism ka waqea hua jo aap ki kursi par daal diya gaya tha. Yeh matlab nahin ke aap doosron ke liye aisay mulk ke na milnay ki dua kartay hon. Lekin jin ba'az logon ne yeh ma'ani liye hain woh kuch theek nazar nahin aatay, balkay sahih matlab yahi hai ke aap ki dua ka yahi matlab tha ke mujhe aisa mulk aur saltanat di jaye ke mere baad phir kisi aur shakhs ko aisi saltanat na milay. Yahi aayat ke alfaaz se maloom hota hai aur yahi ahadees se bhi sabit hota hai.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba farmaya ek sarkash jinn ne guzashta shab mujh par zyadati ki aur meri namaz bigad dena chahi lekin Allah ne mujhe us par qabu de diya aur main ne chaha ke use masjid ke us sutoon se bandh doon taake subah tum sab use dekho lekin usi waqt mujhe mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki dua yaad aa gayi. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Rooh farmate hain phir Huzoor ﷺ ne use zaleel-o-khwar kar ke chhod diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ namaz mein khade hue to hum ne suna ke aap ne farmaya A'uzu billahi minka phir aap ne teen baar farmaya Al'anuka bi la'natillah phir aap ne apna haath is tarah badhaya ke goya aap kisi cheez ko lena chahte hain. Jab farigh hue to hum ne aap se in dono baaton ki wajah poochhi aap ne farmaya Allah ka dushman Iblees aag lekar mere munh mein daalne ke liye aaya to main ne teen martaba A'uzu padhi phir teen martaba us par la'nat bheji lekin woh phir bhi na hata phir main ne chaha ke use pakad kar bandh doon taake Madine ke ladke us se khelein agar hamare bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to main yahi karta. Hazrat Ata bin Yazeed Laithi namaz padh rahe the jo Abu Ubaid ne un ke samne se guzarna chaha unhon ne unhein apne haath se rok diya phir farmaya mujh se Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri ne hadith bayan ki ke Huzoor ﷺ subah ki namaz padha rahe the yeh bhi aap ke peeche the qira'at aap par khalt-malt ho gayi farigh ho kar farmaya kaash tum dekhte ke main ne Iblees ko pakad liya tha aur is qadar us ka gala ghonta ke us ke munh ki jhaag meri shahadat ki aur beech ki ungli par padi agar mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to woh subah hote is masjid ke sutoon se bandha hua hota aur Madina ke bachche use satate tum se jahan tak ho sake is baat ka khayal rakho ke namaz ki halat mein tumhare samne se koi guzarne na paye (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai Rabia bin Yazeed Abdullah Yalami kehte hain main Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A ke paas Taif ke ek baagh mein gaya jis ka naam Rabt tha aap us waqt ek Quraishi ka muhasra kiye hue the jo zaani aur sharabi tha. Main ne un se kaha mujhe pata chala hai ke aap yeh hadith bayan farmate hain ke jo ek ghoont sharab piye ga Allah Ta'ala chalees din tak us ki tauba qabool na farmaye ga aur bura aadmi woh hai jo maa ke pet mein hi bura ho gaya hai jo shakhs sirf namaz hi ki niyat se Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid mein jaye to woh gunahon se aisa paak ho jata hai jaise aaj hi paida hua. Woh sharabi jise Hazrat Abdullah pakde hue the woh sharab ka zikr sunte hi jhatka de kar apna haath chuda kar bhaag gaya. Ab Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya kisi ko halal nahin ke mere zimme woh baat kare jo main ne na ki. Main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yun suna hai jo shakhs sharab ka ek ghoont bhi pi le us ki chalees din ki namaz namaqbool hai. Agar woh tauba kare to Allah us ki tauba qabool farmata hai.

Phir agar dobara laute to phir chalees din tak ki namazein namaqbool hain phir agar tauba karle to tauba maqbool hai mujhe achi tarah yaad nahin ke teesri ya chauthi martaba mein farmaya ke phir agar laute ga to yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala use jahannumiyon ke badan ka khoon, peep, peshab waghera qayamat ke din pilaye ga aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apni makhlooq ko andhere mein paida kiya phir un par apna noor dala jis par woh noor us din pad gaya woh to hidayat wala ho gaya aur jis tak woh noor na pahuncha woh bhatak gaya. Isi liye main kehta hoon ke Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ke ilm ke mutabiq qalam chal chuka aur main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala se teen duayein ki jin mein se do to unhein mil gayin aur hamein umeed hai ke teesri hamare liye ho (1) Mujhe aisa hukm de jo tere hukm ke muwafiq ho (2) Mujhe aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke liye laiq na ho. Teesri dua yeh thi ke jo shakhs apne ghar se is masjid ki namaz ke irade hi se nikle to jab woh laute to aisa ho jaye goya aaj paida hua pas hamein Allah se umeed hai ke yeh hamare liye Allah ne di ho. Tabrani mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko apne liye ek ghar banane ka hukm diya Hazrat Dawood ne pehle apna ghar bana liya us par wahi aayi ke tum ne apna ghar mere ghar se pehle banaya aap ne arz kiya parwardigar yahi faisla kiya gaya tha phir masjid banani shuru ki deewarein poori ho gayin to ittefaqan tihai hissa gir gaya aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki jawab mila ke tu mera ghar nahin bana sakta. Poocha kyun? Farmaya is liye ke tere hathon se khoon baha hai. Arz kiya Allah Ta'ala woh bhi teri hi mohabbat mein farmaya haan lekin woh mere bande the main un par raham karta hoon. Aap ko yeh kalam sun kar sakht pareshani hui. Phir wahi aayi ke ghamgeen na ho main ise tere ladke Sulaiman ke hathon poora karaunga. Chunancha aap ke inteqal ke baad Hazrat Sulaiman ne ise banana shuru kiya jab poora kar chuke to badi badi qurbaniyan keen aur zabiha zibah kiye aur Bani Israel ko jama kar ke khoob khilaya pilaya Allah ki wahi aayi ke tu ne yeh sab kuch mere hukm ki tameel ki khushi mein kiya hai to mujh se maang jo mange ga paye ga. Arz kiya ke Allah Ta'ala mere teen sawal hain mujhe aisa faisla samjha jo tere faisle ke mutabiq ho aur aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho aur jo is ghar mein aaye sirf namaz ke irade se to woh apne gunahon se aisa azad ho jaye jaise aaj paida hua. In mein se do cheezein to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ata farma dein aur mujhe umeed hai ke teesri bhi de di gayi ho.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni har dua ko in lafzon se shuru farmate (Subhanallahi Rabbiyal A'lal Aliyyil Wahhab) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke inteqal ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se farmaya mujh se apni haajat talab karo. Aap ne arz kiya Allah Ta'ala mujhe aisa dil de jo tujh se darta rahe jaisa ke mere walid ka dil tujh se khauf kiya karta tha aur mere dil mein apni mohabbat daal de jaise ke mere walid ke dil mein teri mohabbat thi. Is par Allah Ta'ala bahut khush hua ke mera banda meri ain ata ke waqt bhi mujh se dara aur meri mohabbat talab karta hai, mujhe apni qasam main ise itni badi saltanat doonga jo is ke baad kisi ko na mile. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne un ki matahuti mein hawayein kar dein aur jinnaat ko bhi un ka matahat bana diya aur isi qadar mulk-o-maal par bhi, unhein hisab-e-qayamat se azaad kar diya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke Bari Ta'ala Sulaiman ke sath bhi isi lutf-o-karam se pesh aana jaisa aaj lutf-o-karam tera mujh par raha, to wahi aayi ke Sulaiman se keh do woh bhi isi tarah mera rahe jis tarah tu mera tha, to main bhi us ke sath ho. Khubsurat pyare wafadar tez-rau ghodon ko kaat dala to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne unhein un ke ewaz un se behtar ata farmaye. Yani hawa ko un ke tabe-e-farman kar diya jo mahine bhar ki raah ko subh ki ek ghadi mein tay kar deti thi aur isi tarah shaam ko jahan ka irada karte zara si der mein pahuncha deti. Jinnaat ko bhi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke tabe kar diya, un mein se baaz badi unchi lambi sangeen pukhta imarat ke banane ke kaam sar-anjaam dete jo insani taqat se bahar tha aur baaz ghota-khor thay jo samundar ki teh mein se lulu jawahar aur deegar qisam qisam ki nafees-o-nadir cheezein la dete thay. Phir aur kuch thay jo bhari bhari bediyon mein jakde rehte thay. Yeh ya to woh thay jo hukumat se sartabi karte thay ya kaam-kaaj mein shararat aur kami karte thay ya logon ko satate aur eeza dete thay. Yeh hai hamari meherbani aur hamari bakhshish aur hamara inaam aur hamara atiya, ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai jis se jo chahe sulook kar sab be-hisab hai kisi par pakad nahin. Jo teri zaban se niklega woh haq hoga. Sahih hadith mein hai jab Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ikhtiyar diya gaya ke agar chahein abd-o-rasool rahein yani jo hukm kiya jaye baja late rahein Allah ke farman ke mutabiq taqseem karte rahein aur agar chahein nabi aur badshah bana diye jayein jise chahein dein jise chahein na dein aur is ka koi hisab Allah ke han na liya jaye to aap ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se mashwara liya aur aap ke mashware se pehli baat qabool farmayi kyunke fazeelat ke lihaz se aula aur aala wahi hai. Go nabuwat-o-saltanat bhi badi cheez hai. Isi liye Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka dunyawi izz-o-jah bayan karte hi farmaya ke woh dar-e-akhirat mein bhi hamare paas bade martabe aur behtareen buzurgi aur aala-tar qareeb wala hai.

Sulaiman A.S ka tafseeli tazkira. Hum ne Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka imtehan liya aur un ki kursi par ek jism daal diya, yani shaitan phir woh apne takht-o-taj ki taraf laut aaye. Is shaitan ka naam Sakhr tha ya Asif tha ya Saro tha ya Haqeeq tha. Yeh waqea aksar mufassireen ne zikr kiya hai, kisi ne tafseel ke sath, kisi ne ikhtisar ke sath. Hazrat Qatada R.A is waqea ko is tarah bayan karte hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki tameer ka is tarah hukum hua ke lohay ki aawaz bhi na suni jaye. Aap ne har chand tadbeerein keen, lekin kargar na huin. Phir aap ne suna ke samundar mein ek shaitan hai jis ka naam Sakhr hai, woh albatta aisi tarkeeb bata sakta hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke ise kisi tarah lao. Ek darya samundar mein milta tha, har saatwein din is mein labalab pani aa jata tha aur yahi pani yeh shaitan peeta tha. Is ka pani nikal diya gaya aur bilkul khali kar ke pani ko band kar ke is ke aane wale din ise sharab se pur kar diya gaya. Jab shaitan aaya aur yeh haal dekha to kehne laga yeh to mazay ki cheez hai lekin aql ki dushman jahalat ko taraqqi dene wali cheez hai. Chunancha woh pyasa hi chala gaya. Jab pyas ki shiddat hui to majbooran yeh sab kuch kehte hue peena hi para. Ab aql jati rahi aur ise Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki angoothi dikhayi gayi ya mondhon ke darmiyan se mohar laga di gayi. Yeh bebas ho gaya. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki hukumat isi angoothi ki wajah se thi. Jab yeh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas pohancha to aap ne ise yeh kaam sar-anjaam dene ka hukum diya. Yeh hudhud ke anday le aaya aur unhein jama kar ke un par sheesha rakh diya. Hudhud aaya, us ne apne anday dekhe, charon taraf ghooma lekin dekha ke hath nahin aa sakte, ur kar wapas chala gaya aur almas le aaya aur ise us sheeshay par rakh kar sheeshay ko kaatna shuru kar diya. Aakhir woh kat gaya aur hudhud apne anday le gaya aur is almas ko bhi le liya gaya aur isi se patthar kaat kaat kar imarat shuru hui. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S jab bait-ul-khala mein ya hammam mein jate to angoothi utaar jate. Ek din hammam mein jana tha aur yeh shaitan aap ke sath tha, aap us waqt farzi ghusal ke liye ja rahe thay, angoothi isi ko sonp di aur chale gaye. Us ne angoothi samundar mein phenk di aur shaitan par Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki shakal daal di gayi aur aap se takht-o-taj chhin gaya. Sab cheezon par shaitan ne qabza kar liya siwaye aap ki biwiyon ke. Ab is se bohat si ghair-maroof baatein zuhoor mein aane lageen. Is zamana mein ek sahib thay jo aise hi thay jaise Huzoor ﷺ ke zamana mein Hazrat Farooq R.A. Us ne kaha aazmaish karni chahiye, mujhe to yeh shakhs Sulaiman maloom nahin hota. Chunancha ek roz us ne kaha kyun janab! Agar koi shakhs raat ko junubi ho jaye aur mausam zara thanda ho aur woh suraj tulu hone tak ghusal na kare to koi harj to nahin? Us ne kaha hargiz nahin. Chalees din tak yeh takht-e-Sulaiman par raha, phir aap ki machli ke pait se angoothi mil gayi, hath mein daalte hi phir tamam cheezein aap ki muti ho gayin. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai.

Suddi farmate hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki ek sau biwiyan thin, aap ko sab se zyada aitbar un mein se ek biwi par tha jin ka naam Jarawah tha. Jab janabi hone ya pakhane jate to apni angoothi unhi ko sonp jate. Ek martaba aap pakhane gaye, peeche se ek shaitan aap hi ki surat bana kar aaya aur biwi sahiba se angoothi talab ki, aap ne de di. Yeh aate hi takht par baith gaya. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S aaye aur angoothi talab ki to biwi sahiba ne farmaya, aap angoothi to le gaye. Aap samajh gaye ke yeh Allah ki aazmaish hai, nihayat pareshan haal se mahal se nikal gaye. Is shaitan ne chalees din tak hukumat ki, lekin ahkam ki tabdeeli ko dekh kar ulama ne samajh liya ke yeh Sulaiman A.S nahin. Chunancha un ki jamaat aap ki biwiyon ke paas aayi aur un se kaha, yeh kya mamla hai? Hamein Sulaiman A.S ki zaat mein shak pad gaya. Agar yeh sach-much Sulaiman A.S hai to is ki aql jaati rahi hai ya yeh ke yeh Sulaiman A.S hi nahin, warna aise khilaf-e-shara ahkam na deta. Auratein yeh sun kar rone lagin. Yeh yahan se wapas aa gaye aur takht ke gird-o-pesh use gher kar baith gaye aur Taurat khol kar us ki tilawat shuru kar di. Yeh khabeeth shaitan Kalam-e-Allah se bhaga aur angoothi samundar mein phenk di jise ek machhli nigal gayi. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S yunhi apne din guzarte the, ek martaba samundar ke kinare nikal gaye, bhook bahut lagi hui thi. Mahi-geeron ko machhliyan pakadte hue dekh kar un ke paas aa kar un se ek machhli mangi aur apna naam bhi bataya. Is par baaz logon ko bada taish aaya ke dekho bheek mangne wala apne tayin Sulaiman A.S batata hai, unhon ne aap ko marna peetna shuru kiya, aap zakhmi ho kar kinare ja kar apne zakhm ka khoon dhone lage. Baaz mahi-geeron ko reham aa gaya ke ek sail ko khwah-makhwah mara, jao bhai ise do machhliyan de aao, bhooka hai bhun khaye ga. Chunancha woh machhliyan aap ko de aaye, bhook ki wajah se aap apne zakhm ko aur khoon ko to bhool gaye aur jaldi se machhli ka pait chaak karne baith gaye. Qudrat-e-Allah se us ke pait se woh angoothi nikli, aap ne Allah ki tareef bayan ki aur angoothi ungli mein daali. Us waqt parindon ne aa kar aap par saya kar liya aur logon ne aap ko pehchan liya aur aap se mazrat karne lage. Aap ne farmaya yeh sab Amr-e-Ilahi tha, Allah ki taraf se ek imtihan tha. Aap aaye apne takht par baith gaye aur hukum diya ke is shaitan ko jahan bhi woh ho giraftar kar lao, chunancha use qaid kar liya gaya. Aap ne use ek lohay ke sandook mein band kiya aur qufl laga kar us par apni mohar laga di aur samundar mein phenkwa diya jo Qayamat tak wahin qaid rahe ga. Is ka naam Haqeeq tha. Aap ki yeh dua ke mujhe aisa mulk ata farmaya jaye jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho, yeh bhi poori hui aur aap ke tabe hawayein kar di gayin. Mujahid se marwi hai ke ek shaitan se jis ka naam Asif tha, ek martaba Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne poocha ke tum logon ko kis tarah fitne mein dalte ho?

Usne kaha zara mujhe angoothi dikhao main abhi aap ko dikha deta hoon, aap ne angoothi de di, usne use samundar mein phenk diya, takht-o-taj ka malik ban baitha aur aap ke libas mein logon ko rah-e-Allah se hatane laga. "Yaad rahe ke yeh sab waqiyat Bani Israel ke bayan karda hain" aur in sab se zyada munkar waqia woh hai jo Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai jiska oopar bayan hua, jismein aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Jarawah ka zikr hai. Ismein yeh bhi hai ke aakhir nabuwat yahan tak pahunchi thi ke ladke aap ko patthar maarte the. Aap ki biwiyon se jab ulama ne mamla ki tafteesh ki to unhon ne kaha ke haan hamein bhi iske Suleman hone se inkar hai kyunke woh halat-e-haiz mein hamare paas aata hai. Shaitan ko jab yeh maloom ho gaya ke raaz khul gaya hai to usne jadoo aur kufr ki kitabein likhwa kar kursi tale dafan kar diya aur phir logon ke samne unhein nikalwa kar unse kaha dekho in kitabon ki badaulat Suleman tum par hukumat kar raha tha, chunancha logon ne aap ko kafir kehna shuru kar diya. Hazrat Suleman samundar ke kinare mazdoori karte the, ek martaba ek shakhs ne bahut si machliyan khareedein, mazdoor ko bulaya, aap pahunche, usne kaha yeh utha lo, poocha mazdoori kya doge? Usne kaha ismein se ek machli tumhein de doonga, aap ne tokra sar par rakha, uske haan pahunchaya, usne ek machli de di, aap ne uska pait chaak kiya, pait chaak karte hi woh angoothi nikal padi, pehante hi kul shayateen, jinn, insaan phir tabe ho gaye aur jhurmat baandh kar hazir ho gaye, aap ne mulk par qabza kiya aur us shaitan ko sakht saza di. Pas "Summa Anab" se murad shaitan jo musallat kiya gaya tha uska lautna hai. Iski asnaad Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas tak hai. Hai to qawi lekin yeh zahir hai ke ise Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne Ahl-e-Kitab se liya hai, yeh bhi us waqt jab ise Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul maan lein. Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek jamaat Hazrat Suleman ko nahin manti thi to ajab nahin ke yeh behooda qissa usi khabeeth jamaat ka gadha hua ho. Ismein to woh cheezein bhi hain jo bilkul hi munkar hain, khusoosan us shaitan ka aap ki aurton ke paas jana aur aimma ne bhi aise hi qisse bayan to kiye hain lekin is baat ka sab ne inkar kiya hai aur kaha hai ke jinn unke paas nahin ja saka aur Nabi ke gharane ki aurton ki ismat-o-sharafat ka taqaza bhi yahi hai aur bhi bahut se logon ne in waqiyat ko bahut tafseel se bayan kiya hai lekin sab ki asal yahi hai ke woh Bani Israel aur Ahl-e-Kitab se liye gaye hain. Wallahu A'lam. Shaibani farmate hain aap ne apni angoothi Asqalan mein payi thi aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak tawazan aap paidal chale the. Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne sifat-e-Suleman mein Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar se ek ajeeb khabar riwayat ki hai. Abu Ishaq Misri kehte hain ke jab (اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ) (89).

(Al-Fajr: 7) ke qissay se Hazrat Ka'ab ne faraghat hasil ki toh Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne kaha Abu Ishaq aap Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki kursi ka zikr bhi kijiye. Farmaya ke woh hathi daant ki thi aur yaqoot, zabarjad aur lulu se murassa thi aur us ke charon taraf sonay ke khajoor ke darakht banay huay thay jin ke khushay bhi motiyon ke thay. Un mein se jo dayin janib thay un ke siray par sonay ke mor thay aur bayin taraf walon par sonay ke gidh thay. Is kursi ke pehlay darjay par dayin janib sonay ke do darakht sanobar ke thay aur bayin janib sonay ke do sher banay huay thay. Un ke siron par zabarjad ke do sutoon thay aur kursi ke donon janib angoor ki sunheri belein thin jo kursi ko dhanpay huay thin, us ke khushay bhi surkh moti ke thay. Phir kursi ke aala darjay par do sher bohat baray sonay ke banay huay thay jin ke andar khol tha, un mein mushk-o-ambar bhara rehta tha. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) kursi par aatay toh yeh sher harkat karte aur un ke ghoomnay se un ke andar se mushk-o-ambar charon taraf chhirak diya jata. Phir do mimbar sonay ke bichha diye jatay, ek aap ke wazeer ka aur ek us waqt ke sab se baray aalim ka. Phir kursi ke samnay sattar mimbar sonay ke aur bichhaye jatay jin par Bani Israel ke qazi, un ke ulama aur un ke sardar baithtay. Un ke peechay paintis mimbar sonay ke aur hotay thay jo khali raha kartay thay. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) jab tashreef laatay, pehlay zeenay par qadam rakhtay hi kursi un tamam cheezon samet ghoom jati, sher apna dayna qadam aagay barha deta aur gidh apna bayan par phaila deta. Jab doosray darjay par qadam rakhtay toh sher apna bayan paon phaila deta aur gidh apna dayan par. Jab aap teesray darjay par charh jatay aur kursi par baith jatay toh ek bara gidh aap ka taaj le kar aap ke sar par rakhta, phir kursi zor zor se ghoomti. Hazrat Mu'awiyah ne poocha aakhir is ki kya wajah? Farmaya woh ek sonay ki laat par thi jisay Sakhr Jinn ne banaya tha. Us ke ghoomtay hi neechay walay mor, gidh waghera sab oopar aa jatay aur sar jhukatay, par pharpharate jis se aap ke jism par mushk-o-ambar ka chhirkao ho jata. Phir ek sonay ka kabootar Taurat utha kar aap ke haath mein deta jisay aap tilawat farmatay. Lekin yeh riwayat bilkul ghareeb hai. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki dua ka matlab yeh hai ke mujhe aisa mulk de ke mujh se koi aur chheen na sakay jaise ke us jism ka waqea hua jo aap ki kursi par daal diya gaya tha. Yeh matlab nahin ke aap doosron ke liye aisay mulk ke na milnay ki dua kartay hon. Lekin jin ba'az logon ne yeh ma'ani liye hain woh kuch theek nazar nahin aatay, balkay sahih matlab yahi hai ke aap ki dua ka yahi matlab tha ke mujhe aisa mulk aur saltanat di jaye ke mere baad phir kisi aur shakhs ko aisi saltanat na milay. Yahi aayat ke alfaaz se maloom hota hai aur yahi ahadees se bhi sabit hota hai.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba farmaya ek sarkash jinn ne guzashta shab mujh par zyadati ki aur meri namaz bigad dena chahi lekin Allah ne mujhe us par qabu de diya aur main ne chaha ke use masjid ke us sutoon se bandh doon taake subah tum sab use dekho lekin usi waqt mujhe mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki dua yaad aa gayi. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Rooh farmate hain phir Huzoor ﷺ ne use zaleel-o-khwar kar ke chhod diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ namaz mein khade hue to hum ne suna ke aap ne farmaya A'uzu billahi minka phir aap ne teen baar farmaya Al'anuka bi la'natillah phir aap ne apna haath is tarah badhaya ke goya aap kisi cheez ko lena chahte hain. Jab farigh hue to hum ne aap se in dono baaton ki wajah poochhi aap ne farmaya Allah ka dushman Iblees aag lekar mere munh mein daalne ke liye aaya to main ne teen martaba A'uzu padhi phir teen martaba us par la'nat bheji lekin woh phir bhi na hata phir main ne chaha ke use pakad kar bandh doon taake Madine ke ladke us se khelein agar hamare bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to main yahi karta. Hazrat Ata bin Yazeed Laithi namaz padh rahe the jo Abu Ubaid ne un ke samne se guzarna chaha unhon ne unhein apne haath se rok diya phir farmaya mujh se Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri ne hadith bayan ki ke Huzoor ﷺ subah ki namaz padha rahe the yeh bhi aap ke peeche the qira'at aap par khalt-malt ho gayi farigh ho kar farmaya kaash tum dekhte ke main ne Iblees ko pakad liya tha aur is qadar us ka gala ghonta ke us ke munh ki jhaag meri shahadat ki aur beech ki ungli par padi agar mere bhai Hazrat Sulaiman ki dua na hoti to woh subah hote is masjid ke sutoon se bandha hua hota aur Madina ke bachche use satate tum se jahan tak ho sake is baat ka khayal rakho ke namaz ki halat mein tumhare samne se koi guzarne na paye (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai Rabia bin Yazeed Abdullah Yalami kehte hain main Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A ke paas Taif ke ek baagh mein gaya jis ka naam Rabt tha aap us waqt ek Quraishi ka muhasra kiye hue the jo zaani aur sharabi tha. Main ne un se kaha mujhe pata chala hai ke aap yeh hadith bayan farmate hain ke jo ek ghoont sharab piye ga Allah Ta'ala chalees din tak us ki tauba qabool na farmaye ga aur bura aadmi woh hai jo maa ke pet mein hi bura ho gaya hai jo shakhs sirf namaz hi ki niyat se Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid mein jaye to woh gunahon se aisa paak ho jata hai jaise aaj hi paida hua. Woh sharabi jise Hazrat Abdullah pakde hue the woh sharab ka zikr sunte hi jhatka de kar apna haath chuda kar bhaag gaya. Ab Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya kisi ko halal nahin ke mere zimme woh baat kare jo main ne na ki. Main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yun suna hai jo shakhs sharab ka ek ghoont bhi pi le us ki chalees din ki namaz namaqbool hai. Agar woh tauba kare to Allah us ki tauba qabool farmata hai.

Phir agar dobara laute to phir chalees din tak ki namazein namaqbool hain phir agar tauba karle to tauba maqbool hai mujhe achi tarah yaad nahin ke teesri ya chauthi martaba mein farmaya ke phir agar laute ga to yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala use jahannumiyon ke badan ka khoon, peep, peshab waghera qayamat ke din pilaye ga aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apni makhlooq ko andhere mein paida kiya phir un par apna noor dala jis par woh noor us din pad gaya woh to hidayat wala ho gaya aur jis tak woh noor na pahuncha woh bhatak gaya. Isi liye main kehta hoon ke Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ke ilm ke mutabiq qalam chal chuka aur main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala se teen duayein ki jin mein se do to unhein mil gayin aur hamein umeed hai ke teesri hamare liye ho (1) Mujhe aisa hukm de jo tere hukm ke muwafiq ho (2) Mujhe aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke liye laiq na ho. Teesri dua yeh thi ke jo shakhs apne ghar se is masjid ki namaz ke irade hi se nikle to jab woh laute to aisa ho jaye goya aaj paida hua pas hamein Allah se umeed hai ke yeh hamare liye Allah ne di ho. Tabrani mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko apne liye ek ghar banane ka hukm diya Hazrat Dawood ne pehle apna ghar bana liya us par wahi aayi ke tum ne apna ghar mere ghar se pehle banaya aap ne arz kiya parwardigar yahi faisla kiya gaya tha phir masjid banani shuru ki deewarein poori ho gayin to ittefaqan tihai hissa gir gaya aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki jawab mila ke tu mera ghar nahin bana sakta. Poocha kyun? Farmaya is liye ke tere hathon se khoon baha hai. Arz kiya Allah Ta'ala woh bhi teri hi mohabbat mein farmaya haan lekin woh mere bande the main un par raham karta hoon. Aap ko yeh kalam sun kar sakht pareshani hui. Phir wahi aayi ke ghamgeen na ho main ise tere ladke Sulaiman ke hathon poora karaunga. Chunancha aap ke inteqal ke baad Hazrat Sulaiman ne ise banana shuru kiya jab poora kar chuke to badi badi qurbaniyan keen aur zabiha zibah kiye aur Bani Israel ko jama kar ke khoob khilaya pilaya Allah ki wahi aayi ke tu ne yeh sab kuch mere hukm ki tameel ki khushi mein kiya hai to mujh se maang jo mange ga paye ga. Arz kiya ke Allah Ta'ala mere teen sawal hain mujhe aisa faisla samjha jo tere faisle ke mutabiq ho aur aisa mulk de jo mere baad kisi ke laiq na ho aur jo is ghar mein aaye sirf namaz ke irade se to woh apne gunahon se aisa azad ho jaye jaise aaj paida hua. In mein se do cheezein to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ata farma dein aur mujhe umeed hai ke teesri bhi de di gayi ho.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni har dua ko in lafzon se shuru farmate (Subhanallahi Rabbiyal A'lal Aliyyil Wahhab) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke inteqal ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se farmaya mujh se apni haajat talab karo. Aap ne arz kiya Allah Ta'ala mujhe aisa dil de jo tujh se darta rahe jaisa ke mere walid ka dil tujh se khauf kiya karta tha aur mere dil mein apni mohabbat daal de jaise ke mere walid ke dil mein teri mohabbat thi. Is par Allah Ta'ala bahut khush hua ke mera banda meri ain ata ke waqt bhi mujh se dara aur meri mohabbat talab karta hai, mujhe apni qasam main ise itni badi saltanat doonga jo is ke baad kisi ko na mile. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne un ki matahuti mein hawayein kar dein aur jinnaat ko bhi un ka matahat bana diya aur isi qadar mulk-o-maal par bhi, unhein hisab-e-qayamat se azaad kar diya. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke Bari Ta'ala Sulaiman ke sath bhi isi lutf-o-karam se pesh aana jaisa aaj lutf-o-karam tera mujh par raha, to wahi aayi ke Sulaiman se keh do woh bhi isi tarah mera rahe jis tarah tu mera tha, to main bhi us ke sath ho. Khubsurat pyare wafadar tez-rau ghodon ko kaat dala to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne unhein un ke ewaz un se behtar ata farmaye. Yani hawa ko un ke tabe-e-farman kar diya jo mahine bhar ki raah ko subh ki ek ghadi mein tay kar deti thi aur isi tarah shaam ko jahan ka irada karte zara si der mein pahuncha deti. Jinnaat ko bhi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke tabe kar diya, un mein se baaz badi unchi lambi sangeen pukhta imarat ke banane ke kaam sar-anjaam dete jo insani taqat se bahar tha aur baaz ghota-khor thay jo samundar ki teh mein se lulu jawahar aur deegar qisam qisam ki nafees-o-nadir cheezein la dete thay. Phir aur kuch thay jo bhari bhari bediyon mein jakde rehte thay. Yeh ya to woh thay jo hukumat se sartabi karte thay ya kaam-kaaj mein shararat aur kami karte thay ya logon ko satate aur eeza dete thay. Yeh hai hamari meherbani aur hamari bakhshish aur hamara inaam aur hamara atiya, ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai jis se jo chahe sulook kar sab be-hisab hai kisi par pakad nahin. Jo teri zaban se niklega woh haq hoga. Sahih hadith mein hai jab Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ikhtiyar diya gaya ke agar chahein abd-o-rasool rahein yani jo hukm kiya jaye baja late rahein Allah ke farman ke mutabiq taqseem karte rahein aur agar chahein nabi aur badshah bana diye jayein jise chahein dein jise chahein na dein aur is ka koi hisab Allah ke han na liya jaye to aap ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se mashwara liya aur aap ke mashware se pehli baat qabool farmayi kyunke fazeelat ke lihaz se aula aur aala wahi hai. Go nabuwat-o-saltanat bhi badi cheez hai. Isi liye Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka dunyawi izz-o-jah bayan karte hi farmaya ke woh dar-e-akhirat mein bhi hamare paas bade martabe aur behtareen buzurgi aur aala-tar qareeb wala hai.

Hazrat Ayyub A.S aur un ka sabr. Hazrat Ayyub A.S ka zikr ho raha hai aur un ke sabr aur imtehan mein paas hone ki tareef bayan ho rahi hai ke maal barbad ho gaya, auladein mar gayin, jism mareez ho gaya, yahan tak ke sui ke naake ke barabar saare jism mein aisi jagah na thi jahan bimari na ho, sirf dil salamat reh gaya aur phir faqiri aur muflisi ka yeh haal tha ke ek waqt ka khana paas na tha, koi na tha jo khabar-geer hota siwaye ek biwi sahiba R.A ke jin ke dil mein khauf-e-Allah tha aur apne khawand Allah ke rasool A.S ki mohabbat thi. Logon ka kaam-kaaj kar ke apna aur apne miyan ka pait paalti thin, aath saal tak yahi haal raha halankeh is se pehle un se barh kar maaldar koi na tha. Aulad bhi bakasrat thi aur duniya ki har rahat majood thi. Ab har cheez chheen li gayi thi aur shehar ka kora-karkat jahan dala jata tha wahin aap ko la bithaya tha. Isi haal mein ek do din nahin, saal do saal nahin, aath saal kaamil guzare, apne aur ghair sab ne munh pher liya tha. Khairiyat poochne wala bhi koi na tha. Sirf aap ki yahi ek biwi sahiba thin jo har waqt din aur raat aap ki khidmat mein kamar-basta thin. Haan pait paalne ke liye mehnat mazdoori ke waqt aap ke paas se chali jati thin, yahan tak ke din phire aur achha waqt aa gaya to Rabb-ul-Aalameen, Ilah-ul-Mursaleen ki taraf tazarru-o-zari ki aur kapkapate hue kaleje se, dil se dua ki ke aye mere paalnaar Allah mujhe dukh ne tarpa diya hai aur tu Arham-ur-Rahimeen hai. Yahan jo dua hai is mein jismani takleef aur maal-o-aulad ke dukh dard ka zikr kiya. Isi waqt Rahim-o-Kareem Allah ne is dua ko qabool farmaya aur hukm hua ke zameen par apna paon maaro. Paon ke lagte hi wahan ek chashma ubalne laga, hukm hua ke is paani se ghusal kar lo. Ghusal karte hi badan ki tamam bimari is tarah jati rahi goya thi hi nahin. Phir hukm hua ke aur jagah eri lagao, wahan paon maarte hi dusra chashma jaari ho gaya, hukm hua ke is ka paani pee lo, is paani ke peete hi androoni bimariyan bhi jati rahin aur zahir-o-batin ki aafiyat aur kaamil tandurusti hasil ho gayi. Ibn-e-Jarir aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain athara saal tak Allah ke yeh paighambar A.S dukh dard mein mubtala rahe, apne aur ghair sab ne chhor diya, haan aap ke mukhlis dost subh-o-sham khairiyat khabar ke liye aa jaya karte the. Ek martaba ek ne dusre se kaha mera khayal yeh hai ke Ayyub ne Allah ki koi bari nafarmani ki hai ke athara saal se is bala mein para hua hai aur Allah is par raham kare. Is dusre shakhs ne shaam ko Hazrat Ayyub A.S se is ki yeh baat zikr kar di. Aap ko sakht ranj hua aur farmaya main nahin jaanta ke woh aisa kyun kehte hain.

Allah khoob jaanta hai meri yeh halat thi ke jab do shakhson ko aapas mein jhagarte dekha aur dono Allah ko beech mein laate toh mujh se yeh na dekha jaata ke Allah Ta'ala ke azeez naam ki is tarah yaad ki jaaye kyunke do mein se ek toh zaroor mujrim hoga aur dono Allah ka naam le rahe hain toh main apne paas se de dila kar un ke jhagde ko khatam kar deta ke naam-e-Allah ki be-adbi na ho. Aap se us waqt chala phira balkay utha baitha bhi nahin jaata tha, pakhane ke baad aap ki biwi sahiba aap ko utha kar laati thin. Ek martaba woh nahin thin, aap ko bahut takleef hui aur dua ki aur Allah ki taraf se wahi hui ke zameen par laat maar do. Bahut der ke baad jab aap ki biwi sahiba aayin toh dekha ke mareez toh hai nahin, koi aur shakhs tandurust noorani chehre wala baitha hua hai, pehchan na sakeen aur daryaft karne lageen ke ae Allah ke nek bande! Yahan Allah ke ek Nabi jo dard-o-dukh mein mubtala thay unhein dekha hai? Wallah ke jab woh tandurust thay toh qareeb qareeb tum jaise hi thay, tab aap ne farmaya woh main hi hoon. Rawi kehta hai aap ki do kothiyan thin, ek gehun ke liye aur ek jau ke liye. Allah Ta'ala ne do abr bheje, ek mein sona barsa aur ek kothi anaaj ki us se bhar gayi, dusre mein se bhi sona barsa aur dusri kothi us se bhar gayi (Ibn-e-Jareer). Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) nange ho kar naha rahe thay ke aasman se sone ki tiddiyan barsne lagen, aap ne jaldi jaldi unhein apne kapde mein sametni shuru keen toh Allah Ta'ala ne aawaz di ke ae Ayyub! Kya main ne tumhein ghani aur be-parwah nahin kar rakha? Aap ne jawab diya, haan Ilahi! Beshak tu ne mujhe bahut kuch de rakha hai, main sab se ghani aur be-niyaz hoon lekin teri rahmat se be-niyaz nahin hoon balkay us ka toh poora mohtaj hoon. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne is sabir paighambar (A.S) ko nek badla aur behtar jazayein ata farmayin. Aulaad bhi di aur usi ke misl aur bhi di, balkay Hazrat Hasan aur Qatada se manqool hai ke murda aulaad Allah ne zinda kar di aur utni hi aur nayi di. Yeh tha Allah ka raham jo un ke sabr-o-istiqlal, ruju ilallah, tawazo aur inkisari ke badle Allah ne unhein diya aur aqalmandon ke liye nasihat-o-ibrat hai, woh jaan lete hain ke sabr ka anjam kushadgi hai aur rahmat-o-rahat hai. Baaz logon ka bayan hai ke Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) apni biwi ke kisi kaam ki wajah se un par naraz ho gaye thay, baaz kehte hain woh apne baalon ki ek lat bech kar un ke liye khana layi thin us par aap naraz hue thay aur qasam khayi thi ke shifa ke baad sau kode marenge, dusron ne wajah-e-narazgi aur bayan ki hai.

Jabke aap tandurust aur sahih salim ho gaye toh irada kiya ke apni qasam ko pura karein lekin aisi nek sifat aurat is saza ke laiq na thin jo Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) ne tay kar rakhi thi. Jis aurat ne us waqt khidmat ki jabke koi sath na tha isi liye Rabb-ul-Alameen Arham-ur-Rahimeen ne un par raham kiya aur apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum diya ke qasam puri karne ke liye khajoor ka ek khosha le lo jis mein ek sau seekhein hon aur ek unhein maar do, is surat mein qasam ka khilaf na hoga aur ek aisi sabira shakira nek biwi par saza bhi na hogi. Yehi dastoor-e-Ilahi hai ke woh apne nek bandon ko jo us se darte rehte hain buraiyon aur badiyon se mehfooz rakhta hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) ki sana-o-sifat bayan farmata hai ke hum ne unhein bada sabir-o-zabita paya, woh bada nek aur achha banda sabit hua. Us ke dil mein hamari sachi mohabbat thi, woh hamari hi taraf jhukta raha aur humein se lau lagaye raha. Isi liye farman-e-Allah hai ke jo Allah se darta rehta hai Allah us ke liye chhutkare ki surat nikal deta hai aur use aisi jagah se rozi pahunchata hai jo us ke khayal mein bhi na ho. Allah par tawakkul rakhne walon ko Allah kafi hai. Allah apne kaam mein pura utarta hai, Allah Ta'ala ne har cheez ka ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai. Samajhdar ulama-e-kiram ne is ayat se bahut se imani masail akhaz kiye hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Ayyub A.S aur un ka sabr. Hazrat Ayyub A.S ka zikr ho raha hai aur un ke sabr aur imtehan mein paas hone ki tareef bayan ho rahi hai ke maal barbad ho gaya, auladein mar gayin, jism mareez ho gaya, yahan tak ke sui ke naake ke barabar saare jism mein aisi jagah na thi jahan bimari na ho, sirf dil salamat reh gaya aur phir faqiri aur muflisi ka yeh haal tha ke ek waqt ka khana paas na tha, koi na tha jo khabar-geer hota siwaye ek biwi sahiba R.A ke jin ke dil mein khauf-e-Allah tha aur apne khawand Allah ke rasool A.S ki mohabbat thi. Logon ka kaam-kaaj kar ke apna aur apne miyan ka pait paalti thin, aath saal tak yahi haal raha halankeh is se pehle un se barh kar maaldar koi na tha. Aulad bhi bakasrat thi aur duniya ki har rahat majood thi. Ab har cheez chheen li gayi thi aur shehar ka kora-karkat jahan dala jata tha wahin aap ko la bithaya tha. Isi haal mein ek do din nahin, saal do saal nahin, aath saal kaamil guzare, apne aur ghair sab ne munh pher liya tha. Khairiyat poochne wala bhi koi na tha. Sirf aap ki yahi ek biwi sahiba thin jo har waqt din aur raat aap ki khidmat mein kamar-basta thin. Haan pait paalne ke liye mehnat mazdoori ke waqt aap ke paas se chali jati thin, yahan tak ke din phire aur achha waqt aa gaya to Rabb-ul-Aalameen, Ilah-ul-Mursaleen ki taraf tazarru-o-zari ki aur kapkapate hue kaleje se, dil se dua ki ke aye mere paalnaar Allah mujhe dukh ne tarpa diya hai aur tu Arham-ur-Rahimeen hai. Yahan jo dua hai is mein jismani takleef aur maal-o-aulad ke dukh dard ka zikr kiya. Isi waqt Rahim-o-Kareem Allah ne is dua ko qabool farmaya aur hukm hua ke zameen par apna paon maaro. Paon ke lagte hi wahan ek chashma ubalne laga, hukm hua ke is paani se ghusal kar lo. Ghusal karte hi badan ki tamam bimari is tarah jati rahi goya thi hi nahin. Phir hukm hua ke aur jagah eri lagao, wahan paon maarte hi dusra chashma jaari ho gaya, hukm hua ke is ka paani pee lo, is paani ke peete hi androoni bimariyan bhi jati rahin aur zahir-o-batin ki aafiyat aur kaamil tandurusti hasil ho gayi. Ibn-e-Jarir aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain athara saal tak Allah ke yeh paighambar A.S dukh dard mein mubtala rahe, apne aur ghair sab ne chhor diya, haan aap ke mukhlis dost subh-o-sham khairiyat khabar ke liye aa jaya karte the. Ek martaba ek ne dusre se kaha mera khayal yeh hai ke Ayyub ne Allah ki koi bari nafarmani ki hai ke athara saal se is bala mein para hua hai aur Allah is par raham kare. Is dusre shakhs ne shaam ko Hazrat Ayyub A.S se is ki yeh baat zikr kar di. Aap ko sakht ranj hua aur farmaya main nahin jaanta ke woh aisa kyun kehte hain.

Allah khoob jaanta hai meri yeh halat thi ke jab do shakhson ko aapas mein jhagarte dekha aur dono Allah ko beech mein laate toh mujh se yeh na dekha jaata ke Allah Ta'ala ke azeez naam ki is tarah yaad ki jaaye kyunke do mein se ek toh zaroor mujrim hoga aur dono Allah ka naam le rahe hain toh main apne paas se de dila kar un ke jhagde ko khatam kar deta ke naam-e-Allah ki be-adbi na ho. Aap se us waqt chala phira balkay utha baitha bhi nahin jaata tha, pakhane ke baad aap ki biwi sahiba aap ko utha kar laati thin. Ek martaba woh nahin thin, aap ko bahut takleef hui aur dua ki aur Allah ki taraf se wahi hui ke zameen par laat maar do. Bahut der ke baad jab aap ki biwi sahiba aayin toh dekha ke mareez toh hai nahin, koi aur shakhs tandurust noorani chehre wala baitha hua hai, pehchan na sakeen aur daryaft karne lageen ke ae Allah ke nek bande! Yahan Allah ke ek Nabi jo dard-o-dukh mein mubtala thay unhein dekha hai? Wallah ke jab woh tandurust thay toh qareeb qareeb tum jaise hi thay, tab aap ne farmaya woh main hi hoon. Rawi kehta hai aap ki do kothiyan thin, ek gehun ke liye aur ek jau ke liye. Allah Ta'ala ne do abr bheje, ek mein sona barsa aur ek kothi anaaj ki us se bhar gayi, dusre mein se bhi sona barsa aur dusri kothi us se bhar gayi (Ibn-e-Jareer). Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) nange ho kar naha rahe thay ke aasman se sone ki tiddiyan barsne lagen, aap ne jaldi jaldi unhein apne kapde mein sametni shuru keen toh Allah Ta'ala ne aawaz di ke ae Ayyub! Kya main ne tumhein ghani aur be-parwah nahin kar rakha? Aap ne jawab diya, haan Ilahi! Beshak tu ne mujhe bahut kuch de rakha hai, main sab se ghani aur be-niyaz hoon lekin teri rahmat se be-niyaz nahin hoon balkay us ka toh poora mohtaj hoon. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne is sabir paighambar (A.S) ko nek badla aur behtar jazayein ata farmayin. Aulaad bhi di aur usi ke misl aur bhi di, balkay Hazrat Hasan aur Qatada se manqool hai ke murda aulaad Allah ne zinda kar di aur utni hi aur nayi di. Yeh tha Allah ka raham jo un ke sabr-o-istiqlal, ruju ilallah, tawazo aur inkisari ke badle Allah ne unhein diya aur aqalmandon ke liye nasihat-o-ibrat hai, woh jaan lete hain ke sabr ka anjam kushadgi hai aur rahmat-o-rahat hai. Baaz logon ka bayan hai ke Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) apni biwi ke kisi kaam ki wajah se un par naraz ho gaye thay, baaz kehte hain woh apne baalon ki ek lat bech kar un ke liye khana layi thin us par aap naraz hue thay aur qasam khayi thi ke shifa ke baad sau kode marenge, dusron ne wajah-e-narazgi aur bayan ki hai.

Jabke aap tandurust aur sahih salim ho gaye toh irada kiya ke apni qasam ko pura karein lekin aisi nek sifat aurat is saza ke laiq na thin jo Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) ne tay kar rakhi thi. Jis aurat ne us waqt khidmat ki jabke koi sath na tha isi liye Rabb-ul-Alameen Arham-ur-Rahimeen ne un par raham kiya aur apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum diya ke qasam puri karne ke liye khajoor ka ek khosha le lo jis mein ek sau seekhein hon aur ek unhein maar do, is surat mein qasam ka khilaf na hoga aur ek aisi sabira shakira nek biwi par saza bhi na hogi. Yehi dastoor-e-Ilahi hai ke woh apne nek bandon ko jo us se darte rehte hain buraiyon aur badiyon se mehfooz rakhta hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) ki sana-o-sifat bayan farmata hai ke hum ne unhein bada sabir-o-zabita paya, woh bada nek aur achha banda sabit hua. Us ke dil mein hamari sachi mohabbat thi, woh hamari hi taraf jhukta raha aur humein se lau lagaye raha. Isi liye farman-e-Allah hai ke jo Allah se darta rehta hai Allah us ke liye chhutkare ki surat nikal deta hai aur use aisi jagah se rozi pahunchata hai jo us ke khayal mein bhi na ho. Allah par tawakkul rakhne walon ko Allah kafi hai. Allah apne kaam mein pura utarta hai, Allah Ta'ala ne har cheez ka ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai. Samajhdar ulama-e-kiram ne is ayat se bahut se imani masail akhaz kiye hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Allah Ta'ala apne aabid bandon aur rasoolon ki fazeelaton ko bayan farma raha hai aur un ke naam ginwa raha hai Ibrahim, Ishaq aur Yaqub (Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihim ajma'een) aur farmata hai ke un ke a'maal bahut behtar thay aur sahih ilm bhi un mein tha. Saath hi ibadat-e-Ilahi mein qawi thay aur qudrat ki taraf se unhein baseerat ata farmai gayi thi. Deen mein samajhdaar thay, ita'at-e-Allah mein qawi thay, haq ke dekhne wale thay. Un ke nazdeek duniya ki koi ahmiyat na thi, sirf aakhirat ka hi har waqt khayal bandha rehta tha. Har amal aakhirat ke liye hi hota tha. Duniya ki mohabbat se woh alag thay, aakhirat ke zikr mein har waqt mashghool rehte thay. Woh a'maal karte thay jo jannat dilwayein, logon ko bhi nek a'maal ki targheeb dete thay. Unhein Allah Ta'ala bhi Qayamat ke din behtareen badle aur afzal maqamat ata farmaye ga. Yeh buzargaan-e-deen Allah ke cheeda, mukhlis aur khaas-ul-khaas banday hain. Ismail aur Zul-Kifl (Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihim ajma'een) bhi pasandeeda aur khaas bandon mein thay. Un ke bayanaat Surah Anbiya mein guzar chuke hain is liye hum ne yahan bayan nahin kiye. In fazail ke bayan mein un ke liye naseehat hai jo pand-o-naseehat hasil karne ke liye aadi hain aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke yeh Quran-e-Azeem zikr yani naseehat hai.

Hamesha rehne wali jannatein hain jin ke darwaze un ke liye band nahin balkay khulay huay hain. Khulwanay ki bhi zehmat nahin. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain jannat mein ek mahal-e-Adan hai jis ke aas-paas burj hain jis ke paanch hazaar darwaze hain aur har darwazay par paanch hazaar chadarein hain un mein sirf Nabi ya Siddiq ya Shaheed ya Aadil badshah rahenge (Ibn Abi Hatim) aur yeh toh bohat si bilkul sahih ahadees se sabit hai ke jannat ke aath darwaze hain. Apne takhton par takiye lagaye be-fikri se chaar-zaano ba-aaram bethay huay honge. Aur jis qoum ko jis meway sharab ka jee chahay hukum ke sath khudaam ba-saleeqa hazir kar dein ge. Un ke paas un ki biwiyan hongi jo afeefa, paak-daman, neechi nigahon wali aur un se mohabbat-o-ishq rakhne wali hongi jin ki nigahain kabhi dusre ki taraf na uthi hain na uthein na uth sakein. Un ki hum-umar hongi un ki umron ke laiq hongi. Yeh hai hamara inaam jis mein na kabhi kami aayegi na yeh munqata hoga. Jaise farmaya (مَا عِنْدَكُمْ يَنْفَدُ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ بَاقٍ) (16-An-Nahl: 96) tumhare paas jo kuch hai woh khatam ho jata hai aur Allah ke paas jo hai woh baqi rehne wala hai aur aayat mein hai aur jagah ghair-mamnoon bhi hai. Matlab yeh hai ke na is mein kabhi kami aur ghata aaye na kabhi woh khatam aur fana ho. Jaise irshad hai (اُكُلُهَا دَاۗىِٕمٌ وَّظِلُّهَا ۭ تِلْكَ عُقْبَى الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْاڰ وَّعُقْبَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَ النَّارُ) (13-Ar-Ra'd: 35), is ke meway aur khane peene aur is ke saaye daimi hain. Parhezgaron ka anjam yahi hai aur kafiron ka anjam jahannam hai. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bohat si aayatein hain.

Jise woh is tarah ghasit-te phirenge jaise koi shakhs apna kapra ghasit raha ho (Ibn Abi Hatim). Garz sardi ka azab alag hoga garmi ka alag hoga Hameem peene ko Zaqqum khane ko kabhi aag ke paharon par charhaya jata hai toh kabhi aag ke garhon mein dhakela jata hai Allah hamein bachaye. Allah farmayega har ek ke liye dugna hi hai lekin tum nahin jante. Yani har ek ke liye aisa azab hai jis ki inteha usi ke liye hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke Abu Jahl kahega ke Bilal, Ammar, Suhaib waghera waghera kahan hain?

Woh toh nazar hi nahin aate, garaz har kafir yahi kahega ke woh log jinhein duniya mein hum shareer ginte thay woh aaj yahan nazar nahin aate. Isi waqt jannatiyon ki taraf se nida aayegi ke ae dozakhiyo! Idhar dekho, hum ne toh apne Rab ke wade ko haq paya, tum apni kaho kya Allah ke wade sachay nikle? Jaise farman hai (Qalat ukhrahum li-ulahum rabbana ha'ula'i adalluna fa-atihim azaban di'fan minan-nar, qala likullin di'fun wa lakin la ta'lamun) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 38), yani pichle pehlon ke liye kahenge ke Parwardigar inhone hamein gumrah kar diya toh inhein aag ka dugna azab kar. Allah farmayega har ek ke liye dugna hi hai lekin tum nahin jante. Yani har ek ke liye aisa azab hai jis ki inteha usi ke liye hai. Chunke kuffar wahan mominon ko na payenge jinhein apne khayal mein behka hua jante thay toh is mein zikr karenge ke is ki wajah kya hai? Hamein musalman Jahannam mein nazar nahin aate? Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke Abu Jahl kahega ke Bilal, Ammar, Suhaib waghera waghera kahan hain?

Woh toh nazar hi nahin aate, garaz har kafir yahi kahega ke woh log jinhein duniya mein hum shareer ginte thay woh aaj yahan nazar nahin aate. Kya hamari hi ghalti thi ke hum unhein duniya mein mazaq mein urate thay? Lekin nahin, aisa toh na tha, woh honge toh jahannam mein hi lekin kahin idhar udhar honge, hamari nigah mein nahin parte. Isi waqt jannatiyon ki taraf se nida aayegi ke ae dozakhiyo! Idhar dekho, hum ne toh apne Rab ke wade ko haq paya, tum apni kaho kya Allah ke wade sachay nikle? Yeh jawab denge ke haan bilkul sach nikle. Isi waqt ek munadi nida karega ke zalimon par Allah ki laanat ho. Isi ka bayan aayat-e-quraniyah (Wa naada as-haabul jannati as-haaban naari an qad wajadna ma wa'adana rabbuna haqqan fahal wajadtum ma wa'ada rabbukum haqqan, qalu na'am, fa azzana mu'azzinum bainahum al la'natullahi alaz zalimeen) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 44) hai. Phir farmata hai ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo khabar mein tumhein de raha hoon ke jahannami isi tarah larenge jhagrenge aur aapas mein ek dusre par laan ta'an karenge, yeh bilkul sachi waqai aur theek khabar hai jis mein koi shak-o-shuba nahin.)))

Nabi A.S ka khwab. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko hukum farmata hai ke kafiron se keh do ke meri nisbat tumhare khayalat mehez ghalat hain, main toh tumhein dar ki khabar pahunchane wala hoon. Allah wahdahu la sharika lahu ke siwa aur koi qabil-e-parastish nahin, woh akela hai, woh har cheez par ghalib hai, har cheez uske matehat hai. Woh zameen-o-aasman aur har cheez ka malik hai aur sab tasarrufat usi ke qabze mein hain. Woh izzaton wala hai aur bawajood is azmat-o-izzat ke bada bakhshne wala hai. Yeh bahut badi cheez hai yani mera Rasool ban kar tumhari taraf aana, phir tum ae ghafilo is se a'raaz kar rahe ho. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh badi cheez hai yani Quran-e-Kareem. Hazrat Adam A.S ke bare mein farishton mein jo kuch ikhtilaf hua agar Rabb ki wahi mere paas na aayi hoti toh mujhe iski babat kya ilm hota? Iblees ka Aap ko sajda karne se munkir hona aur Rabb ke samne uski mukhalifat karna aur apni badai jatana waghera in sab baton ko main kya janun? Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ek din subah ki namaz mein Huzoor ﷺ ne bahut der laga di yahan tak ke suraj tulu hone ka waqt aa gaya, phir bahut jaldi karte hue aaye, takbeer kahi gayi aur Aap ne halki namaz padhai. Phir hum se farmaya zara der thehre raho, phir hamari taraf mutawajja ho kar farmaya raat ko main tahajjud ki namaz padh raha tha jo mujhe oongh aane lagi yahan tak ke main jaga, main ne dekha ke goya main apne Rabb ke paas hoon, main ne apne Parwardigar ko behtareen umda surat mein dekha. Mujh se Janab-e-Bari ne daryaft farmaya jante ho aalam-e-bala ke farishte is waqt kis amr mein guftagu aur sawal-o-jawab kar rahe hain? Main ne kaha mere Rabb mujhe kya khabar? Teen martaba ke sawal-o-jawab ke baad main ne dekha ke mere dono mondhon ke darmiyan Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apna hath rakha yahan tak ke ungliyon ki thandak mujhe mere seene mein mehsoos hui aur mujh par har ek cheez roshan ho gayi. Phir mujh se sawal kiya ab batao Mala-e-A'la mein kya baat-cheet ho rahi hai? Main ne kaha gunahon ke kaffare ki. Farmaya phir tum batao kaffare kya kya hain? Main ne kaha namaz-e-ba-jamaat ke liye qadam utha kar jana, namazon ke baad masjidon mein baithe rehna aur dil ke na chahte par bhi kamil wuzu karna. Phir mujh se mere Allah ne poocha darje kya hain? Main ne kaha khana khilana, narm-e-kalami karna aur raton ko jab log soye pade hon namaz padhna. Ab mujh se mere Rabb ne farmaya mang kya mangta hai? Main ne kaha main nekion ka karna, buraiyon ka chhodna, maskeenon se mohabbat rakhna aur teri bakhshish, tera raham aur tera irada jab kisi qoum ki aazmaish ka fitne ke sath ho toh use fitne mein mubtala hone se pehle maut, teri mohabbat aur tujh se mohabbat rakhne walon ki mohabbat aur un kamon ki chahat jo teri mohabbat se qareeb karne wale hon mangta hoon. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya yeh sarasar haq hai ise padho, padhao, seekho, sikhao.

Yeh hadith khwab ki hai aur mashhoor bhi yehi hai. Baaz ne kaha hai yeh jaagte ka waqea hai lekin yeh ghalat hai, balkay sahih yeh hai ke yeh waqea khwab ka hai aur yeh bhi khayal rahe ke Quran mein farishton ki jis baat ka rad-o-badal karna is aayat mein mazkoor hai woh yeh nahin jo is hadith mein hai, balkay yeh sawal toh woh hai jis ka zikr is ke baad hi hai, mulahiza hon agli aayatein.

Mujh se Janab-e-Bari ne daryaft farmaya jante ho aalam-e-bala ke farishte is waqt kis amr mein guftagu aur sawal-o-jawab kar rahe hain? Main ne kaha mere Rabb mujhe kya khabar? Teen martaba ke sawal-o-jawab ke baad main ne dekha ke mere dono mondhon ke darmiyan Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apna hath rakha yahan tak ke ungliyon ki thandak mujhe mere seene mein mehsoos hui aur mujh par har ek cheez roshan ho gayi. Phir mujh se sawal kiya ab batao Mala-e-A'la mein kya baat-cheet ho rahi hai? Main ne kaha gunahon ke kaffare ki. Farmaya phir tum batao kaffare kya kya hain? Main ne kaha namaz-e-ba-jamaat ke liye qadam utha kar jana, namazon ke baad masjidon mein baithe rehna aur dil ke na chahte par bhi kamil wuzu karna. Phir mujh se mere Allah ne poocha darje kya hain? Main ne kaha khana khilana, narm-e-kalami karna aur raton ko jab log soye pade hon namaz padhna. Ab mujh se mere Rabb ne farmaya mang kya mangta hai? Main ne kaha main nekion ka karna, buraiyon ka chhodna, maskeenon se mohabbat rakhna aur teri bakhshish, tera raham aur tera irada jab kisi qoum ki aazmaish ka fitne ke sath ho toh use fitne mein mubtala hone se pehle maut, teri mohabbat aur tujh se mohabbat rakhne walon ki mohabbat aur un kamon ki chahat jo teri mohabbat se qareeb karne wale hon mangta hoon. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya yeh sarasar haq hai ise padho, padhao, seekho, sikhao.

Yeh hadith khwab ki hai aur mashhoor bhi yehi hai. Baaz ne kaha hai yeh jaagte ka waqea hai lekin yeh ghalat hai, balkay sahih yeh hai ke yeh waqea khwab ka hai aur yeh bhi khayal rahe ke Quran mein farishton ki jis baat ka rad-o-badal karna is aayat mein mazkoor hai woh yeh nahin jo is hadith mein hai, balkay yeh sawal toh woh hai jis ka zikr is ke baad hi hai, mulahiza hon agli aayatein.

Takhleeq-e-Adam aur Iblees ki sarkashi. Yeh qissa Surah Baqarah, Surah A'raf, Surah Hijr, Surah Subhan, Surah Kahf aur is Surah Sad mein bayan hua hai. Hazrat Adam A.S ko paida karne se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne farishton ko apna irada bataya ke main mitti se Adam ko paida karne wala hoon. Jab main ise paida kar chukoon toh tum sab ise sajda karna taake meri farmanbardari ke sath hi Hazrat Adam A.S ki sharafat-o-buzurgi ka bhi izhar ho jaye. Pas kul ke kul farishton ne tameel-e-irshad ki. Haan Iblees is se ruka, yeh farishton ki jins mein se tha bhi nahin balkay jinnaat mein se tha. Tab'i khabasat aur jabli sarkashi zahir ho gayi. Sawal hua ke itni mu'azzaz makhlooq ko jise main ne apne hathon se banaya, tu ne mere kehne ke bawajood sajda kyun na kiya? Yeh takabbur! Aur yeh sarkashi? Toh kehne laga ke main is se afzal-o-a'la hoon, kahan aag aur kahan mitti? Is khata-kar ne is ke samajhne mein bhi ghalti ki aur Allah ke hukum ki mukhalifat ki wajah se gharat ho gaya. Hukum hua ke mere samne se munh hata, mere darbar mein tujh jaise nafarmanon ki rasai nahin, tu meri rahmat se door ho gaya aur tujh par abadi la'nat nazil hui aur ab tu khair-o-khoobi se mayoos ho ja. Is ne Allah se dua ki ke Qayamat tak mujhe mohlat di jaye. Is Haleem Allah ne jo apni makhlooq ko un ke gunahon par foran nahin pakarta, is ki yeh iltija poori kar di aur Qayamat tak ki ise mohlat de di. Ab kehne laga main toh is ki tamam aulad ko behka doonga, sirf mukhlis log toh bach jayenge. Manzoor-e-Allah bhi yahi tha jaisa ke Quran-e-Kareem ki aur aayaton mein bhi hai, maslan (QALA ARA'AITAKA HADHAL-LADHI KARRAMTA 'ALAYYA LA'IN AKHARTANI ILA YAWMIL-QIYAMATI LA'AHTANIKANNA DHURRIYYATAHU ILLA QALILA) (Al-Isra: 62) aur (INNA 'IBADI LAYSA LAKA 'ALAYHIM SULTANUN ILLA MANIT-TABA'AKA MINAL-GHAWIN) (Al-Hijr: 42). Fal-Haq ko Hazrat Mujahid R.H ne pesh se parha hai, ma'ni yeh hain ke main khud Haq hoon aur meri baat bhi Haq hi hoti hai aur ek riwayat mein un se yun marwi hai ke Haq meri taraf se hai aur main Haq hi kehta hoon. Auron ne dono lafz zabar se parhay hain. Suddi R.H kehte hain yeh qasam hai. Main kehta hoon yeh aayat is aayat ki tarah hai (WA LAW SHI'NA LA'ATAYNA KULLA NAFSIN HUDAHA WA LAKIN HAQQAL-QAWLU MINNI LA'AMLA'ANNA JAHANNAMA MINAL-JINNATI WAN-NASI AJMA'IN) (As-Sajdah: 13) yani mera yeh qaul atal hai ke main zaroor zaroor Jahannam ko is qisam ke insanon aur jinnon se pur kar doonga aur jaise farman hai (Idh-hab faman tabi'aka) al-kh, yahan se nikal ja, jo shakhs bhi teri manay ga us ki aur teri poori saza Jahannam hai.

Main kehta hoon yeh aayat is aayat ki tarah hai (WA LAW SHI'NA LA'ATAYNA KULLA NAFSIN HUDAHA WA LAKIN HAQQAL-QAWLU MINNI LA'AMLA'ANNA JAHANNAMA MINAL-JINNATI WAN-NASI AJMA'IN) (As-Sajdah: 13) yani mera yeh qaul atal hai ke main zaroor zaroor Jahannam ko is qisam ke insanon aur jinnon se pur kar doonga aur jaise farman hai (Idh-hab faman tabi'aka) al-kh, yahan se nikal ja, jo shakhs bhi teri manay ga us ki aur teri poori saza Jahannam hai.

Takhleeq-e-Adam aur Iblees ki sarkashi. Yeh qissa Surah Baqarah, Surah A'raf, Surah Hijr, Surah Subhan, Surah Kahf aur is Surah Sad mein bayan hua hai. Hazrat Adam A.S ko paida karne se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne farishton ko apna irada bataya ke main mitti se Adam ko paida karne wala hoon. Jab main ise paida kar chukoon toh tum sab ise sajda karna taake meri farmanbardari ke sath hi Hazrat Adam A.S ki sharafat-o-buzurgi ka bhi izhar ho jaye. Pas kul ke kul farishton ne tameel-e-irshad ki. Haan Iblees is se ruka, yeh farishton ki jins mein se tha bhi nahin balkay jinnaat mein se tha. Tab'i khabasat aur jabli sarkashi zahir ho gayi. Sawal hua ke itni mu'azzaz makhlooq ko jise main ne apne hathon se banaya, tu ne mere kehne ke bawajood sajda kyun na kiya? Yeh takabbur! Aur yeh sarkashi? Toh kehne laga ke main is se afzal-o-a'la hoon, kahan aag aur kahan mitti? Is khata-kar ne is ke samajhne mein bhi ghalti ki aur Allah ke hukum ki mukhalifat ki wajah se gharat ho gaya. Hukum hua ke mere samne se munh hata, mere darbar mein tujh jaise nafarmanon ki rasai nahin, tu meri rahmat se door ho gaya aur tujh par abadi la'nat nazil hui aur ab tu khair-o-khoobi se mayoos ho ja. Is ne Allah se dua ki ke Qayamat tak mujhe mohlat di jaye. Is Haleem Allah ne jo apni makhlooq ko un ke gunahon par foran nahin pakarta, is ki yeh iltija poori kar di aur Qayamat tak ki ise mohlat de di. Ab kehne laga main toh is ki tamam aulad ko behka doonga, sirf mukhlis log toh bach jayenge. Manzoor-e-Allah bhi yahi tha jaisa ke Quran-e-Kareem ki aur aayaton mein bhi hai, maslan (QALA ARA'AITAKA HADHAL-LADHI KARRAMTA 'ALAYYA LA'IN AKHARTANI ILA YAWMIL-QIYAMATI LA'AHTANIKANNA DHURRIYYATAHU ILLA QALILA) (Al-Isra: 62) aur (INNA 'IBADI LAYSA LAKA 'ALAYHIM SULTANUN ILLA MANIT-TABA'AKA MINAL-GHAWIN) (Al-Hijr: 42). Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum deta hai ke logon mein aap elaan kar dein ke main tableegh-e-deen par aur ahkaam-e-Quran par tum se koi ujrat-o-badla nahin maangta. Is se mera maqsood koi dunyawi nafa hasil karna nahin aur na main takalluf karne wala hoon ke Allah ne na utara ho aur main jod loon. Mujhe toh jo kuch pahunchaya hai wahi main tumhein pahuncha deta hoon na kami karoon na ziyadati aur mera maqsood is se sirf raza-e-Rabb aur marzi-e-Maula hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain logon jise kisi masla ka ilm ho woh use logon se bayan kar de aur jo na jaanta ho woh keh de ke Allah jaane. Dekho Allah Ta'ala ne is aayat mein apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bhi yahi farmaya ke main takalluf karne wala nahin hoon. Yeh Quran tamam insaanon aur jinnon ke liye nasihat hai jaise aur aayat mein hai taake main tumhein aur jin jin logon tak yeh pahunche aagah aur hoshiyar kar doon aur aayat mein hai ke jo shakhs bhi is se kufr kare woh jahannami hai. Meri baaton ki haqeeqat mere kalaam ki tasdeeq mere bayan ki sachai mere zabaan ki sadaqat tumhein abhi abhi maloom ho jayegi yani marte hi, Qayamat ke qaim hote hi. Maut ke waqt yaqeen aa jayega aur meri kahi hui khabrein apni aankhon se dekh loge. Wallahu A'lam bis-Sawab. Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Sad ki tafseer khatam hui. Allah Ta'ala ke inaam-o-ehsaan par us ka shukr hai.
